BookOrbit is a native Android client for your own self-hosted BookOrbit
server — a personal library for ebooks and audiobooks that you control.

• Browse and search your full library, with smart scopes and collections

fdroid:com.greenart7c3.nostrsigner.name: Amber
fdroid:com.greenart7c3.nostrsigner.description: Amber is a nostr event signer for Android. It allows users to keep their nsec segregated in a single, dedicated app. The goal of Amber is to have your smartphone act as a NIP-46 signing device without any need for servers or additional hardware. fdroid:com.mendhak.conscryptprovider.name: Conscrypt Provider
fdroid:com.mendhak.conscryptprovider.summary: Conscrypt Provider provides TLS 1.3 to apps supporting older Android devices
fdroid:com.mendhak.conscryptprovider.description:
Conscrypt Provider is an APK which can provide the Conscrypt Library to apps that support older Android devices.
The Conscrypt Library provides modern TLS capabilities and ciphers, including TLS 1.3, and supports all the way back to Android 2.3 Gingerbread!
I have wrapped it in a standalone APK because not all users will need it (Android 10+ has TLS 1.3 enabled), and because the library is quite large.
Users: will need to install this app. It does not appear in the app drawer as it has no interface.
App Developers: will need to add code to their apps to make use of this provider.
For instructions on how to do this, see the README: https://github.com/mendhak/Conscrypt-Provider
---
I have made use of the F-Droid blog post and an associated gist .
This may not be the best or perfect way to provide Conscrypt to applications, but it's a way that works for me. I'm putting it on F-Droid in case it benefits others too.

fdroid:com.monkopedia.healthdisconnect.name: Health Disconnect
fdroid:com.monkopedia.healthdisconnect.summary: View your Health Connect data in charts and widgets. Offline. Private. No ads.
fdroid:com.monkopedia.healthdisconnect.description:
Health Disconnect lets you explore your personal health data right on your device — no accounts, no internet, no data collection.
Connect to Android Health Connect and instantly visualize 35+ health metrics as interactive charts. Create custom views that combine multiple metrics, configure chart types, aggregation methods, and time windows, then pin them to your home screen as widgets.
YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
Health Disconnect never connects to the internet. It reads your Health Connect data, renders it locally, and never transmits anything. There are no accounts, no analytics, and no ads.
KEY FEATURES
• Browse 35+ Health Connect metrics — steps, heart rate, weight, sleep, blood pressure, nutrition, and more
• Interactive charts — line and bar charts with configurable aggregation (sum, average, min, max)
• Custom views — combine multiple metrics in a single chart and save for quick access
• Flexible time windows — view data by day, week, month, year, or all-time history
• Home screen widgets — pin any custom view as a resizable widget with configurable refresh intervals
• Export your data — save aggregated values or raw entries as CSV
• Share charts — export chart images in light or dark theme
• Advanced configuration — logarithmic and normalized Y-axes, data smoothing, bucket sizes, custom units, min/max labels
• Theme support — follows your system theme or choose light/dark manually
SUPPORTED HEALTH CONNECT DATA
Fitness & Activity: Steps, Distance, Speed, Exercise, Floors Climbed, Elevation Gained, Power, Wheelchair Pushes
Cardiovascular: Heart Rate, Resting Heart Rate, Heart Rate Variability, Blood Pressure, Oxygen Saturation, VO2 Max
Body: Weight, Height, Body Fat, Lean Body Mass, Bone Mass, Body Water Mass, Basal Metabolic Rate
Nutrition: Hydration, Nutrition, Active Calories Burned, Total Calories Burned
Other: Body Temperature, Basal Body Temperature, Respiratory Rate, Sleep, Menstruation, Cervical Mucus, Ovulation Test, Intermenstrual Bleeding, Sexual Activity
PRIVACY FIRST
Health Disconnect includes zero network permissions. Your health data is read from Health Connect, displayed on screen, and never leaves your device unless you explicitly choose to export or share.
One thing worth knowing: the app takes part in Android's standard backup, so if you have device backup switched on, your saved views — their names, chart settings, and which record types each one charts — are included in it. No health measurements are stored by the app or backed up; those stay in Health Connect. You can turn this off in your device's backup settings.

fdroid:com.secluso.mobile.name: Secluso
fdroid:com.secluso.mobile.summary: Private home security for Raspberry Pi and Secluso hardware
fdroid:com.secluso.mobile.description:
Secluso is a private home security camera system for Raspberry Pi and Secluso
hardware. Watch live video, get alerts, and view recordings from your phone
without giving a cloud provider access to your footage.
You can start today with your own Raspberry Pi and off-the-shelf parts.
Secluso is built around end-to-end encryption. The camera encrypts video before
it leaves your network, and the relay only transports encrypted data. You can
self-host the open-source relay on your own VPS, or use hosted relay
infrastructure without giving the relay access to your footage.
Secluso Deploy gives you a guided setup path for preparing your Raspberry Pi,
pairing it with the app, and setting up secure remote access.
Secluso also includes on-device AI for alerts such as motion, person, pet, and
vehicle detection.
What you get:
- end-to-end encrypted live view, alerts, and recordings
- on-device AI with motion, person, pet, and vehicle alerts
- support for DIY Raspberry Pi cameras
- self-hosted or hosted relay options without giving the relay access to your
 footage
- open-source software you can inspect and self-host
- reproducible releases you can verify
- guided image building, QR-based pairing, and relay provisioning for easier
 setup
The F-Droid Android build is a better fit for de-Googled devices and avoids
Firebase and Google Play Services for notifications.

fdroid:com.shatteredpixel.shatteredpixel.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
fdroid:com.shatteredpixel.shatteredpixel.summary: A roguelike dungeon crawler RPG that's simple to get into but hard to master!
fdroid:com.shatteredpixel.shatteredpixel.description:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike dungeon crawler RPG that's simple to get into but hard to master! Every game is a unique challenge, with six different heroes, randomized levels and enemies, and hundreds of items to collect and use. ShatteredPD is also updated with new content roughly every three months, so there's always something new.
 Choose Your Hero 
Each of ShatteredPD's six playable heroes has their own unique mechanics and gameplay style. Cut down foes as the durable Warrior or deadly Duelist, fry your enemies as the arcane Mage or divine Cleric, or use terrain to your advantage as the stealthy Rogue or the markswoman Huntress!
As you progress through the dungeon you'll earn points to spend on talents, choose a subclass, and gain powerful lategame abilities. You can turn the Duelist into a dual-wielding Champion, the Cleric into a righteous Paladin, the Huntress into a precise Sniper, or explore loads of other possibilities!
 Explore the Dungeon 
ShatteredPD's dungeon is procedurally generated with random layouts, room types, items, traps, and enemies. In each game you'll find equipment and collect or craft consumable items to power you up or help you out in a pinch. There is a huge variety to what you might see from run to run and region to region.
As you progress through the dungeon you'll find equipment that can be enchanted, upgraded, and augmented as you outfit your hero. Set foes ablaze with an enchanted weapon, wade through enemies with upgraded armor, or gain powerful damage, defensive, or utility benefits from one of the many magical wands, rings, artifacts, or trinkets.
 Succeed or Die Trying 
The Dungeon is filled with enemies, traps, hazards, and bosses intent on ending your run! Battle hostile wildlife in the sewers and caves, mad thieves and guards in the prison, occult servants in the fallen dwarven city, and maybe something even worse further down...
All these hazards can make the game quite tough, but don't be discouraged! You probably won't win on your first try, but there are many tricks and strategies to discover and learn on the path to getting your first win. Afterward, there are optional challenges and achivements if you want to put your skills to the test!
 Over A Decade in the Making 
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is an open source game based on the source code of Pixel Dungeon by Watabou (first released in late 2012). It started in 2014 as a project to rebalance Pixel Dungeon but has steadily grown into its own game over the last 10 years!
 Features Include: 
• 6 Heroes, each with 2 subclasses, 3 endgame abilities, and over 25 talents.
• Over 300 items including equipment, consumables, and items crafted via alchemy.
• 5 dungeon regions, 26 floors, over 100 room types, and trillions of possible floor layouts.
• Over 60 regular enemy types, 30 traps, and 10 bosses to test your skills.
• An in-game catalog to fill in, with just over 500 entries.
• 9 stackable challenges and over 100 achievements for completionists.
• Interface modes for large and small screens, and support for multiple input types.
• Updates roughly every 3 months with new content, fixes, and improvements.
• Support for many languages thanks to the game's dedicated communities.

fdroid:com.standardnotes.name: Standard Notes
fdroid:com.standardnotes.summary: An end-to-end encrypted note-taking app for digitalists and professionals
fdroid:com.standardnotes.description:
Standard Notes is a secure and private notes app. It syncs your notes securely across all your devices, including your Android devices, Windows, iOS, Linux, and Web.
Private means your notes are end-to-end encrypted, so only you can read your notes. Even we can't read the contents of your notes.
Simple means it does one job and does it well. Standard Notes is a safe and lasting place for your life's work. Our focus is making it easy to write notes wherever you are and syncing them with encryption to all your devices.
Our users love us for:
* Personal Notes
* Tasks & Todos
* Passwords & Keys
* Code & Technical Procedures
* Private Journal
* Meeting Notes
* Cross-platform Scratchpad
* Books, Recipes, & Movies
* Health & Fitness Log
Standard Notes comes free with:
* Seamless sync across all your devices, with easy to use applications on Android, Windows, Linux, iPhone, iPad, Mac, and web browsers.
* Offline access, so you can access your downloaded notes even without a connection.
* No limit on number of devices.
* No limit on number of notes.
* Passcode lock protection, along with fingerprint protection.
* A tagging system to organize your notes (like #work, #ideas, #passwords, #crypto).
* The ability to pin, lock, protect, and move notes to trash, which allows you to recover deleted notes until the trash is emptied.
Standard Notes is completely open-source, which means when we say your notes are encrypted with industry-leading XChaCha-20 encryption, and that only you can read your notes, you don't have to take our word for it. Our code is open to the world to audit.
We made Standard Notes simple because longevity is important to us. We want to make sure we're here, protecting your notes, for the next hundred years. You shouldn't have to find a new notes app every year.
To sustain our development, we offer an optional paid program called Standard Notes Extended. Extended gives you access to powerful tools including:
* Productivity editors (like Markdown, Code, Spreadsheets)
* Beautiful themes (like Midnight, Focus, Solarized Dark)
* Powerful cloud tools including daily backups of your encrypted data delivered to your email inbox every day, or backed up to your cloud provider (like Dropbox and Google Drive).
You can learn more about Extended at standardnotes.com/extended.
We're always happy to talk, whether it be a question, thought, or issue. Please feel free to email us any time at help@standardnotes.com. When you take the time to send us a message, we'll be sure to do the same.

fdroid:de.uwepost.android.deltacam.name: DeltaCamera
fdroid:de.uwepost.android.deltacam.summary: Record movement (deltas) in one single image
fdroid:de.uwepost.android.deltacam.description: DeltaCamera uses the camera to record movement (thus *Delta*) and visualize it in one picture. For example running ants leave dark lines on a light surface, or driving cars make light lines on a dark surface. Make sure not to move the camera during recording. You can share images with other apps, adjust sensitivity and switch between light-on-dark and dark-on-light mode. You can create some amazing pictures for example with light painting. This is NOT just a long time exposure! The app uses the first captured frame as "background" and then records differences (deltas), either negative (dark on light) or positive (light on dark) to add them up. See homepage for some examples.

fdroid:eus.ordunte.app.name: Ordunte: Karrantza weather
fdroid:eus.ordunte.app.summary: Weather at your location and four hyperlocal Karrantza/Ordunte sections
fdroid:eus.ordunte.app.description:
Ordunte is a native Android app for hyperlocal weather in the Karrantza / Ordunte valley (Carranza, Bizkaia). Motto: El tiempo del valle.
What it shows
• In Carranza: Weather, Field, Hunting and Beekeeping.
• Away from the valley: current, hourly and weekly forecasts, air quality when data is available, and rain radar for the current location.
• Measured AEMET warnings for the valley, with their own channel so they are not repeated.
• The hunting section is informational only. It is not a hunting permit and it does not replace any official licence.
• Home-screen widget and periodic sync, both exclusively for Carranza.
• Optional beach camera (La Salvé) resolved from a public stream page.
Location and privacy
• Only ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION is requested to centre the forecast and radar. The app does not request precise or background location, does not track continuously, and does not integrate Google location services.
• It accepts a last known location no more than 10 minutes old or performs a point-in-time update, without continuous tracking, under an original 12-second deadline. If the activity resumes before it expires, the listener may be registered again only for the remaining time; the deadline is not reset.
• An approximate 15 km geofence around Carranza selects the content: four sections inside and Weather only outside. Without permission or a position, the app uses Carranza and keeps all four sections.
• Coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for forecasts and air quality. When the radar is opened, the visible area is converted to tiles for RainViewer and OpenStreetMap.
• Coordinates are not stored in Room. The visitor snapshot exists only in process memory and disappears when the process closes. Room, periodic sync and the widget remain restricted to Carranza so visitor data cannot be labelled as valley data.
• The current version uses an approximate geofence and does not look up a locality name.
Where the data comes from
• Away from Carranza it uses Open-Meteo, Open-Meteo/Copernicus air quality when data is available, and RainViewer for radar. Local valley sources are hidden.
• In Carranza, forecasts, warnings, air and tides use Open-Meteo, AEMET and IHM directly. Those requests do not go through nomad.
• Hunting seasons, the valley Bresser station and the Cerroja ridge reading need nomad.debian.link. Without that service those sections stay empty or show a network error (F-Droid TetheredNet). The app does not invent a temperature to fill the gap.
No client token or Euskalmet key is baked into the package. A release build only needs the Android SDK path.

fdroid:fi.nikosavola.immichwear.name: Immich Wear
fdroid:fi.nikosavola.immichwear.summary: Browse your self-hosted Immich photos from your wrist
fdroid:fi.nikosavola.immichwear.description:
An unofficial Immich client for Wear OS. Browse your recent photos, albums, favorites, and "on this day" memories, favorite an asset, and glance at a random photo from a tile, all from your wrist. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Immich project.
Requires a self-hosted Immich server reachable from the watch, and an API key for it (Account settings > API Keys in the Immich web UI).
This build has no Google Play Services and no phone companion pairing feature - sign in by entering your Immich server URL and API key directly on the watch.
Your API key is encrypted at rest (AES/GCM via the Android Keystore) and never leaves the watch except in requests to the Immich server address you configured. Nothing is collected, logged, or sent anywhere by this app's developer.

fdroid:me.trion.whispertype.name: WhisperType Keyboard
fdroid:me.trion.whispertype.summary: Offline Android keyboard with QWERTY typing and on-device speech dictation
fdroid:me.trion.whispertype.description:
WhisperType is a full Android input method (IME) with a real QWERTY keyboard plus offline voice dictation.
Unlike dictation-only "keyboards" that only show a microphone button, WhisperType lets you type normally and use speech when you want.
Features:
- Full QWERTY layout with numbers, symbols, and a categorized emoji picker
- Shift / caps lock, sentence caps, double-space period, word-delete swipe
- On-device word suggestions and clipboard history
- Long-press accents and extra symbols
- Microphone key for offline on-device speech-to-text (25s warning, 30s auto-stop)
- Downloadable Whisper models: tiny.en, base.en (default), or small.en (int8)
- Import your own sherpa-onnx Whisper zip
- No API keys - audio, clipboard, and learned words stay on your device
- Free and open source (MIT)
Setup:
1. Install WhisperType
2. Enable it in system keyboard settings
3. Select it as the input method
4. Grant microphone permission
5. Download or import a speech model in settings
6. Type or tap the mic to dictate
On-device recognition uses sherpa-onnx (includes ONNX Runtime). Whisper models download on demand from Hugging Face when the user chooses Download; Import works offline.

Finer is a native music player for your Jellyfin server. Your own music library — on your iPhone, iPad, in the car and on your Mac — with no algorithm deciding what you hear. Free, no ads, no tracking.
LOCAL-FIRST, WORKS OFFLINE
• Local-first Mode keeps your library's details on your device, so albums, artists and playlists open instantly — and you can still browse and search everything with no connection
• Download songs, albums, playlists or all your favorites, in the original format or transcoded to save space
• Finer switches to Offline Mode on its own when your server can't be reached, and back again when it returns
SOUNDS RIGHT
• Gapless playback, always
• Lossless FLAC for streaming and downloads, including DSD files
• Album-aware volume normalization: quiet interludes stay quiet, while a shuffle of unrelated songs is evened out
• Synced lyrics, word by word where available, with in-app translation
MADE FOR YOUR IPHONE
• CarPlay, with shuffle buttons that work offline too
• Siri and Shortcuts: "shuffle my favorites in Finer", or play a playlist by name

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY

• Instant Mix from any song, album, playlist or artist
• Manage playlists and favorites; play history is reported to your server so it can scrobble to ListenBrainz or Last.fm
FOR SELF-HOSTERS
• Several servers and accounts, switched in a moment; credentials kept in the system keychain
• Sign in with a password or Quick Connect, and pick which music library to use
• Custom HTTP headers for servers behind a proxy
• Works over Tailscale, VPN or your home network — from a NAS such as Synology to a homelab

apple-macos:1287445660.name: Agenda - Notes meets Calendar
apple-macos:1287445660.description:
Most notes apps lose track of time. You write something, it disappears into a folder, and a week later you can't remember why you made that decision or what you prepared for that meeting.
Agenda fixes this. Every note lives on a timeline alongside your calendar. Prepare for next week's client meeting, capture decisions as they happen, and look back at exactly what led you here — all in one view.
"It's my favorite new app in years."
— John Gruber, daringfireball.net
"Every notes app should work like Agenda."
— Khoi Vinh, subtraction.com
"One of the most interesting note-taking apps I've used."
— John Voorhees, MacStories
YOUR NOTES, CONNECTED TO YOUR CALENDAR
Attach any note to a date or link it directly to a calendar event. Mark notes as "On the Agenda" to surface them in a dedicated overview — your shortlist of what matters right now.
A REAL TEXT EDITOR
Headings, lists, tables, checklists, indented blocks, and preformatted text — with the simplicity of plain text input. Focus on what you're writing; Agenda handles how it looks.
FILES, PHOTOS, AND LINKS
Attach files and images to any note. Everything syncs across your devices and can be previewed inline.
SMART NOTES
Ask questions about your notes using Ask Agenda. On the Mac, connect agents like Claude or Codex via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to automate the entire app.
PROJECTS AND CATEGORIES
Group notes into projects, group projects into categories. Drag to reorder, collapse to focus, or let the timeline do the organizing for you.
MAC, IPAD, AND IPHONE
Agenda syncs across all your devices via iCloud or Dropbox. Share individual notes for real-time collaboration — useful for team meetings or shared lists.
FREE TO USE, FOREVER
Agenda is free with no time limits. Premium features are available through a yearly subscription — and you keep every feature you unlock, even if you cancel. A one-time lifetime purchase is also available.

flathub:org.gnome.Tetravex.summary: Reorder tiles to fit a square
flathub:org.gnome.Tetravex.description:
Each square piece has a number on each side. Position the pieces on the left
 side of the board so that the same numbers are next to each other. If the
 numbers don’t match, you can’t put the piece there. Move quickly: you’re

flathub:org.raceintospace.Raceintospace.name: Race into Space
flathub:org.raceintospace.Raceintospace.summary: A game to relive the 1960s Space Race
flathub:org.raceintospace.Raceintospace.description:
Race Into Space is a simulation of the US-Soviet Space Race.
 In it, you take charge of your country’s space program as
 Director (US) or Designer (USSR). You will purchase and develop
 space hardware, recruit and manage astronauts/cosmonauts, and
 plan and send missions into space. The ultimate goal is to be
 the first to complete a Moon landing and return your people
 safely to Earth.
 Race Into Space (RIS) is a port to modern operating systems of
 Buzz Aldrin’s Race Into Space (BARIS), a DOS game originally released
 in 1993 on floppy disk, and a year later in an expanded CD version.
 BARIS was developed by Fritz Bronner based on his 1989 board game Liftoff!.
 Dr. Aldrin’s name and imagery have been dropped because permission to
 use them was limited to the old DOS game.
 RIS is available for Windows, Linux, and Mac, and includes some
 improvements over the original game—which we feel have justified
 a rewrite of the game manual. Those involved in RIS are volunteer
 enthusiasts, and we hope you enjoy this simulation.
 You might even find it educational.

flathub:top.akizip.akizip.name: Akizip
flathub:top.akizip.akizip.summary: A modern front-end for 7-Zip on GNOME
flathub:top.akizip.akizip.description:
Akizip is a graphical archive utility built with GTK 4 and libadwaita that brings the power of 7-Zip to the GNOME desktop.
 It supports creating and extracting archives in 7z, zip, and tar formats. It can also open (read-only) rar, gz, bz2, xz, tar.gz, tar.bz2, and tar.xz archives.
 Features include archive inspection, cancellable background jobs with progress reporting, a dedicated logs panel, and multilingual support.

fedora-packages:golang-github-hashicorp-.name: golang-github-hashicorp-memdb-devel
fedora-packages:golang-github-hashicorp-.summary: Golang in-memory database built on immutable radix trees
fedora-packages:golang-github-hashicorp-.description: The Memdb package implements a simple in-memory database built on immutable radix trees. The database provides Atomicity, Consistency and Isolation from ACID. Being that it is in-memory, it does not provide durability. The database is instantiated with a schema that specifies the tables and indices that exist and allows transactions to be executed. The database provides the following: – Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) - By leveraging immutable radix trees the database is able to support any number of concurrent readers without locking, and allows a writer to make progress. – Transaction Support - The database allows for rich transactions, in which multiple objects are inserted, updated or deleted. The transactions can span multiple tables, and are applied atomically. The database provides atomicity and isolation in ACID terminology, such that until commit the updates are not visible. – Rich Indexing - Tables can support any number of indexes, which can be simple like a single field index, or more advanced compound field indexes. Certain types like UUID can be efficiently compressed from strings into byte indexes for reduced storage requirements. – Watches - Callers can populate a watch set as part of a query, which can be used to detect when a modification has been made to the database which affects the query results. This lets callers easily watch for changes in the database in a very general way. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/hashicorp/go-memdb

firefox-addons:3094328.name: Video Downloader Legal
firefox-addons:3094328.summary: Save videos and audio from the page you watch — YouTube, Shorts, Instagram, Twitch, TikTok, VK, OKru, Bilibili, Dailymotion, RuTube, Dzen and more. Convert any video to GIF. Free, local, no paywall, no tracking and open source
firefox-addons:3094328.description:
Save videos and audio from the page you watch — YouTube, Shorts, Instagram, Twitch, TikTok, VK, OKru, Bilibili, Dailymotion, RuTube, Dzen and more. Convert any video to GIF. Free, local, no paywall, no tracking and open source 
VDL - Video Downloader Legal lists what the open page plays and saves the one you choose. Everything happens inside your browser: no external servers, no analytics, no helper programs to install. Video and audio are joined and TS is converted to MP4 by the extension's own code, without re-encoding.
FEATURES
- Video download — direct files, HLS (m3u8) and DASH (mpd) streams on any site: choose the quality, separate audio tracks are joined into one file.
- Video to GIF — short videos (up to 3 min) become an animated GIF right in the browser: width 640 / 480 / 320 / 240 px, 5–15 FPS, the rough size shown up front.
- Converter — pick a video or audio file on your computer and make a GIF (a "from–to" part, width, FPS) with an optional caption: a white bar, text on the video or a demotivator, with a live preview. Also MP3, a PNG frame, TS → MP4 / MKV and fragmented MP4 → MP4 without re-encoding. The file never leaves your browser.
- YouTube and YouTube Shorts — choose type (MP4, WEBM, AV1) and resolution; audio as MP3, M4A or WEBM; video and audio in one file.
- Live streams — record Twitch and other HLS live streams until you press Stop; YouTube live recording from the player (beta).
- TS to MP4 — streams in MPEG-TS are saved as ordinary MP4 by default (no re-encoding); MKV and TS too.
- TikTok — the video on screen is first, with its title and cover; the rest of the feed is under "More".
- Other sites — Vimeo, Dailymotion, RuTube, Dzen, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), Bilibili, Canva, OKru, VK and any other site through general stream detection (results depend on what the page provides).
- Audio download — MP3 (converted in the browser), M4A or WEBM.
- Light and dark theme — follows your system. 10 languages: English, Russian, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, French, Arabic, Portuguese, German, Japanese.
- Convenient — download history, file name template, notifications, hotkey Alt+Down, context-menu item, built-in help.
- Diagnostics — one button saves a local file (links masked) you can attach to a bug report; an optional debug log (off by default) records what the extension does. Nothing is ever sent automatically.
PRIVACY FIRST
No accounts, no telemetry, no servers of our own. Settings and history stay in your browser. The extension contacts only the sites you are already using.
AI DISCLOSURE
This project contains code generated by AI. 
All comments and translations are AI-generated.
GOOD TO KNOW
- After installing, allow access to all sites in about:addons → the extension → Permissions, otherwise the page scanner cannot see the media.
- Streaming sites change often; YouTube and social networks are supported on a best-effort basis and may stop working later. If something does not work, press the bug button in the window and send the diagnostics file.
- DRM-protected services (Netflix, Disney+ and similar) are not supported and never will be.

 More Yandex search extensions for Mozilla Firefox 
 Yandex Search Engine - Yandex search across the whole web, the @ya keyword.
 Yandex Images - Yandex image search, the @images keyword.
 Yandex Video - Yandex video search, the @video keyword.
 Yandex Maps - Yandex search for places and routes, the @maps keyword.
 Yandex Realty - Yandex real estate search: homes for sale and for rent, the @realty keyword.
 Yandex Finance - Yandex finance search: deposits, loans, exchange rates, the @finance keyword.
This extension is for shoppers: it helps you find and choose a product, not list your own.
 Why you might want it 
 Straight to products. A regular search mixes articles, reviews and ads. Here your query opens the Products section: offers from shops with photos and prices.
 Compare prices without ten tabs. One query shows what an item costs in different shops.
 No detour through the home page. You do not have to open Yandex and switch to the Products tab - the query goes there directly.
 What the extension does on desktop 
 Adds Yandex Shopping to the Firefox list of search engines.
 The @tovary keyword for a one-off search from the address bar: @tovary running shoes .
 A toolbar button: click it on any page, type a query, get products in a new tab.
 Yandex suggestions in the address bar as you type.
 On installation Firefox asks whether to make Yandex Shopping your default search engine. If you search for more than products, decline: the @tovary keyword and the toolbar button work either way. You can change the choice at any time in Firefox settings, section Search. 
 Yandex search for shopping in Firefox: how to add it and how to remove it 
 How to add Yandex Shopping to Mozilla Firefox. Install the extension - it adds Yandex Shopping (Яндекс Покупки) to your list of search engines. There is nothing to set up in Firefox by hand.
 How to search for products from the address bar. Type @tovary , a space and your query, for example @tovary running shoes . Or click the extension button on the toolbar.
 How to remove Yandex Shopping from Firefox. Remove the extension - the search engine disappears from the list, and nothing else in Firefox changes.
 On Android 
 Quick product search from the extension button in the menu.
 Step-by-step instructions for adding Yandex Shopping to your search engines by hand.
 Firefox for Android does not let extensions add search engines. On a phone you add it by hand, once - the extension shows you how and gives you the string to copy. 
 Privacy 
 The extension requests no permissions and does not collect your data. Your query and suggestions go only to Yandex, exactly as when you search on its site.
 A welcome page opens after installation and after an update. There is no other background activity.
 Partner links 
 The welcome page and the settings contain a labelled block, "Support the extension author", with partner links to Yandex services, including an offer with a bonus of up to 1100 ₽.
 Following them is optional and does not affect search. If you use one, the author receives a reward from Yandex at no cost to you.
 Also 
 Need regular Yandex search? There is a separate extension for that: Yandex Search Engine .
 Interface in Russian and English.
 This is an independent extension, not developed by Yandex.

firefox-addons:3005180.name: Intimate Shopping Extractor
firefox-addons:3005180.summary: Extract and save shopping items from 20+ European & global fashion sites.Extract shopping carts from 24 fashion sites (Zalando, Zara, ASOS, H&M, and more) and sync them — end-to-end encrypted — to your Intimate Shopping iOS app. Zero ads, zero analyt
firefox-addons:3005180.description:
The Firefox companion to Intimate Shopping — a privacy-first shopping wishlist app for iPhone.
Install this extension, pair it once with the iOS app (6-character code), and every cart you extract from a supported shop lands in your encrypted list.
SUPPORTED SHOPS (24 total):
Zalando, Zara, ASOS, H&M, SHEIN, About You, Mango, COS, & Other Stories, Uniqlo, Bershka, Pull&Bear, Massimo Dutti, Vinted, Depop, Amazon, Temu, Primark, Boohoo, PrettyLittleThing, NastyGal, Next, AliExpress, plus a generic fallback for JSON-LD / Open Graph product pages.
WHAT IT DOES
• Parses product name, brand, price, size, and image from each cart item.
• Encrypts every item on your computer with your per-user AES-256-GCM key (obtained from your iPhone during a one-time pairing handshake).
• Sends only ciphertext to the queue. Items are decrypted inside your iPhone app.
PRIVACY, DONE PROPERLY
• End-to-end encryption with AES-256-GCM. Your encryption key lives on your iPhone and syncs privately via iCloud Keychain. It never touches our servers.
• Pairing uses a 6-character code. Only its SHA-256 hash reaches the server — the raw code stays on your devices.
• Zero ads. Zero third-party analytics. Zero tracking SDKs. Zero selling your shopping data — ever.
• Full privacy policy: https://intimateshopping.app/privacy
BEFORE YOU INSTALL
You need the Intimate Shopping iOS app on your iPhone for pairing — it's a separate free download from the App Store / TestFlight. This extension on its own doesn't do anything useful.
SUPPORT
Email: mail@intimateshopping.app
Support docs: https://intimateshopping.app/support

bluejetty:00183926:ios.description:
Check your balance, deposit cheques, transfer money, and more!
The Kindred Mobile App gives you easy, secure access to your accounts anytime, anywhere. It's like having kindredcu.com in your pocket! 
Features
• Log in with your Access Card Number and your Password (PAC)
• For secure and quick access, set-up Fingerprint ID or Facial Recognition
• View your account activity, balances and recent transactions
• Pay bills now or set them up for a future date
• View and edit upcoming scheduled bills and transfers
• Send money instantly with Interac e-Transfer®
• Transfer money between your Kindred Credit Union accounts
• Quickly and securely deposit your cheques
• Search or use your current location to find nearby branches and ATMs
• Receive messages about your account
• Display your balances at-a-glance without having to log in with QuickView
Benefits
• It’s simple to use
• You can download it for free*
• It’s fully compatible with iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad
• You can access our app using your existing online banking login credentials
• You can use QuickView for quick access to your account information without having to log in
• Quick access options – Touch ID & 3D Touch
*You may incur service charges for various online services depending on the type of account you have. In addition, your mobile carrier may charge you for using your mobile device to access the services provided by our mobile app.
Security
Your security is our top priority, which is why our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full online banking.
Permissions
In order to use the Kindred Credit Union App, you'll need to grant our app permission to access certain functions on your mobile phone, including:
• Full network access – Allows our app to connect to the Internet.
• Approximate location – Find our nearest branch or 'ding-free' ATM by allowing our app to access your phone's GPS.
• Take pictures and videos – Deposit cheques using Deposit Anywhere™ right from your mobile phone by allowing our app access to your phone camera.
• Access to your phone contacts – Get the utmost in convenience by allowing our app to access your list of contacts, that way you can send an Interac e-Transfer® to someone on your contact list without manually setting them up as a recipient in mobile banking.
Access
Access is available to all members who currently use our online banking service. If you’re not a Kindred Credit Union member, no problem – simply visit kindredcu.com to set up a new membership and you’ll be set up with access right away. To login, you’ll need your Access Card Number and your Password (PAC).
Use of the mobile app is subject to the terms and conditions found in our Kindred Credit Union Direct Services Agreement.

Import your own .cube and HaldCLUT files or start from curated cine
bluejetty:00149199:ios.description:
Turn any clip into cinematic footage. PeekLUT brings pro color grading to iPhone and iPad — apply LUTs, fine-tune every frame, and export looks that rival DaVinci Resolve.
Import your own .cube and HaldCLUT files or start from curated cinematic presets, then push further with pro tools for color, contrast, tone, and texture. Every adjustment previews in real time. Every grade exports as a reusable LUT.
TURN YOUR VISION INTO REALITY
Professional results without the learning curve. Import industry-standard LUTs, apply film presets instantly, and keep creating without waiting on renders.
BUILT FOR CREATORS WHO WON'T SETTLE FOR FILTERS
Basic filters flatten your footage. PeekLUT preserves the quality and character of your original shot while enhancing what makes it special. Whether you're cutting Reels, TikToks, YouTube vlogs, or a short film, your look stays consistent across every export.
POWERFUL FEATURES THAT FEEL EFFORTLESS
LUT Workflow
- Import and apply .cube and 3D HaldCLUT LUTs
- Import from Files or Photos, or use bundled LUT packs
- Export your custom look as a reusable LUT preset for other apps
- DaVinci Resolve DCTL compatibility for technical colorists
- Built for creators using DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, and Adobe Premiere Pro
Cinematic Effects
- Chromatic Aberration: Simulate lens fringing with customizable color separation for a vintage or stylized look
- Lens Distortion: Add barrel or pincushion distortion to mimic real lens characteristics
- Technicolor 3-Strip: Recreate the iconic Technicolor 3-strip process for rich, saturated colors reminiscent of classic cinema
- Film Saturation: Fine-tune saturation with a film-like response curve for natural, pleasing color shifts
- Halation for vintage film glow
- Bloom to make highlights shine
- Film grain for authentic texture
- Linear, radial, and image masks for targeted adjustments
Precision Color Grading
- Separate controls for highlights, shadows, and midtones
- Tone Curves for detailed control over contrast, depth, and mood
- Selective masking tools for local color and light adjustments
- Color space transforms for sLog3, Rec.709, Arri Log C, BMPCC Log, V-Log, Apple Log, and more
Built for Speed and Pro Output
- Real-time preview of all adjustments
- Fast export with high image quality
- Batch editing for consistent looks across multiple clips
- ProRes export with custom bitrate controls
- Support for ProRes and ProResRAW workflows
- Full 10-bit and 8-bit color grading support
WHO IS PEEKLUT FOR?
- Content creators building a signature look across Reels and shorts
- Filmmakers who need professional color grading on the go
- Photography enthusiasts creating cohesive edits across photos and videos
- Social media creators producing cinematic content that stands out
- Colorists looking for a mobile companion to DaVinci Resolve
- Anyone who wants pro-grade results in a fast, intuitive app
Your footage deserves better than a one-tap filter. Download PeekLUT and start grading.

bluejetty:00141754:ios.name: Smart Noter - AI Note Taker
bluejetty:00141754:ios.summary: Smart Noter is an AI note-taking app for professionals and students. It records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings, lectures, and any conversation, turning hours of audio into structured, searchable notes you can act on. Trusted by over
bluejetty:00141754:ios.description:
Smart Noter is an AI note-taking app for professionals and students. It records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings, lectures, and any conversation, turning hours of audio into structured, searchable notes you can act on. Trusted by over 10 million users across 60+ languages.
KEY CAPABILITIES
AI Note-Taking: Smart Noter writes your notes for you. Every recording becomes organized notes with key points and clear headings, ready the moment you stop recording.
Recording and Transcription: Record any conversation and get an accurate transcript with automatic speaker identification, so you always know who said what.
Live Transcription: Every word appears on screen in real time as it is spoken, so you can follow and highlight key moments without writing anything down.
Live Translation: Follow any conversation in your own language. Smart Noter translates speech in real time across 60+ languages.
AI Summaries and Action Items: Each recording becomes a concise summary, with the action items and follow-ups pulled out automatically.
Chat with Your Notes: Ask questions about any recording and get instant answers, summaries, or decisions on demand.
Summarize Any Content: Import existing audio and video files or PDFs and get a full transcript and summary in one place.
Calendar Integration: Connect your calendar and get prepared notes for every scheduled meeting.
Works Offline: Record and capture notes anywhere, even without an internet connection.
Export and Share: Send your notes as PDF, DOCX, TXT, or SRT, or share them straight to Slack, Notion, and Google Docs.
FAQ
What is Smart Noter?
Smart Noter is an AI note-taking app that records and transcribes any conversation, then writes the notes for you. Instead of leaving you with raw audio, it identifies each speaker, summarizes the key points and action items, and lets you ask questions about what was said.
How does it work?
1. Record a meeting, lecture, or call, or import an audio or video file you already have.
2. Smart Noter transcribes the audio in real time and labels each speaker.
3. Turn on live translation to follow along in your own language.
4. Get a structured summary with the highlights and next steps.
5. Chat with your notes to find any detail, then export or share them wherever you work.
Who is Smart Noter for?
Smart Noter is built for professionals and students. Professionals use it to capture decisions and action items from client calls, standups, and board meetings. Students use it to turn lectures and seminars into clean transcripts and study notes. Researchers and interviewers use it for speaker-labeled transcripts they can search and quote. It fits anyone who needs to turn spoken conversations into organized, searchable notes.
Terms & Conditions: https://static.smartnoter.ai/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://static.smartnoter.ai/privacy.html

• Your phone must support eSIM and be carrier-unlocked.

bluejetty:00015739:ios.description:
200+ SQL queries with explanations, 120+ of them free. Tap Run and see the result table right in the app.
An everyday SQL cheat sheet, from your first SELECT to window functions.
• 39 sections, including filtering, sorting, calculated fields, functions, GROUP BY, window functions, subqueries, JOIN, UNION, INSERT and UPDATE, data types, tables, views.
• Changes by standard: 7 sections from SQL-92 to SQL:2023, with before-and-after queries.
• Keyword and function reference: over 180 articles. Browse, search, or tap a word in a query to open its article.
• Dialects compared: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, Firebird, Access. Where they differ, the dialect-specific variants are shown.
• Practice database: the classic MySQL “world” sample (countries, cities, spoken languages); its tables are described in the app.
• Run in the app: more than half of the queries execute against the practice database, and the result table appears directly below the query. Requires an internet connection.
• Search covers the queries themselves, not just titles: type a fragment you remember and find the query.
• Edit queries and rerun the runnable ones; one tap brings the original back.
• Add your own queries; they are saved in the app.
• Everything except running queries works offline. No account needed.
Queries are curated from professional sources and checked before release: the code works and is easy to follow.
FREE VERSION
• 12 runs and 12 edits a day
• Full keyword and function reference; tap a word in a query for up to 12 articles a day
• Up to 5 queries of your own
The full version unlocks every query, removes the limits on edits and on your own queries, and raises the daily run limit to 80. One-time purchase, no subscription.
Built by a developer for developers. The CodePro project has been in active development since 2015.

bluejetty:00148450:ios.description:
MOSHICAM – The Aesthetic Photo Editor for Fans and Creators
Moshicam is the all-in-one photo editing app for fans, creators, and anyone who loves making cute, aesthetic edits. Whether you want to decorate selfies, make K-Pop fan edits, design collages of your favorite idols, or create stylish photos to share with friends, Moshicam gives you everything you need. With thousands of artist-made frames, sticker packs, fonts, and tools, Moshicam makes it easy to transform photos into something unique.
 • 1,000+ Frames by Real Artists. Stand out with frames you won’t find anywhere else—from polaroid borders and photobooth strips to film frames and photo card templates. These are the same styles seen on Pinterest, Instagram, and Threads. With new drops every week, your edits stay fresh and on trend.
 • Hundreds of Artist Sticker Packs. Decorate your edits with stickers from top online artists: cute icons, sparkly decorations, doodles, and fan-favorite themes. Whether it’s a collage, a birthday edit for your bias, or a moodboard, our sticker library makes every photo personal.
 • Fonts, Filters, and Pens. Add text with custom fonts, write in unique pen styles, and apply filters that match your vibe. Moshicam makes it simple to design edits that feel stylish and one of a kind.
 • Built for Fans & Friends. Perfect for K-Pop fans, lifestyle creators, or anyone sharing on Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and more. Make polaroid edits of idols, collages of friends, or photobooth strips from a night out—Moshicam turns photos into creative moments to share everywhere.
 • Community & Artist Collabs. Follow your favorite artists, get notified when they drop new frames or stickers, and browse edits for inspiration. Anyone can submit frames and packs for others to use, and our community of fan editors and influencers is thriving.
 • Share Anywhere, Instantly. Post directly from Moshicam to Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Threads, or Red Note. Just create, save, and share.
 • Free vs Premium. Moshicam is free to download and comes with tons of frames, sticker packs, fonts, and filters. But if you want unlimited creative freedom, upgrade to Moshicam Plus. Plus unlocks even more exclusive frames, stickers, fonts, pen styles, and filters, with new content added weekly. Choose from flexible monthly or yearly plans and take your edits to the next level.
 • Trusted by Fans & Creators. Moshicam is already loved by top fan editors on Twitter, lifestyle influencers on Instagram, and creators across Threads. Our frames and stickers have been used in edits that reach millions of views, including by celebrities and K-Pop stars themselves. If you’ve seen trendy polaroid or photobooth edits on social media, they were probably made with Moshicam.
Why Moshicam?
• The largest artist-made frame & sticker collection.
• Designed for fans of K-Pop, music, movies, and more.
• Full toolkit: photo editor, collage maker, fonts, stickers, pens, filters.
• Built-in community where fans and artists share daily inspiration.
• Perfect for anyone making fun, aesthetic edits that stand out on social media.
Moshicam isn’t just another photo editor—it’s a creative tool built around fandom, aesthetics, and sharing memories. Download now and join the community redefining edits online.
Privacy & Terms
By using or subscribing to Moshicam, you agree to our Privacy Policy (https://moshi.cam/privacy) and Terms of Use (https://apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula)

bluejetty:00065746:ios.name: Wine Maps
bluejetty:00065746:ios.summary: Wine Maps provides a handy visual reference, for the wine regions in twenty countries around the world. Its a great tool for anyone looking to learn more about the world of wine, and even better for those looking for maps to study from. It'
bluejetty:00065746:ios.description:
Wine Maps provides a handy visual reference, for the wine regions in twenty countries around the world. Its a great tool for anyone looking to learn more about the world of wine, and even better for those looking for maps to study from. It's perfect for those teaching others about wine, and Wine Maps provides a number of ways of exporting or printing maps. 
Wine Maps focuses exclusively on mapping the wine regions of the world. It offers one hundred and twenty two maps, defining the wine regions. It is NOT an encyclopaedia of wine, and does not give any textual definitions or comment. Wine Maps is a purely visual reference, which allows you to search for the location of a wine region. With the exception of the top wineries in Bordeaux, individual vineyards do not appear on the maps. There's just too many of them!
Each map is one or two taps away from the main screen. Simply choose from the main wine region list, and you instantly have a map of that region. You can search for regions by name, and Wine Maps will neatly zoom into its location. The surrounding regions will be greyed out to highlight the selected region. Each map has the wine regions clearly presented, along with rivers, cities, and major towns. 
You can adjust the major components for map. for example to hide the labels for wine regions. You can hide the rivers, or the towns and cities. On each map, controls are provided to show, grey out, or hide individual wine regions. 
For commercial users, who would like to make more extensive use of the maps, an in-app purchase has been added. This provides a licence to distribute maps, via websites, videos, presentations, and more.
Wine Maps is also bundled with a companion app for your Apple TV. Allowing you to show off your wine knowledge, and TV simultaneously!
Feature Summary:
• Locate one of 1500+ wine regions in seconds
• 130 Maps covering 25 countries
• Accessible top down approach
• Maps can be printed, or exported as images 
• Test yourself, to help with learning the world's wine regions
• A licence for commercial distribution is available as in in-app purchase
• Maps can be altered. For example, to hide labels, rivers, or towns and cities.
• Individual wine regions can be hidden, or greyed out
• Works offline
• iPad, iPhone and Apple TV support
• Currently on its 28th update. Wine Maps is actively developed (now with a version for the Mac desktop). 
What regions are included?
- Overall World Map
- Overall Europe Map
- Central and Eastern Europe Map
Old World - 17 Countries, and 62 Regions: 
- Austria
- Bulgaria
- Croatia
- Czech Republic
- France
 (with fifteen main subregions, and further sub-subregions. Eleven from Bordeaux, six from Burgundy, and Bergerac),
- Georgia
- Germany
- Greece
- Hungary
- Italy 
 (with nineteen subregions)
- Moldova
- Portugal
- Romania
- Spain
 (with ten subregions)
- Slovenia
- Slovakia
- Switzerland
New World - 9 Countries, and 40 Regions: 
- Argentina
- Australia 
 (with four subregions)
- Brazil
- Canada
 (with subregion Ontario)
- Chile
- Mexico
- New Zealand
 (with two subregions)
- South Africa
 (with the subregion Western Cape)
- USA 
 (with subregions of seventeen states, and fifteen subregions of California)

If you have purchased the Commercial Licence in-app purchase. All images generated are issued under the "Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International Public License".

bluejetty:00177355:ios.name: Wild West: Hidden Object Games
bluejetty:00177355:ios.summary:
Try out the role of a detective in the world of Cyber Wild West!
You arrive at the mysterious town of Red Hook, where technology reigns supreme. However, there’s one problem, the town treasury was stolen and the old sheriff was kidnapped!
bluejetty:00177355:ios.description:
Try out the role of a detective in the world of Cyber Wild West!
You arrive at the mysterious town of Red Hook, where technology reigns supreme. However, there’s one problem, the town treasury was stolen and the old sheriff was kidnapped! 
Conduct an investigation like a real detective: collect clues, talk to witnesses, get tips from townspeople, and gather information about your next destination. You will never guess what lies around the bend, but you can be sure it’s going to be fun!The Cyber West is waiting. Search for hidden items to reveal story clues that unlock new locations. Unusual characters, a mysterious gang, a competitor in the investigation, and, of course, a femme fatale are waiting for you! Embark upon a journey to carve out your own legend in the world of the Cyber Wild West!
The game is TRULY FREE: the whole adventure is open to you without any additional purchases, so it's entirely up to you to buy optional tools.
Features of the game:
- Atmospheric cyberpunk western.
- Locations contain several sets of hidden items and clues. Re-play in an engaging way!
- Among the classic locations, you’ll encounter 360-degree panoramic ones
- Build a collection of rewards for successfully completing locations in a variety of modes!
We’ll be happy to stay in touch with you at www.facebook.com/CrispApp - feel free to leave comments, ask questions, and get news about upcoming games!

bluejetty:00121976:ios.description:
Sand in a Box: Magic Pixel Art turns your screen into a mesmerizing magical sand playground.
It’s a creative falling sand simulator, blending the charm of magic sand and the endless creativity of a sandbox. Watch particles flow, stack, and interact as you shape colorful landscapes and dynamic worlds.
Features:
• Engaging sand physics – watch sand and particles fall, pile up, and interact with walls, fluids, and other elements.
• Intuitive painting controls – simply touch and drag to paint with sand, water, oil, lava, and more.
• Diverse materials – build with over 36 unique materials, including brick, metal, sponge, acid, TNT, bacteria, and many more.
• Vibrant colors – mix and match sand and fluid colors to create dazzling art and landscapes.
• Fluids and reactions – experiment with water, oil, lava, and acid, and see how they blend and react.
• Dynamic elements – unleash the power of lava, bacteria, explosions, and more.
Version 4.0 brought back the original 2011 simulation engine, now faster, smoother, and more dynamic than ever.
Version 5.0 expanded your creativity: from 4 to 36 elements, unlocking infinite possibilities for your designs.
Whether you’re looking to relax, create pixel art, experiment with fluid dynamics, or simply enjoy the satisfying motion of falling sand and particles — this app is for you.

bluejetty:00071535:ios.description:
We all admire our police and their courage. They are the ones that protect us and make sure we have peaceful lives. Some of us even wanted to be in that uniform and fight the bad in our society, isn't? Well, it's a wish no more because you can now actually be a cop. Yes, you read that absolutely right and it's all possible with the latest 'Cops Driver Police Simulator'. This exciting Police driver game is all that you need to do what you always wanted to do (Yes, we know it's just a game but you get to be a cop).

Moreover, you can use coins to buy new stuff for yourself, doesn't it sound super exciting?

Drive as fast as you can, complete missions, chase robbers, collect coins, buy stuff and live a cop's life! 
Show the world your amazing skills and save your city. Make your department proud!
Feature
- A huge open world
- Realistic driving control 
- Realistic vehicles damage
- High-quality police vehicles and weapons
- Unlimited mission objectives, non-stop action!!
- Dynamic camera angles
- Realistic driving and first-person game play physics
- Stop and arrest all the gangsters

bluejetty:00092045:ios.description:
Your camera roll is full. You know you should clean it, but scrolling through thousands of photos feels impossible. Swipe makes it effortless.
Just swipe. Right to keep. Left to delete. That's it.
No complicated menus. No AI guessing what you want. Just you, your photos, and a satisfying card-stack interface that makes decluttering feel like a game.
——————————————————————
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a month or jump right in
2. Swipe through your photos and videos one by one
3. Review everything you marked for deletion before committing
4. Confirm and reclaim your storage
Nothing is permanent until you say so. Every decision can be undone instantly.
——————————————————————
WHY PEOPLE LOVE SWIPE
◆ Swipe-to-decide — Fluid card animations with haptic feedback make every decision satisfying
◆ Photos AND Videos — Clean your entire media library, not just photos
◆ Batch review — See all your decisions in one place before deleting anything
◆ Unlimited undo — Changed your mind? One tap to restore, even mid-session
◆ Smart preloading — Images load instantly. No waiting, no stuttering
◆ Full-screen preview — Tap to zoom in, pinch to explore every detail
◆ Share anywhere — Send photos and videos right from the curation screen
◆ Smart reminders — Get notified when your camera roll needs attention
◆ Progress tracking — See how much storage you're freeing in real time
——————————————————————
BUILT FOR TRUST
◇ 100% offline — Your photos never leave your device. Ever.
◇ Non-destructive — Deleted items go to Recently Deleted, recoverable for 30 days
◇ No account required — No sign-up, no cloud, no tracking
◇ No ads — Clean experience from day one
——————————————————————
PREMIUM
Unlock Swipe Premium to access advanced filters, custom album selection, and unlimited session history. One purchase, full power.
Works beautifully on iPhone and iPad.
Your camera roll deserves better. Start swiping.

bluejetty:00151941:ios.description:
Stock Analysis is the best all-in-one stocks app for regular investors. Use our free app to research stocks, funds and keep track of of your portfolio, all in one place.
We have global coverage, with over 130,000 stocks and funds that span all of the world’s countries, stock markets and exchanges.
Our data updates in real-time, including pre-market and after-hours quotes, with both basic charts and advanced technical analysis charts.
Install the Stock Analysis app now to get instant stock market insights. No account required.
=== Global coverage
We have comprehensive data on 130,000+ stocks and funds from every country and stock exchange in the world.
=== Real-time stock prices
Most of our stock prices update in real-time, including for pre-market and after-hours trading.
=== Watchlist & Portfolio Tracker
The watchlist and portfolio tracker has real-time stock prices and news. And you can create custom views with over 200 unique indicators to view all the data on your stocks in one place.
=== Stock Screener & ETF Screener
Our real-time stock screener has over 300 unique filters and indicators that you can use to find your next investment.
=== Accurate, enterprise-grade data
Our data is provided by S&P Global and other enterprise-grade data providers. Use the same quality data as professionals and institutions.
=== Charts
The app has both basic stock price and financial charts, as well as advanced charts with over 100 technical analysis studies.
=== More features
In addition to these, we offer:
• Detailed financial history.
• Detailed dividend histories and statistics.
• Analyst price targets, ratings and forecasts.
• Both light and dark mode support.
• Stock and ETF comparison tools.
• Market Movers: The top gainers and losers of each trading day.
• Today’s top trending stocks.
• IPO calendar, plus historical IPOs.
• Full stock price history.
• Corporate actions.
• Fundamental charts.
• ETF holdings.
• Stock price alerts.

bluejetty:00129337:ios.description:
Bringing all of your personal media together into one place has never been easier! Emby unites your personal videos, music, and photos and streams them to your devices.
Get the free Emby Media Server from the Emby website (required as part of your Emby install).
• Emby automatically converts your media on-the-fly to play on any device.
• Emby organizes your media into an elegant display with artwork, rich metadata and related content.
• Easily share your media with friends and family.
• Rich parental control and management features allow the Emby Server administrator to easily control access for your entire family.
• Stream your cloud-synced media (with installed cloud sync providers)
The app is free to browse your media collection, and free to cast media to other devices. Playback requires a small one-time in-app purchase, or an active Emby Premiere subscription, also available in-app.

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the renewal cost is $6.99 USD. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Check what is wrong with them and find out what helps best. They will instantly feel better and thank you as their vet! 
Features: 
> 8 Free Animals - Upgrade to Full Version with 40 animals 
> From pets to exciting exotic animals- help lots of different animals
> Funny animations and sounds 
> Easy to play (3+) 
Learning successes: 
> Hand-eye coordination 
> Patience and concentration 
> Logical thinking and creativity 
Tell others your experiences and leave a review at the App Store! 
ABOUT HAPPYTOUCH®: 
From the very beginning of the App Store we create Apps, that kids love and parents trust. 
HAPPYTOUCH® Apps are full of lovely characters and educational values. They are always adapted to the skills and needs of toddlers and preschoolers. Our Happy-Touch® Apps are designed and tested together with parents and kids. Just because of our HAPPYTOUCH®-Commitments all Apps promise moments of fun and learning successes for your individual child. 
Our HAPPYTOUCH®-Commitments: 
√ Free of ads and push-messages 
√ Childlock 
√ Clear Pricing 
√ Compliance with Rights of Privacy 
Experience the variety of our HAPPYTOUCH® Apps! 
Visit us!

Welcome to Kiokii, the ultimate hub for all things K-Beauty and J-Beauty. Whether you’re a skincare enthusiast, makeup lover, or exploring Asian beauty for the first time, we’ve got you covered with a curated selection of innovative, high-quality products designed to meet your unique needs.
At Kiokii, we bring you the best of the best, featuring cult-favorite brands like Anua, Mediheal, and Biodance, alongside rising stars like Medicube, SKIN1004, and Torriden. Our collection includes everything from hydrating serums and rejuvenating creams to pore-perfecting treatments and flash-friendly powders.
Why Choose Kiokii?
We’re more than a beauty store—we’re your partner in achieving radiant, healthy skin. Every product in our lineup is thoughtfully selected to meet the highest standards of efficacy, safety, and innovation.
The Magic of Asian Beauty!
Korean and Japanese beauty have revolutionized the global beauty scene with their emphasis on natural ingredients, cutting-edge formulations, and personalized routines. Whether you’re looking to boost hydration, reduce redness, or achieve a youthful glow, Kiokii is your gateway to these transformative products.
What Makes Us Special?
At Kiokii, we pride ourselves on offering exclusive brands, allowing you to shop bestsellers while discovering hidden gems that are hard to find elsewhere. Our diverse product range is designed to cater to all skin types—whether you have dry, oily, sensitive, or combination skin. Additionally, many of the brands we feature are committed to sustainability, with a focus on eco-friendly packaging and cruelty-free practices, so you can feel good about every purchase.
Shop with Ease.
Shopping at Kiokii is simple and enjoyable. Our app and website are designed to help you find what you need effortlessly. Plus, with exclusive discounts, reliable shipping, and exceptional customer support, we ensure your experience is seamless from start to finish.
Download the Kiokii app today and experience the beauty revolution for yourself. Glow brighter with Kiokii!

bluejetty:00069377:ios.name: Noise Generator: Full Spectrum
bluejetty:00069377:ios.summary: Generate custom color noises including brown, pink, white, blue, and violet. Customize noise further by using low and high cut filters. Simple modern interface remembers all settings for quick generation and utilizes advanced mathematical
bluejetty:00069377:ios.description:
Generate custom color noises including brown, pink, white, blue, and violet. Customize noise further by using low and high cut filters. Simple modern interface remembers all settings for quick generation and utilizes advanced mathematical formulas to generate all audio waves. There are no audio files included in the application binary which keeps app size to a minimum and app performance to a maximum.
What are benefits of listening to white noise?
- Helps you sleep by blocking distractions
- Pacifies fussy and crying babies
- Relaxes and reduces stress
- Increases focus while enhancing privacy
- Soothes headaches and migraines
- Masks tinnitus (ringing of the ears)
What are the different sound colors?
- White noise sounds similar to static of an analog TV or radio station that has stopped broadcasting. White noise has equal energy across all sound frequencies.
- Brown noise sounds like a powerful waterfall. It has more energy at the lower frequencies and if you have a good speaker system with a subwoofer you should be able to really feel it.
- Pink noise's upper sound frequencies don't fall off as fast as they do with brown noise, so you'll get a little more punch. The most interesting thing about pink noise is it's found in almost all electronic devices (known as flicker noise) and even in biological systems.
- Blue and violet noise are the opposites of pink and brown noise, respectively, and sound like spraying water from a garden hose. It has more energy at the higher frequencies which means more treble and less bass. 
- Curious to learn more about color noises? Check out this article for all the details: http://www.tmsoft.com/white-noise-player/
Directions:
Drag the Sound Color slider to select brown, pink, white, blue, violet, or somewhere in-between. Next, drag the low and high cut filters to further customize to your liking. Adjust device volume using the on-screen volume slider to a comfortable level. You can also specify to play audio to any AirPlay supported device. Toggle audio playback using the Play/Pause button.
Created by the audio experts at TMSOFT that brought you the famous White Noise app. Check out all our apps and sounds at http://www.tmsoft.com/

bluejetty:00027842:ios.description:
Discover fun and educational dinosaur games for kids designed to combine learning and play in one exciting experience. This dinosaur game helps children explore the prehistoric world while developing essential early skills in a safe and engaging way.
Kids can meet friendly dinosaurs and learn about the scientists who study them. Through interactive dinosaur games, children discover exciting jobs such as paleontologist, archaeologist, and expedition leader, and learn how dinosaurs lived millions of years ago.
These dinosaur games for kids include a variety of educational activities that support early childhood development. Children can solve colorful dinosaur puzzles, spot differences between pictures, and train their attention and observation skills. The game also helps kids practice counting and sorting items, recognize shapes and colors, and improve logical thinking through playful challenges.
Each mini-game is carefully designed to be intuitive and age-appropriate, making learning feel like a fun adventure. Bright visuals, simple controls, and friendly dinosaur characters keep kids engaged while encouraging curiosity and independent play.
This educational dinosaur game supports the development of memory, concentration, problem-solving skills, and creativity. It is perfect for preschoolers and young learners who love dinosaurs and enjoy interactive dinosaur games for kids.
Let your child play, learn, and explore the amazing world of dinosaurs through fun and educational gameplay!

Join your favorite businesses' Stamp Me loyalty program to collect stamps and earn free rewards. You deserve to be rewarded!

- Automatically triggers in-app vouchers to claim rewards in-person, or rewards are sent via email
- Don’t forget to join the Birthday Club for a special surprise on your birthday!
- Look out for special offers, spontaneous rewards and Scratch & Win games!
- Simple to use interface and concept
- Prevents a stack of paper cards in your wallet
- Contactless and more hygienic than paper cards
- No in-app purchases: you have full access to all features
- We’re completely ad-free (now and forever)!
Many more exciting features are added with every release. If you have any feedback or feature requests, please feel free to get in touch with us at support@stampme.com.
Happy stamping!

bluejetty:00082102:android.description:
The first MOBA esports game from Indonesia to your mobile
Lokapala: Saga of the Six Realms is a 5v5 Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) game focusing on skill and team strategy, developed by Anantarupa Studios, an Indonesian game developer. Lokapala is the first esports game from Indonesia which that inspired by regional cultures to introduce unsung historical and mythological heroes.
The story of Lokapala takes place in the end of the world, when the realms of the thirst, the molded, and the formless are merged into one. The realms are going under the oblivion, waiting for the fate no one can form or escape. The higher dominions of power are now awakened, but only one of them will be able to determine the fate of the realms in this endless fight of powers.

bluejetty:00167988:ios.name: PIX4Dcatch: 3D scanner
bluejetty:00167988:ios.summary:
Digitize Reality: Transform your mobile device into a powerful 3D scanner. 
Simply point and record to create professional-grade 3D models. 
Pair with a compatible RTK device for centimeter-level accuracy, precise measurements, and geoloca
bluejetty:00167988:ios.description:
Digitize Reality: Transform your mobile device into a powerful 3D scanner. 
Simply point and record to create professional-grade 3D models. 
Pair with a compatible RTK device for centimeter-level accuracy, precise measurements, and geolocated 3D reconstructions. 
Visualize the captured model in the app, upload and export, and view it in AR.
New ArcGIS Workflow: PIX4Dcatch now streams ArcGIS data in realtime in AR to provide in-field operators full contextual information about the entire site including 3D reconstructions and attributes. Our capture feature generates complete and defensible georeferenced 3D reconstructions which can be communicated seamlessly back to ArcGIS. 
New Guide-To Feature: PIX4Dcatch has a guide-to feature directing users to specified geolocated assets for staking, boosting onsite efficiency and accuracy. Just select the point or reconstruction you would like to find and follow the arrows in AR. 
WORKFLOW
1 – Scan & Capture
Walk around your site. The app automatically gathers data and provides live feedback using iOS LiDAR, ensuring you capture every detail. For enhanced accuracy, use an RTK device compatible with PIX4Dcatch, PIX4D Autotags with a fully automated workflow, or combine both.
2 – Process, Analyze & Share
Process your data by uploading to PIX4Dcloud for online analysis and sharing, or export to PIX4Dmatic for desktop processing. Both platforms offer a 14-day free trial. Projects can also be exported to third-party photogrammetry software.
Measure spaces, document results, and enjoy all the benefits of a detailed 2D/3D model of your surroundings.
3 – View in AR
Experience an immersive augmented-reality view. Display 3D models and points directly in your phone camera in AR.
____________________
USE CASES
• Digitize construction sites
• Measure stockpiles and other objects
• Document underground utilities
• Digitize indoor and outdoor spaces with Autotags
• Visualize and verify 3D models in AR in real time
• Perform single-point measurements with RTK accuracy
____________________
COMPATIBILITY
• Optimized for LiDAR-equipped devices (Pro series phones)
• All ARKit-enabled devices
• RTK devices: Emlid Reach RX and RX2, TopCon HiPer CR, Bad Elf Flex Mini, Bad Elf Flex, Trimble DA2, Leica Zeno FLX100 
____________________
TERMS OF USE
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00174340:ios.description:
ASTB PREP is a comprehensive study tool for the ASTB-E and OAR military aviation exams, created by a former Naval Officer.
Full Access is available as a one-time in-app purchase.
Whether you are preparing for Navy, Marine Corps, or Coast Guard aviation selection, ASTB PREP gives you the tools to study efficiently and build confidence before test day.
FREE FEATURES
• Create a free account
• Access introductory lessons covering exam overview, structure, and study strategies
• Track your study progress
• Sync your progress and access with your ASTB PREP account
FULL ACCESS
• 81 comprehensive lessons with review sections across all 7 ASTB subtests
• 140+ flashcard decks for rapid knowledge reinforcement
• 1,200+ sample test questions with detailed explanations
• Unlimited adaptive practice tests that target your weak areas
• Dichotic Listening Test (DLT) simulator
• UAV tracking simulator
• Terrain Identification simulator
• Rear Cockpit simulator
• Hardware-enhanced PBM training for a more realistic practice experience
• On iPhone and iPad, train with intuitive on-screen controls or compatible Bluetooth game controllers, including supported Xbox and PlayStation controllers
• Performance coaching tools
• All content is available offline after download, making ASTB PREP ideal for deployment, travel, and other low-connectivity environments
STUDY WITH YOUR ACCOUNT
Full Access is tied to your ASTB PREP account. Sign in with the same account to keep your access and study progress synced and available wherever your account is supported.
EXISTING CUSTOMERS
If you previously purchased ASTB PREP, your access is preserved. Simply sign in or create an account to link your Full Access.
ALL 7 ASTB SUBTESTS COVERED
• Math Skills Test (MST)
• Reading Comprehension Test (RCT)
• Mechanical Comprehension Test (MCT)
• Aviation and Nautical Information Test (ANIT)
• Naval Aviation Trait Facet Inventory (NATFI)
• Performance Based Measures (PBM): DLT, UAV, TI, RC
• Biographical Inventory with Response Validation (BI-RV)
Also covers all 3 OAR subtests: MST, RCT, and MCT.
Account required. Free to create.
Privacy policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/24362764

listings.description:
ASTB PREP is a comprehensive study tool for the ASTB-E and OAR military aviation exams, created by a former Naval Officer.

Full Access is available as a one-time in-app purchase.

Whether you are preparing for Navy, Marine Corps, or Coast Guard aviation selection, ASTB PREP gives you the tools to study efficiently and build confidence before test day.

FREE FEATURES
• Create a free account
• Access introductory lessons covering exam overview, structure, and study strategies
• Track your study progress
• Sync your progress and access with your ASTB PREP account

FULL ACCESS
• 81 comprehensive lessons with review sections across all 7 ASTB subtests
• 140+ flashcard decks for rapid knowledge reinforcement
• 1,200+ sample test questions with detailed explanations
• Unlimited adaptive practice tests that target your weak areas
• Dichotic Listening Test (DLT) simulator
• UAV tracking simulator
• Terrain Identification simulator
• Rear Cockpit simulator
• Hardware-enhanced PBM training for a more realistic practice experience
• On iPhone and iPad, train with intuitive on-screen controls or compatible Bluetooth game controllers, including supported Xbox and PlayStation controllers
• Performance coaching tools
• All content is available offline after download, making ASTB PREP ideal for deployment, travel, and other low-connectivity environments

STUDY WITH YOUR ACCOUNT
Full Access is tied to your ASTB PREP account. Sign in with the same account to keep your access and study progress synced and available wherever your account is supported.

EXISTING CUSTOMERS
If you previously purchased ASTB PREP, your access is preserved. Simply sign in or create an account to link your Full Access.

ALL 7 ASTB SUBTESTS COVERED
• Math Skills Test (MST)
• Reading Comprehension Test (RCT)
• Mechanical Comprehension Test (MCT)
• Aviation and Nautical Information Test (ANIT)
• Naval Aviation Trait Facet Inventory (NATFI)
• Performance Based Measures (PBM): DLT, UAV, TI, RC
• Biographical Inventory with Response Validation (BI-RV)

Also covers all 3 OAR subtests: MST, RCT, and MCT.

Account required. Free to create.

Privacy policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/24362764
