Hello New Friends,
Welcome to a DIFFERENT, very exciting, brand-new social media meeting place called XAPiT (pronounced “Zap-it”) .
XAPiT is that long-overdue alternate social community you’ve been asking for, where your content is highly respected. XAPiT is where everyone can still share their lives, their opinions, their hopes, and their dreams. And it’s still a place where you can catch up with your friends and family members, plus your clients and customers! This is a great place to build up and encourage one another.
On the surface you may not see it -- at least not at first…
So, you ask, "What’s so different about XAPiT?" Read this next part slowly and carefully:
XAPiT is also a place where your personal information is held in high esteem. We will NOT sell, share, or give away any of your private information to anyone. Period. You are in total control of who you choose to share your information with, including photos, videos, or any other personal or sensitive data.
And with XAPiT, all content, conservative and liberal, is welcome. Plus, rest easy that at XAPiT, the content you post won't be removed or banned just because of your unique political beliefs!
With these promises, you may be sold already. The many new features that will SOON BE COMING YOUR WAY will make you celebrate the moment you decided to use XAPIT, and that you told all your friends about it too!
So again, welcome to XAPiT.COM. Tell your friends. Tell your family. Tell EVERYONE. The world is going to love XAPiT!
XAPiT.com - We're Social Media Done "Right"!
Team XAPiT

bluejetty:00099114:ios.name: DeeVid - AI Video Generator
bluejetty:00099114:ios.summary: Deevid is an AI video and image creation app. You can start from a single photo, a piece of text, or an existing video to generate AI videos, create images, apply trending effects, or continue editing, adjusting backgrounds, and refining yo
bluejetty:00099114:ios.description:
Deevid is an AI video and image creation app. You can start from a single photo, a piece of text, or an existing video to generate AI videos, create images, apply trending effects, or continue editing, adjusting backgrounds, and refining your results. Deevid supports high-definition AI video creation, unlocking up to 1080p output to make your work perfect for short-video platforms, social media, and marketing scenarios.
Core Features:
• Image-to-Video: Upload a photo to bring static images to life. Supports HD generation, ideal for portraits, product photos, travel shots, avatars, and creative assets.
• Text-to-Video: Input your imagined scenes, camera movements, styles, or actions to generate AI videos. Adjust models, resolution, duration, and aspect ratios, with support for up to 1080p output.
• AI Image Generation & Editing: Generate images from text or upload reference images to continue creating. You can also use prompts and AI editing capabilities to modify image content.
• AI Background: Upload an image and use prompts to generate new backgrounds, lighting, and atmospheres—perfect for product shots, avatars, and social content.
• Trending AI Effects & Templates: Browse creative templates, select your images or footage, and quickly produce content tailored for short-video and social media platforms.
• Video Restyling & Editing: Upload a video and use prompts to add, replace, or remove elements, or completely redesign the video style, with HD output options supported.
• Motion Control: Generate dynamic content using character images and motion videos, making characters or personas follow specific movements.
• Continuous Optimization: After generating, you can re-generate, modify prompts, enter the editing workflow, or convert images into videos.
Deevid is perfect for short-video creators, social media users, e-commerce operators, marketing teams, and creative designers. Whether you want to make trending videos, product assets, social media graphics, or quickly validate a visual concept, Deevid helps you create faster. Once completed, works can be saved to your system album or shared via links. You can also unlock more creation credits, 1080p HD output, more model options, and premium benefits through credit packs and VIP subscriptions, subject to the in-app display. Start using Deevid today and turn your photos, ideas, and video assets into your next high-definition AI masterpiece.
Terms and Conditions
https://deevid.ai/terms
Privacy Policy
https://deevid.ai/privacy-policy
Contact us: contact-app@deevid.ai

bluejetty:00089080:ios.description:
▶Dark Throne◀
The heroes of the human world begin a great adventure to bring peace back to Izendar, the human land occupied by the Demon Realm.
Enjoy a variety of gameplay options, such as ever-growing demons, epic items, three different game modes, etc.
■ Authentic 'hack and slash' action role-playing game with
Battles with intense actions with thrill 
Exhilarating pleasure of sweeping enemies away at once with exquisite skill action!
■ Various missions and hidden traps with:
Captivating battles in the demon world imbued with intricate plots and missions to complet
New dungeons being changed with infinite combinations
Boss stages requiring unique strategies
■ Charming heroes with various characteristics 
Paladin, Assassin, Demon Hunter and more
A variety of weapons and armors, and action-skills
■ AAA quality game
Jeehyung Lee as Art Director, who is also the cover artist of renowned comic books
Dark Throne OST featuring K-Pop top producer Keeproots
Sound effects that maximize the immersion of the game
■ In-depth gameplay experience with
'Stress-free' game control with simple and easy operation
Meticulous UX designs
■ Details on Subscriptions 
1. Subscription Pricing & Billing 
Monthly: $4.99 
You can subscribe in the in-game store. 
2. Subscription Content 
Subscribers can enjoy the following privileges during the period: 
 - You can receive premium currency, Emerald, upon your first login every day.
 - You can use Totems in the game, which provide various effects. (Rare grade or higher)
 - You can receive Blessing Chest key, upon your first login every day. 
 - 8 more slots of inventory space are provided.
3. Auto Renewals 
The App Store Subscription feature renews automatically via your iTunes Account. Users can manage the subscription through your iTunes/Apple ID Settings Manager. The subscription will auto-renew for the assigned billing period if the auto-renew feature is not turned off 24 hours before the current subscription expires. 
4. User Agreement and Privacy Policy 
Terms of Use : https://static.epicleague.io/web/docs/terms-of-use.html
User Agreement : https://static.epicleague.io/web/docs/terms-of-subscription.html 
Privacy Policy : https://static.epicleague.io/web/docs/privacy-policy.html
5. Subscription Cancellation 
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’ and select the subscription for ‘Dark Throne’ to cancel it.

bluejetty:00146151:ios.description:
Control your Nerivio device and track your migraine headaches.
The Nerivio app controls the Nerivio device - a wireless remote electrical neuromodulation device for the acute and/or preventive treatment of migraine with or without aura in patients 12 years of age or older.
This prescribed device is self-applied to the upper-arm and should be used in the home environment at the onset of migraine headache or aura, or every other day for preventive treatment.
Track your headaches and migraine symptoms in an easy-to-use advanced migraine diary which is included in the app.
To provide you with optimal user experience for managing your migraine, the app may require access to HealthKit for sleep information.
For detailed information on the Nerivio device, please refer to https://nerivio.com/
Nerivio(R) is a prescription device. Use the Nerivio device and this app only if you have a valid prescription and after consulting with your health care professional.

bluejetty:00016350:ios.name: Equalizer
bluejetty:00016350:ios.summary:
"... the sound quality blew us away."- Gearburn.com
Music player with the most powerful and acurate equalizer in the app store as well as the most advanced playlist controls.
+ Play music directly from your Music Library including podcasts
bluejetty:00016350:ios.description:
"... the sound quality blew us away."- Gearburn.com
Music player with the most powerful and acurate equalizer in the app store as well as the most advanced playlist controls.
+ Play music directly from your Music Library including podcasts and music video (audio only)
+ Adjust the powerful parametric equalizer by moving the seven control points or type in the values directly.
+ Adjust the EQ curve for your left and right ear separately (now extends from -30 to + 30 dB. Use the StereoEQ setting for that)
+ Select from over 10 presets or save your own. You can even share them via email and import presets from other people via email.
+ Full background support including remote control (from docks, headsets, car stereos)
+ Visualize the music with the spectrum analyzer.
+ Use AirPlay to listen on your AppleTV, or your Bluetooth headsets and even a dock. 
+ Use the pre-amp slider to adjust the overall boost or cut. Make sure to turn the slider down if you experience distortion. Use the auto-normalizer function to prevent clipping automatically and have the best dynamic range possible with your eq curve. (on/off in settings)
+ Curve screen: curve redraws as controllers are dragged. Pinch to modify Q. Three stage clipping signal on preamp slider. Keyboard entry for pre-amp. Twitter/Facebook/Weibo integration to share your current EQ curve. Bypass.
+ Crossfade between songs. Make sure to stop the music before changing the crossfade time slider.
+ Now playing screen includes repeat (all, single no repeat) button and shuffles like the music app. Improved stability of on the fly modifications of the playlist. Add more songs to the playlist at any time. Sort playlist alphabetically.
+ Music selection is very similar to default music app.
+ Turn landscape to display the frequency analyzer. 
+ Built in sleep timer to stop Equalizer after a certain period if time. 
+ Crossfeed option to blend audio between channels
+ Apple Watch support for eq curve selection incl. complications
KNOWN ISSUES:
No known issues. please contact support if you have any problems.
COPY-PROTECTED MUSIC:
Equalizer will not play copy-protected (DRM). You need to convert DRM songs. Apple Music Streaming uses copy-protected songs.
iCLOUD:
Only the Apple Music app can manage songs in iCloud (iTunes Match). You will need to make sure the songs are downloaded to your device to listen and enhance them via Equalizer. If you want to stream and eq your music, you can try our other app: CloudEQ. It allows you to stream and eq music from SoundCloud and your Dropbox account without the need for storage on your device.
From the reviews:
EXCELLENT PROGRAM
I connect my iphone 4 to a car audio system, with the application the music began to sound incomparably better ....
A little clear interface, but to understand it and understand need no more than 5-10 minutes. -- P_S_B_
***
LOVE IT
This is the EQ I have been looking for, and because of bad ratings I almost passed on it! I consider myself an aspiring audiophile and have the equipment -- Klipsch, Sunfire, Nottingham, Denon, Paradigim, etc. -- (and debt) to back it up. This EQ performs flawlessly and is very easy to use. It enhanced my music dramatically. Yes, dramatically! Just make sure you are running the recommended IOS, as the developer suggests. -- J. Paul DiMaggio
***
PLEASE if you have concerns or encounter problems with the app: post on http://www.audioforge.ca and we will explain how things work, until you can use all the features of the app to the fullest. Thank you

Features of this Call break game:
* Simple Gam
bluejetty:00166559:ios.description:
Callbreak (Call Break) is an offline free card game that is popular in Nepal, India and other Asian countries. 4 players and 5 rounds of game makes this a perfect time for different occasions.
Features of this Call break game:
* Simple Game Design
* Drag (Swipe) or Tap (click) to play card
* Improved AI (Bot)
* Completely Free
* No active internet connection required( Completely offline)
* Great Timepass
* Smooth gameplay
GamePlay:
Callbreak is simple to play . 52 cards are randomly dealt among 4 players. Based on their card and tactics, they choose to bid between 1 to 8. Players throw card according to rule and the player with the highest card wins the hand. They need to win the hand equal to their bid amount. If not, they will have negative scores. This goes for 5 rounds and the player with hightest win wins the game. 
Call break is the king of the card game and and more popular than other card games such as marriage or rummy. 
Enjoy callbreak game and also don't forget to share this call break game with your friends, families.
If you have any feedback, suggestions, questions for this game please do let us know.

 * Lakadi or Lakdi in India

bluejetty:00063856:ios.description:
Hemen Passo’yu indir, tek tıkla üye ol ve aradığın konser biletini al, maç heyecanını yaşa, alışveriş yap, yemek siparişi ver, sanal kart kullan, çekilişlere katıl!
Maç biletlerinden tiyatroya, konserlerden festivallere; elektronik ve spor ürün alışverişlerinden yemek siparişine, sanal karttan Passolig başvurusuna kadar ihtiyacın olan her şey yenilenen Passo mobil uygulamasında seni bekliyor. Passo; sanat tutkunları, futbolseverler, alışveriş meraklıları, teknoloji takipçileri ve avantaj arayan kullanıcılar için hepsi bir arada dijital yaşam asistanı oldu!
Uygulama üzerinden Passolig kart başvurusu yapabilir, derbi biletlerine anında ulaşabilirsin. Tiyatro ve stand-up gösterileri için yerini ayırtabilirMüze giriş bileti gibi kültürel etkinliklere birkaç dokunuşla ulaşabilirsin. Passo, e-bilet süresi uzatma, takım değiştirme, QR kodla stadyum ve konser alanlarına giriş gibi özelliklerle etkinlik deneyimini kolaylaştırır.
Etkinlik dışında da Passo ile alışveriş artık mobilde. Passo Dükkan’da lisanslı ürünlerin yanı sıra teknolojik cihazlardan giyime kadar birçok ürünü uygun fiyatlarla satın alabilirsin. Passo Kart ile güvenli ödeme yapabilir, N Kolay kredi ve nakit avans kampanyalarıyla indirimlerden yararlanabilirsin.
Yemek kategorisinde maç menüleri , Ekonomix Menü, Arby’s menü, Burger menüsü gibi ürünlerle etkinlik öncesi hızlı ve uygun fiyatlı yemek siparişi verebilirsin. 
Finansal işlemlerinde de Passo yanında!Sanal kart oluşturabilir, dijital banka kartı ile mobil alışveriş yapabilir, alışveriş kredisi ile ihtiyacına uygun ürünleri satın alabilir, tüm harcamalarını kontrol altında tutabilirsin.
Passo Şans kategorisinde çekilişlerle dilediğin araca sahip olma şansı yakalayabilirsin. . Biletlerini dijital olarak saklayabilir, arkadaşına gönderebilir, iptal ya da satış işlemlerini kolayca gerçekleştirebilirsin.
Kişiselleştirilmiş bildirimlerle ilgilendiğin maçları, konserleri, tiyatroları ya da kampanyaları kaçırmazsın. Hemen Passo’yu indir, üye ol, Passo kampanyalarını takip et ve dijital deneyimin keyfini çıkar. Passo her zaman seninle!

bluejetty:00118955:ios.description:
Underground Service Alert of Southern California (USA/SC) aka DigAlert was formed on September 13, 1976 in response to a deadly accident that had taken place in Culver City three months earlier. A petroleum pipeline was accidentally breached by a construction crew working on Venice Blvd and the resulting explosion took the lives of nine people. Additionally, an entire city block was burned to the ground and millions of dollars in damages were caused by this incident. The spark that ignited this deadly inferno quickly became the impetus behind a movement to prevent these tragic accidents. USA/SC is the result of that effort and has been serving this part of California ever since.
Keep yourself up to date with our latest advancements in technologies by downloading the DigAlert app with tons of useful tools for homeowners and contractors such as:
- Web Update of tickets
- View expiring tickets
- DigAlert Express
- Newtin ETA
- Access Emergency / Vacuum Contacts
Remember, find out FIRST, contact 811 before you dig. It's the law.

bluejetty:00063824:ios.name: Okey!
bluejetty:00063824:ios.summary:
The Turkish game classic "Okey" in its best form on mobile devices.
Okey is a traditional tile-based board game with long history and many variations. It's highly popular in Turkey, played mainly in coffee houses by people in every age. It
bluejetty:00063824:ios.description:
The Turkish game classic "Okey" in its best form on mobile devices.
Okey is a traditional tile-based board game with long history and many variations. It's highly popular in Turkey, played mainly in coffee houses by people in every age. It's very similar to Rummikub as it is played with the same set of boards and tiles but with different rules.
Realistic feeling, simple interface and exciting gameplay!
Game is played by four players with a set of 106 tiles and 104 of them are numbered from 1 to 13 with four different colors. During the game each player has 14 tiles on his board. On each turn a player draws one tile and discards one tile. The object of the game is to be first to form a board which consists sets and runs using all 14 tiles. There are special tiles chosen in every game, called jokers which helps the player form his 14 tiles board of sets and runs, by replacing the tile which is missing. Two last tiles from 106-tile-set represented with stars are tricky 'false jokers', which against expectations acts as normal numbered tile.
Features:
● Advanced Artificial Intelligence
● Full HD graphics (perfect for high resolution tablets)
● Multitouch support
● Unlimited hours of joy
● Multiple game modes
● High playability
● High quality animations
● Turkish trophies to win
● Many table images to choose from
In Okey, when you attempt to win a game by discarding a tile to the center of table (bank), if there are any mistakes with your groups, these groups will be highlighted with red color.
You can tap and hold a tile in the same place for 3 seconds to flip it. This is generally used as a reminder of joker tiles in Okey game.
For online version please try our new game "Okey Pro" !
--------------------------------
Okey
Türk insanının en çok sevdiği okey oyununun teknolojiyle en güzel birleşimi. Evde, yolda, bayırda, çayırda istediğiniz zaman oynayın.
Bu Okey oyunu online değildir. Bu Okey oyununda gelişmiş yapay zekaya karşı oynuyorsunuz.
Özellikler:
● Gelişmiş yapay zeka
● Full HD grafikler
● Multitouch desteği (tabletler için mükemmel)
● Mükemmel oynama kolaylığı
● Sayıdan düşmeli oyun modu
● Yüksek kalite animasyonlar
● Oyun içi kazanılabilinen bir cok öğe
● Bir çok masa resmi seçeneği
Online versiyon için lütfen "Okey Pro" adlı oyunumuzu deneyin !
Desteğiniz için çok teşekkür ediyoruz !

bluejetty:00016520:ios.description:
GET TO THE CHOPPAAAAAA! 
Unleash the fury of the skies in HELI HELL – the ultimate bullet hell shmup that will test your mettle and your trigger finger! Dive into a relentless arcade experience where the sky is your battlefield and danger comes from every angle. Customize your chopper, unlock devastating weapons, and show no mercy as you blast through enemy lines. Whether you're a seasoned shmup veteran or a newcomer to the arcade shooter genre, HELI HELL offers an adrenaline-pumping, sky-dominating adventure that's not for the faint of heart.
Join the aerial assault, embrace the bullet hell, and become the ultimate sky warrior in HELI HELL – where victory is only a shot away!

bluejetty:00090433:ios.description:
Every morning, a new verse. A new devotion written just for it. A new image worth pausing on.
Bible Thoughts Daily is a free daily devotional and a complete Bible reference in one app. Each day we hand-pick a verse from the Old or New Testament, pair it with an original reflection written by our own Logan R. Harris, and set it against beautiful high-resolution imagery.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED FOR DAILY INSPIRATION
- The entire Bible, with six translations included:
 World English Bible
 King James Version
 American Standard Version
 Young's Literal Translation
 Reina Valera
 Biblia Sacra Vulgata
- Daily verses, hand-picked from the Old and New Testament.
- Daily devotionals that expand on each verse, written by Logan R. Harris.
- A practically infinite library of high-resolution imagery to brighten your day.
- Write your own notes on any curated verse, any devotion, or any verse in the Bible.
- Favorite verses and devotions to revisit them later.
- Daily reminders to help you build the routine.
- Bookmark any verse so you can jump straight back to where you left off.
- Share a verse, a devotion, or your own thoughts with family and friends.
- Dark mode for comfortable night-time reading.
+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-
Every verse and devotion is chosen and written by Logan R. Harris, who works hard to bring you his own thoughts on Scripture. Nothing here is recycled commentary.
Whether you have two minutes or twenty, Bible Thoughts Daily meets you where you are: a verse to carry with you, a thought to sit with, and the whole of Scripture whenever you want to go deeper.

Bible Thoughts Daily is a free daily devotional and a complete Bible reference in one app. Each day we hand-pick a verse from the Old or New Testament, pair it with an original reflection written by our own Logan R. Harris, and set it against beautiful high-resolution imagery.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED FOR DAILY INSPIRATION

- The entire Bible, with six translations included:
     World English Bible
     King James Version
     American Standard Version
     Young's Literal Translation
     Reina Valera
     Biblia Sacra Vulgata

- Daily verses, hand-picked from the Old and New Testament.
- Daily devotionals that expand on each verse, written by Logan R. Harris.
- A practically infinite library of high-resolution imagery to brighten your day.
- Write your own notes on any curated verse, any devotion, or any verse in the Bible.
- Favorite verses and devotions to revisit them later.
- Daily reminders to help you build the routine.
- Bookmark any verse so you can jump straight back to where you left off.
- Share a verse, a devotion, or your own thoughts with family and friends.
- Dark mode for comfortable night-time reading.

+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-

Every verse and devotion is chosen and written by Logan R. Harris, who works hard to bring you his own thoughts on Scripture. Nothing here is recycled commentary.

Whether you have two minutes or twenty, Bible Thoughts Daily meets you where you are: a verse to carry with you, a thought to sit with, and the whole of Scripture whenever you want to go deeper.

+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-

Made in the USA by Fort Apps LLC.

+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-

bluejetty:00146636:ios.name: Wellspent: Replace Scrolling
bluejetty:00146636:ios.summary:
Do you really want to be scrolling right now? 
We all know the feeling. You pick up your phone to kill a few minutes and before you know it, an hour has gone by. Wellspent is here to solve the great mystery of "where did that hour just go"
bluejetty:00146636:ios.description:
Do you really want to be scrolling right now? 
We all know the feeling. You pick up your phone to kill a few minutes and before you know it, an hour has gone by. Wellspent is here to solve the great mystery of "where did that hour just go" because we want it back, too.
Wellspent is designed to help you find a healthy balance between productivity and play. Paired with your input, our tool creates the recipe for supporting you best and we inject your phone time with science-backed methods designed to actually help you break the cycle of scroll addiction. It’s the future of screen time self-control. 
THE ADDED BENEFITS OF WELLSPENT:
- Stop wasting time on your phone
- Stay focused at work
- Boost your productivity all day long
- Stay in control without needing digital detoxes
- Manage ADHD with this tool
- Redirect your attention to how you want to spend it
- Get better sleep without getting lost in the scroll before bed
- Be more mindful and aware of how you invest your time and attention
HERE’S HOW IT WORKS:
- Set your budgets for problem apps so we know when to give you a full-screen check-ins
- Get short and sweet full-screen check-ins that get you to stop scrolling
- Language matters: decide which tone you want Wellspent to use when checking in with you. Get roasted, hyped, and more!
- Stay productive, in control, and away from time-sinks
WHAT USERS ARE SAYING
“Wellspent supports me with tracking and understanding my screen time patterns. This increased awareness prevents me from getting lost scrolling.” - Franz
“When my ADHD brain finds a TikTok rabbit hole, I used to completely lose track of time. With Wellspent, I’ve learned to control my social media usage again.” - Jeannine
“I used to have a love-hate-relationship with social media. It’s really addictive but also way too useful to avoid. I’m glad to have Wellspent. It helps me to use my phone in a meaningful way.” - Karolina
FEATURES:
- Powerful, Full-Screen Check-Ins: You’re not alone out there in the wild west. Wellspent is right there with you. Our science-backed methods paired with your customization helps improve your screen time goals by intervening just when you need it. 
- Progress Score: Stay true to your commitments and understand how healthy your phone use is day-to-day. 
- Set Budgets: Not all apps are the same. Create time budgets for the categories, websites, and apps you struggle with most. You can be stricter with big problem apps like TikTok, Instagram, or LinkedIn or a little more lenient with apps like Netflix or YouTube - it’s up to you!
- Choose your hero: What kind of vibe are you going for? Do you want to be roasted by a firm hand? Or maybe you’re looking for something more warm and friendly. You get to choose which tone of voice the reminders will take to motivate you. 
- Skill-Building Exercises: Our team of psychologists knows exactly how to help you kick your scrolling habits in a way that sticks.
Wellspent can be tested free of charge. In addition, we offer flexible subscription models that can be cancelled at any time.
The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current term. Your iTunes account will be charged for the next term within 24 hours before the current subscription expires. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time through iTunes Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription. For more information, see our Terms & Conditions (https://www.wellspent.so/terms-and-conditions) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.wellspent.so/privacy-policy).
Do you have feedback? Feel free to write us at support@wellspent.so.

bluejetty:00069204:ios.description:
Have you played parking games? Surely you are familiar with racing games but have not heard of parking games then try our Car Parking 3D - Driving Game now. Make sure this is an addictive game with extremely challenging levels in this super modern 3D parking game.
You will be overwhelmed by the world's most modern supercars gathered in the Game. You can test drive in front of high-class supercars. You can improve your driving skills by enjoying the best parking game.
Unique parking game for you challenging experiences. Try to be the best Parker in this challenging car game. Let's start your parking mission and show off your driving and parking skills ..
Your mission is to drive through the city to park the car exactly at the right time to complete the mission. If you collide or break any obstacle you will be late to park. You will fail in your quest. Swing through levels like a real Parker and get three stars in each mission to unlock the next level and enjoy lots of parking stages. There are lots of driving quests and driving tests in parking games waiting for you.
HOW TO PLAY:
+ Press the Play button to start the game
+ Use the right buttons to accelerate the car and stop
+ Press the steering wheel or Left / Right button to Drive
+ Avoid crashing into any obstacles
+ Use the camera button to change camera view
+ See ads to get money boost. Collect more money to exchange more advanced cars as you like, buy extra parts for the car
FEATURE:
+ Ultimate HD graphics
+ Very friendly controls
+ Improve your driving and parking skills
+ Multiple camera angles
+ Play completely free
Download the game now to ensure you will be addicted. Let's become a good packer now

bluejetty:00169464:ios.description:
Keep 9.1 全新升级，越练，越懂，越健康！
在 Keep，与 4 亿运动爱好者共同见证专业与科技的完美融合。Keep 9.1 继续围绕 AI 运动教练体验进化：从训练安排、健身记录、跑步陪伴，到吃练睡数据解析与身体状态洞察，让每一次运动都更清晰、更有反馈。
基于 Keep 运动健康大模型 Keepace.ai，AI 教练更懂你的训练节奏与身体变化。无论你是在家跟练、户外跑步，还是在健身房进行力量训练，Keep 都将陪你更科学地运动，也更深入地了解自己。
你是否也曾遇到这些困扰：
- 想在家运动，空有热情但无从下手？
- 想跟练课程，却无法根据自己的需求做出选择？
- 在健身房训练时，器械、组数、重量、次数总是不好记录？
- 跑步计划难以坚持，希望有人在过程中提醒、反馈和陪伴？
- 吃、练、睡数据散落各处，看不懂背后的身体变化？
- 想了解自己的身体状态，却缺少一个更直观的参考？
- 想控制饮食，却不清楚每顿饭的热量缺口到底是多少？
Keep 解决方案：
【海量课程，随心开练】 
万节专业精品课程持续开放，覆盖减脂、增肌、塑形、拉伸等多种训练目标。无论你是运动新手，还是长期训练者，都能快速找到适合自己的课程，随时随地，想练就练。
【专业工具，一应俱全】
 训练评估、运动记录、计划管理等工具体验更完整。健身记录工具支持记录健身房训练，让力量训练过程更清晰，进步更可见。
【AI 语音互动跑，边陪伴边指导】 
跑步不再只是记录轨迹。AI 会在跑步过程中给你反馈、提醒和鼓励，陪你关注节奏、状态和目标，让每一次开跑都更有陪伴感。
【AI 教练管理日程，训练安排更省心】 
AI 教练“卡卡”可以结合你的目标与运动节奏，帮助安排训练日程。今天练什么、怎么练、练到什么程度，都能获得更清楚的建议。
【AI 深度数据解析，读懂吃练睡变化】 
围绕饮食、训练、睡眠进行更全面的数据解读，把分散的数据转化为更直观的身体洞察。你可以更清楚地看到状态变化，也更容易找到适合自己的调整方向。
【身体年龄，了解真实状态】 
从体能和运动表现出发，帮助你了解自己的身体状态。相比单次运动数据，身体年龄能提供更直观的参考，让训练目标更清晰。
【拍照智能识别，掌控热量缺口】 
吃练结合，事半功倍。只需拍张照片，卡卡即可识别食物热量。0 成本记录摄入与消耗数据，帮你全方位掌控目标管理，让每一顿饭都吃得明明白白。
在 Keep，你还可以获得：
【更多品类运动课程】
直播课、跟练课、增肌、减脂、力量训练，专业教练带你科学健身；
跑步、跳绳、冥想、瑜伽课程，助你减压、缓解疲劳；
HIIT、Tabata 有氧燃脂，带你减脂、燃烧你的卡路里！
更有女性专属生理期、产后恢复训练，遇见更美的自己；
【多样的达人课程内容】
汇聚众多运动达人，课程内容丰富多样！无论是初学者还是健身达人，都能找到适合自己的课程；
专业指导，科学训练，让你在轻松愉悦中享受健身的乐趣。与达人一同开启健身之旅！
【丰富的赛事和活动】
丰富多彩赛事，见证高光时刻；
同步和查看马拉松、越野赛等户外比赛数据，和大神一起竞技和 PK；
特色奖牌，记录你的每一份努力与坚持，参与活动，赢取丰厚奖励；
分享运动动态，在运动社区与运动爱好者一起交流运动经验，感受运动快乐。
【户外路线探索和新玩法】
城市街道、自然小径，丰富的跑步路线带来不同的跑步体验；
一键搜索附近路线，轻松开跑体验周边的美好；
多人组队跑，和好友互鼓励，感受更多跑步的乐趣；
剧情跑，跑出穿越感、跑出科技感，获得不一样的跑步体验。
【全面的运动健康数据平台】
健身、跑步、跳绳、瑜伽、骑行、越野跑、计步、羽毛球、飞盘、手环、跑步机… 所有运动数据一站式记录；
主流的智能穿戴设备、运动手表、手机健康系统数据均已接入，实时同步第三方数据到 Keep，数据 All in one；
时刻关注自己的变化，记录和同步体重、三围等身体数据，以及最大摄氧量、HRV、心率等健康数据，做到自我的全方位掌控。

bluejetty:00016262:ios.description:
SOL: YOUR PERSONALIZED PATH TO INNER GROWTH
Feel calmer. Understand yourself. Build habits that last. Strengthen your relationships. Explore what gives your life meaning.
Sol brings personalized plans, self-discovery, daily practices, spiritual exploration, and community together in one place—so you can grow in a way that feels true to you.
START WITH YOUR GOAL
Choose what you want to change, and Sol creates a personalized 4-week plan around you:
• Reduce stress and anxiety
• Find your true self and purpose
• Feel less lonely and more connected
• Feel better emotionally day to day
• Explore your spirituality
• Build healthier habits
Complete two guided practices each day, follow clear weekly milestones, and track your progress as small actions become lasting change.
DISCOVER THE REAL YOU
Go beyond a single personality test with quizzes and insights across psychology, relationships, purpose, and the world’s wisdom traditions:
• Personality, Enneagram, attachment style, emotional intelligence, resilience, burnout, values, and more
• Purpose and meaning-of-life tests
• Relationship style, love tests, and compatibility
• Career paths aligned with your strengths
• Name meanings and personal symbolism
• Western, Vedic, Chinese, Mayan, and Kabbalistic astrology
• Personalized daily horoscopes and zodiac insights
BUILD YOUR DAILY PRACTICE
Sol recommends practices based on your goals, interests, personality, and world view:
• Mood tracker, mood journal, daily journal, and gratitude journal
• Guided meditation for stress, anxiety, relaxation, mindfulness, and sleep
• Breathing exercises and breathwork, including box breathing, Pranayama, and alternate-nostril breathing
• Daily yoga workouts, Sun Salutations, Tai Chi, stretching, mudras, and body-based relaxation
• Positive daily affirmations, mantras, inspirational quotes, and motivational quotes
• Relaxing sounds, rain sounds, nature sounds, sound baths, and soothing sleep sounds
• Daily Bible verses, devotionals, prayers, and Christian practices
• Orthodox feast days, Scripture readings, and prayer practices
• Buddhist meditation, Vipassanā, Dharma, observances, and daily wisdom
• Spiritual readings, rituals, nature practices, mindful eating, art, and music
• A personalized daily habit tracker, streaks, and routines that help your practices stick
Choose an evidence-based path, a mystical one, a combination, or anything in-between. Sol adapts to what resonates with you.
GROW YOUR RELATIONSHIPS
You don't have to do this alone. Understand how you connect and discover practical ways to grow closer:
• Test compatibility with partners, friends, and family
• Explore relationship styles and patterns
• Use your relationship tracker to stay intentional
• Get personalized gifts, activities, and communication tips
• Send Hugs, Blessings, Joy, and Peace
FIND YOUR PEOPLE
Join Circles built around shared goals and interests, meet Solmates who understand you, and connect with a positive community focused on becoming better - not appearing perfect.
MEET YOUR INNER-LIFE COMPANION
Talk with Sol - your AI companion - anytime you need perspective, encouragement, or a next step. Sol can help you:
• Reflect on what you're feeling and why
• Choose the right practice for today
• Understand your quiz results and what they mean
• Work through relationship challenges
• Keep moving forward when motivation fades
Sol remembers your journey and meets you where you are - not where an algorithm thinks you should be.
SOL PLUS
Sol Plus unlocks personalized plans, unlimited AI Guide sessions, all quizzes, deeper relationship insights, Circle creation, and premium content and tools.
One app for your inner life.
One path designed around you.
Download Sol and start growing today.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
• 1 month (7-day free trial, auto-renewal)
• 1 year (7-day free trial, auto-renewal)
TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY POLICY

bluejetty:00164274:ios.developer: Beijing Kongwang Cultural Books Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00164274:ios.summary:
孔网创建于2002年，是大型的二手旧货、古旧图书和商品交易平台，是传统文化行业结合互联网而搭建的C2C平台，是有传统文化价值的旧货市场。网站主要板块是书店区和拍卖区。网站秉承“网罗天下图书，传承中华文明”的理念，致力于发掘、抢救、保护和传播中国传统文化资源，是新时期坚定中国传统文化自信的重要阵地。
【用户群体】
目前孔网注册会员数量近2000万，主要涵盖以下群体：
1/知识分子群体,主要以各领域专家、学者、专业研究人员等知识分子为主。
2/高校师生群体:,主要以高等院校相关
bluejetty:00164274:ios.description:
孔网创建于2002年，是大型的二手旧货、古旧图书和商品交易平台，是传统文化行业结合互联网而搭建的C2C平台，是有传统文化价值的旧货市场。网站主要板块是书店区和拍卖区。网站秉承“网罗天下图书，传承中华文明”的理念，致力于发掘、抢救、保护和传播中国传统文化资源，是新时期坚定中国传统文化自信的重要阵地。
【用户群体】
目前孔网注册会员数量近2000万，主要涵盖以下群体：
1/知识分子群体,主要以各领域专家、学者、专业研究人员等知识分子为主。
2/高校师生群体:,主要以高等院校相关人文学科师生为主。
3/爱好中国传统文化的普通读书人。
4/图书馆、纪念馆、文博相关机构等。
5/古玩图书爱好者、收藏家。
【网上书店】
截止2023年底，孔夫子旧书网拥有超过2万余家旧货（书）店，30.5万余个旧货（书）摊加盟，每日新加盟的店铺300余家；在线展示销售商品高达1.5亿多种，3天在线拍品近7万余件。
【在线拍卖】
每日新增10000种拍品，从明清古籍、民国期刊、名人信札，到字画、连环画、邮票、古钱币到古玩杂项，都能够以合适的价格购得。
【经营品类】
1、图书大全：古旧书、二手书、畅销书、特价书、教材教辅、考试用书、线装书、古籍善本、民国旧书、国学古籍、报纸期刊、老照片、外文原版书、签名本等
2、艺术收藏品：名人墨迹、信札、连环画、字画、红色文献、老旧地图、碑帖印谱、版画宣传画、老照片、邮票、钱币、陶瓷、玉器、文房雅玩、古玩杂项等
【社会价值】
1/中国传统文化的传承基地。
2/中国文化自信的阵地。
3/社会底层低收入群体生计之道。
4/知识分子学术研究的资料宝库。
5/社会高尚读书风气养成的园地。
6/绿色环保经济的重要领域。 
7/老百姓处置闲置旧书的便捷途径。
8/年轻一代传承传统文化的崭新舞台。
“网罗天下图书，传承中华文明”，“花少钱，买好书”，关注孔网，尽享淘书与收藏的乐趣吧。

bluejetty:00193737:android.description:
Are you good at playing words with letters?
Word Swipe Pic is a PERFECT word finder game for you to search words with hidden clues in pictures. Combined with the classic "4 pics 1 word" and the creative "word swipe" gameplays, it will allow you to enjoy a great journey of word search puzzles.
While you are playing the game, all you need to do is to find words based on the clues in a picture. Answers for each puzzle may be the objects in the picture or any concepts or emotions related to the picture. 
BEAUTIFUL PICTURES FOR EACH PUZZLE
• There will be an awesome picture as a clue for each puzzle
• Try to guess the correct words as many as possible
CREATIVE WORD SEARCH PUZZLES 
• Letter blocks crush after correct words being swiped out
• New hidden words will be formed after letters' collapse
ADDICTIVE WORD FINDER WITH CLUES
• A new kind of word finder game to tease your brain
• Try to find hidden words as many as possible
CLEAR & AMAZING ANIMATIONS
• Clear graphics and animations for each tap or swipe
• You can easily use "Search", "Hint" or "Shuffle" for help
HUNDREDS OF CHALLENGING LEVELS
• It starts easy and becomes challenging fast
• More challenges are on the go
HOW TO PLAY?
- Search words on the letter block according to the hidden clue(s) in pictures
- Swipe letters horizontally or vertically to find and collect words
- Tap the "Search", "Hint" or "Shuffle" buttons when you get stuck
- Find the "Bonus Words" which are not presented in the answers

Don't hesitate to download it! And start this addictive words with letters game for FREE now!

bluejetty:00099069:ios.description:
ACNETIC — AI SKINCARE, PHOTO SKIN ANALYSIS & FACE YOGA
Acnetic is an AI-powered skincare and acne assistant that helps you understand your skin and build safe, effective daily routines. Using a single photo or a short selfie, Acnetic performs a photo skin analysis—assessing hydration, redness, acne type, scarring visibility, pore prominence and sensitivity—and converts insights into personalized morning/evening routines, targeted treatment steps, product-matching, short face yoga sessions.
KEY FEATURES
• Photo Skin Analysis: Instant AI evaluation (hydration, redness, acne classification, scars, pores, sensitivity) presented as a clear report to guide routines.
• Personalized Routines: Morning and night step-by-step plans tailored to your skin data, acne type and the products you already own, including concise how-to instructions (amount, placement, frequency).
• Product Matching & Compatibility: Add your products; Acnetic orders them safely, flags incompatible actives, manages duplicate ingredients and suggests alternates suited to your region.
• Face Yoga & Targeted Zones: Guided 1–5 minute face yoga flows for forehead, under-eye, cheeks, jawline and neck to support circulation, lymphatic drainage and gentle facial toning.
• Education Hub: Accessible guides on skincare basics, an ingredient encyclopedia, myth-busting articles, safe layering rules and short how-to videos for common application mistakes..
HOW IT WORKS
Snap a photo or upload images from your gallery.
Receive an immediate skin analysis report with clear insights and priority concerns.
Get a tailored morning/evening routine plus optional face yoga sequences and targeted treatment steps.
Track progress with date-stamped photos and adjust the plan as your skin changes.
WHO IT'S FOR
• People struggling with acne, recurring breakouts, oily or combination skin.
• Users who want to learn safe active usage and avoid damaging ingredient combinations.
• Anyone curious about face yoga or wanting short guided facial exercises as part of a holistic routine.
• Beauty enthusiasts who prefer photo-based progress tracking and data-informed adjustments.
DISCLAIMER
Acnetic offers skincare suggestions based on AI analysis and does not provide medical advice or treatment. For skin concerns, consult a dermatologist. Face images are processed securely and can be deleted anytime within the app. See our Privacy Policy for details.
ACNETIC PRO – UNLOCK ALL FEATURES
Acnetic Pro is a subscription‑based app. A valid subscription is required to access all features including daily acne treatment routines, AI‑powered skin analysis, 30‑day treatment path, habit recommendations, and personalized product matching. There is no free content available.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Auto‑renewable monthly subscription – $4.99/week
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Your subscription will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto‑renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto‑renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase
ACCOUNT DELETION
Users can delete their account and associated data at any time from within the app: Profile → Delete Account.
Need help or have questions?
For more information use Apple Support Links:
• https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
• https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT204084
• Privacy Policy: https://acneticdotcom.web.app/#/privacy
• Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00077499:ios.description:
Get ready for an outrageously fun and wacky adventure back in time with Dino Bash! In this dinosaur game, you'll lead an army of powerful, wise-cracking dinos to defend your precious egg from pesky Neanderthals who are armed with nothing but clubs and bad attitudes.
Are you ready for a time-traveling adventure that takes you and your trusty team of dinosaurs on a journey through the ages? In Dino Bash, you'll be transported through a magical wormhole that lands you smack-dab in the middle of different time zones, where you'll encounter all kinds of wild and wacky challenges.
With each level, you'll unlock new dinosaurs, each with their own unique abilities and personalities (some of them are just plain weird). And let's not forget the upgrades - pimp out your dinos with the latest in prehistoric fashion, including stylish hats and battle armor.
But it's not just about looking good in this dinosaur game - strategy is key in Dino Bash. You'll need to place your dinosaurs in just the right spots to fend off those Neanderthals and protect your stash. And when things get really hairy, call on your most powerful dinos to unleash some jurassic mayhem.
So, what are you waiting for? Get ready to stomp, chomp, and roar your way to victory in Dino Bash, the most outrageous dino game of prehistoric proportions!

bluejetty:00032355:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Eras Bar: Food Tycoon!
Embark on a culinary journey through time! Become the ultimate Food Tycoon by cooking and crafting your way across various civilizations. Develop and produce unique cultural resources, sell them to the locals, and advance through the ages. Assist your people in constructing historical landmarks that stand the test of time.
Create Your Culinary Empire:
Master the art of cooking and crafting in different eras, from ancient civilizations to the modern age. Design your own unique dishes and recipes that reflect each era's cultural richness.
Cultural Resource Production:
Dive into the fascinating world of cultural resources. Develop and produce items that showcase the essence of each era. From traditional delicacies to groundbreaking inventions, satisfy the cravings of your customers.
Trade and Expand:
Establish a bustling marketplace and trade your cultural treasures with the diverse inhabitants of each era. Earn coins to upgrade your kitchen, unlock new recipes, and expand your culinary empire.
Historical Landmarks:
Help your citizens build iconic historical landmarks that define their era. Witness the evolution of architecture and celebrate the achievements of each civilization. Your decisions shape the course of history!
Endless Upgrades:
Plan your path to success with countless upgrades. Enhance your cooking techniques, unlock new ingredients, and boost your production capabilities. Customize your gameplay experience and watch history unfold before your eyes.
Chart Your Own Course:
Navigate through the twists and turns of history as you make strategic decisions. Choose your path wisely, and observe how your choices influence the development of your culinary empire.
Experience the Evolution of Food:
Discover the evolution of food across different eras and witness the impact of your culinary creations on the world. Keep the flames of innovation burning as you progress through time.
Download Idle Eras Bar: Food Tycoon now and embark on a flavorful adventure through the ages! Unleash your culinary creativity and leave your mark on history!

bluejetty:00096233:ios.description:
Welcome to Guard Club Simulator 3D — where you run the night, not the party.
Take on the ultimate role of a nightclub security guard and experience the thrilling, unpredictable world of nightlife! As the frontline enforcer of order, your job is to protect the club, manage the crowd, deal with chaos, and keep VIPs safe at all costs. This isn’t just a job — it’s a full-blown action simulation that puts your reflexes, awareness, and authority to the test.
Whether it’s scanning IDs at the entrance, diffusing heated arguments, ejecting unruly guests, or escorting celebrities through dangerous situations, your shift is anything but boring. Every night brings new challenges, new characters, and new trouble.
Immersive Nightclub Simulation: Explore highly detailed 3D club environments with dynamic lighting, sound, and crowds.
 Action Meets Strategy: Deal with unpredictable situations using a mix of strength, decision-making, and timing.
 Enforce the Rules: Throw out troublemakers, spot fake IDs, search for weapons, and keep the party under control.
 Stealth & Drama: Be discreet when needed, or go full force when the situation gets out of hand.
 Progression System: Earn experience, unlock new levels, and climb the ladder to become Head of Security.
 Unique Characters: Interact with a variety of NPCs — drunk guests, dancers, influencers, VIPs, and shady figures.
 Upgrade Your Gear: Unlock tools like tasers, flashlights, scanners, radios, and more to boost your performance.

bluejetty:00144161:ios.description:
Gem Space is everything you need to connect, work, and create.
A messenger with free audio and video calls, a smart feed, channels, Spaces communities, and mini apps. Chat with friends, follow the news, grow your blog or business, and meet people who share your interests, all in one app.
Your privacy matters. Messages, audio and video calls, and Spaces are securely protected, while you stay in control of your privacy settings.
FOR YOU AND YOUR FRIENDS
Follow creators, learn something new, share ideas, and connect through chats and communities.
Smart feed
Choose your interests and follow channels and chats. AI helps surface fresh videos and posts based on what you like.
Find inspiration
Browse the channel catalog and use smart search to discover new topics and communities.
Easy chats, public or private
Send messages, stickers, voice notes, and video messages, or start an audio or video call.
Free audio and video calls
Host group calls and conferences with up to 200 participants from any device. Even guests without a Gem Space account can join.
Spaces for communities
Create your own Space in just a few clicks. Pick a category template and get a ready-made structure with channels and chats.
Feed: public and private channels organized by topics and interests.
Chats: spaces for conversations with subscribers and community members.
Store: add links to your website, blog, or business in one place.
Communities by interest
Meet people who share your interests and build your own community.
Mini apps
Play, explore services, and get things done without leaving Gem Space. New mini apps are marked NEW.
FOR BLOGGERS AND CONTENT CREATORS
Create and share videos, articles, and live streams. Templates help you launch a Space in minutes.
Channels
Share updates, publish articles, and upload videos. Recommendation algorithms help your content reach the right audience.
Channel catalog
Publish content, talk to your audience directly in the messenger, and grow through recommendations.
Communities
Run your community like your own media space:
bring people together in chats and channels;
share updates through the smart feed;
choose open or invite-only access;
organize important information;
keep your contacts and external links in one place.
FOR BUSINESS
One app instead of several tools: messaging, video calls, and a Space with a feed, chats, and links. Stay connected with your team and your audience.
Chats and recorded conferences
Send messages, make calls, and host conferences with up to 200 participants.
Call people without an account
Make free audio and video calls over the internet, even with people who have not signed up yet.
Privacy and moderation
Control access through invitations, manage members, and moderate your Space.
Secure communication
Keep your data private and your conversations protected.
API integration
Automate workflows and connect Gem Space with other services through the API.
Everyday work tools
Edit messages, share documents, and keep team communication in one place.
Reach a new audience
Grow through chats, calls, and content discovery inside Gem Space. Calling people without an account gives your business even more ways to connect.
Terms of Use: https://gemspace.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00024610:ios.description:
BoothLab: Create Stunning 360 photo booth videos & photo booth layouts
BoothLab is the go-to app for photo booth professionals and event creators who want fast, beautiful, and professional-quality videos and layouts, all without the technical hassle.
Designed for speed and simplicity, BoothLab helps you focus on capturing unforgettable moments while it handles the rest. Whether you're running a wedding, corporate event, birthday, or brand activation, BoothLab ensures your guests get an experience worth sharing with a photo booth setup.
Powerful Features for Effortless Results
• Create both 360 photo booth videos and classic layouts
• Adjustable slow-motion range for perfect cinematic effects
• Record in 720p, 1080p, or 4K at 60 to 240 frames per second
• Select from multiple lenses for creative flexibility
• Customize compression quality to balance speed and storage
• Add your own overlays, intros, and outros for branded results
• Import music directly from your audio files (MP3 supported)
• Use the built-in flash to enhance low-light shots
• Built-in video gallery to manage and preview creations
• QR sharing so guests can instantly download their videos and photo booth creations
• Set up a Sharing Station for seamless on-site access
• AirPlay support to stream the video gallery on Apple TV
• Background video processing keeps your workflow smooth and uninterrupted
• Connect your Sony DSLR camera to capture even better photos
• Easily design your own custom layout templates
BoothLab is built for pros who demand speed, reliability, and high-quality output. From setup to sharing, everything is streamlined for success.
Download BoothLab today and elevate your photo booth experience.
In app purchases:
With the 'Pro' in-app purchase you can have access to all features within the app during a month, six months or a year, depending on the chosen package. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal, Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Privacy policy: https://booth-lab.com/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://booth-lab.com/terms.html
Questions?
contact@booth-lab.com

bluejetty:00046364:ios.description:
Aolicativo Estância Parque Atibaia
Tanto pelo site do condomínio Estância Parque Atibaia quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com o Estância Parque Atibaia, a sua vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para epatibaia@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00167372:ios.description:
The best realistic police officer simulation game where you use guns, pilot helicopters, airplanes, cars, and boats, chase criminals, save hostages, and arrest gangsters and stop mafia!
Play as an armed policeman, in this thrilling mobile simulation game.
Equip your guns, rescue hostages, snipe from rooftops, stop bank robberies, arrest gangsters, and chase criminals.
Perform a wide variety of missions to become the Commissioner of Ultra City.
More than 20 weapons are available, including pistols, shotguns, SMGs, assault rifles, large machine guns, sniper rifles, bazookas, and grenades. 
Control all vehicles available on the map, including helicopters, airplanes, boats, and cars. More than 52 police vehicles are controllable. 
Complete challenging missions to rise through the ranks, from Cadet to Commissioner!
A free ranked pass is available.
!! Police Simulator: Gun War Duty contains unlimited free levels !!
You can drive different cop vehicles, including cars, helicopters, planes, and boats. You also have a parachute if you encounter difficulties. 
The environment features dynamic weather conditions, realistic day and night cycles, clear skies, tropical rain, snow, thunderstorms, wind, turbulence, and true 3D volumetric clouds. 
Almost the entire environment is destructible!
Drive and fly to explore the massive open-world environment and its unique locations. Take off from 7 airports and commute from international airports to small rural airstrips. There are tons of points of interest to explore, including rivers and lakes, big cities, small towns, nuclear power plants, ports, Japanese temples, rural houses and farms, ruins, and more. Drive fast cars on open roads, from 2x2 lanes to very small off-road mountain trails with hill climbs and canyons. Explore the world not just by flying but with real car driving simulation experiences as well!
Tons of missions to experience, such as:
- Use weapon to arrest gangsters traffic
- Save hostages
- Train your aim in the shooting range
- Take aerial photos from helicopters
- Snipe gangster from the top of the mall building
- Destroy turrets with rockets
- Rescue president with GPS radar tracker
- Chase and arrest bad drivers
- Drive fast cars with no limit speed
- Arrest bank robbers
- Stop gangsters with police boats
- Parachute jump training
- Protect and escort the president
- Go to airplane accidents and car collisions to help victims
- Transport wreck: grab things with your electromagnet
- Land on an aircraft carrier
Features:
- Advanced weapon system
- Customize your cop officer
- Interior police station
- Mission debriefing board
- Weather forecast: clear sky, rain, thunderstorms, snow
- Day and night cycle
- True 3D volumetric cloud system
- Realistic plane flight physics
- Intuitive controls: buttons, joystick, or accelerometers
- High-quality world environments with high res satellite imagery
- Highly detailed realistic copter cockpit environment.
- Multiple on-board cameras to get every angle of the jet
- Ultimate racing challenge game
- Hugely open-world driving simulator
- Miles of roads to drift and drive on and do stunt jumps
- Map Information (Distance, Altitude, etc.)
- Vehicle crashes and smoke effects.
- Huge selection of aircraft and airline
20 weapons :
- Pistols : Deagle, Colt, Glock, Magnum
- Shotgun : Remington, Sp12
- SMG : Uzi, Mac10 Mp5
- Small Rifle : Famas, Aks, ScarL
- Assault Rifle : M4A1, Ak47
- Sniper : Awp, M24 Dragunov
- Large machine gun : Negev
- Bazooka : Carl Gustav, M72 Law
52 controllable vehicles:
- 15 helicopters, like Bell 206, Eurocopter EC135, Apache, Mil Mi-8, SuperCobra, Bell UH-1 Huey
- 18 aircrafts, like Cesna, Piper PA-46, Boeing 747, Airbus A380, F14, Hawk
- 10 boats, like Jetski, Yacht, Vedette, Offshore
- 9 cars, like SUVs, 4x4, sports and racing cars
This is the latest and one of the best police officer simulators! 
Are you ready for the ultimate law enforcement simulation? Duty calls!

bluejetty:00027103:ios.name: Blue Iris
bluejetty:00027103:ios.summary: This app is a CLIENT for the Blue Iris Windows PC software. In order to make use of this app, you must have Blue Iris version 6 installed and running on a Windows PC or VM. Instructions for connecting this app to the PC software are found
bluejetty:00027103:ios.description:
This app is a CLIENT for the Blue Iris Windows PC software. In order to make use of this app, you must have Blue Iris version 6 installed and running on a Windows PC or VM. Instructions for connecting this app to the PC software are found in the Remote Access chapter of its Help file.
This app provides a single point of contact to your home camera network. There is no need to insecurely open individual cameras to the Internet. This app connects using a secure and session-based protocol--no passwords are transmitted in plain text.
Remote access does require router configuration or NGROK, which you can test without the app by using Safari. You should see your Blue Iris login page.
Key features include:
- Manage multiple Blue Iris installations
- Geofencing: set status, send alerts, and more in response to device location *
- Control the shield icon, schedule and profile selection
- Receive iOS push notification alerts when a Blue Iris camera is triggered or there is a critical status message
- Fast H.264 streaming
- Control PTZ, IR and more for any camera that’s also controllable at the Blue Iris PC
- Listen to and talk to any camera that’s also supported at the Blue Iris PC
- Navigate cameras by tapping and swiping
- Review recordings as stored on the Blue Iris PC, up to 64x speed
- Download recorded video from the Blue Iris PC to the iOS device
- Selectively delete recordings from the Blue Iris PC
- Broadcast live video from the iOS device directly into a Blue Iris PC camera window
- Remote control DIO output signals on compatible devices
- Baby monitor functionality: continue to listen to audio with app closed or device in standby **
* Note that continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
** Note that continued use of audio streaming running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00045974:ios.description:
doobi is a digital mobile only laundry and dry cleaning platform. Designed to provide a fun and easy laundry experience. Simply, pick a plan, fill a bag and leave the rest to us!
Why doobi?
We make laundry easy, literally. We pick up, we clean and we deliver. Each customer gets an essential welcome kit on their first order delivered to their doorstep. We refer to these as “necessities”, and the lack of having them can hugely impact the ease of doing laundry!
What’s next?
Fill a bag with your items and we will take care of the rest! We will return them to you cleaned, pressed or folded and smelling fresh! We have a single price per bag and no hidden cost! (Hence: Free delivery for you!)
Special requests?
Easy! Through doobi, you have full control over your laundry! You may add your special requests, choose your preferred scent, control your folding preferences or even take a photo of your items directly on the app!
Order Tracking?
We value transparency, so we made sure you’re with us during the process! Once you place an order you will be able to manage and track you order on the App!
Need help?
You can reach out to our team anytime through our in-app live chat. We’re here to for you.
Get doobi and enjoy the experience!

bluejetty:00083353:ios.summary: Luna is a smart and simple calendar for women's health tracking. Luna has different features such as tracking and predicting the exact calendar of menstruation and ovulation, and pregnancy tracking will be added to Luna's predictions soon.
bluejetty:00083353:ios.description:
Luna is a smart and simple calendar for women's health tracking. Luna has different features such as tracking and predicting the exact calendar of menstruation and ovulation, and pregnancy tracking will be added to Luna's predictions soon. Luna accurately tracks the menstrual cycle and its flow rate. Also, it is also a smart tracker for regular and irregular periods, and based on the changing circumstances of each person, it can provide a reliable program for women trying to conceive. By keeping track of your periods in Luna's calendar, you can get accurate predictions of menstruation, ovulation, and fertility days. Luna is the simplest and most effective period and ovulation tracker and pregnancy program that uses machine learning (AI) and is available to everyone for free. Every woman of all ages, including teens, adults, and even those with irregular periods, can use this health tracker. You can use diverse feature lists of Luna including Keeping track of the days and intensity of your period in a useful period calendar, tracking your ovulation period, menstrual cycle reminder program, recording PMS states and symptoms, and following your pregnancy calendar. 
Take full control of your health right now with Luna, and plan your various activities by predicting your future period.
This app is intended for general information purposes and should not be used for prevention, diagnostic or therapeutic purposes. It is strongly recommended to seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00168081:ios.description:
Bíblia Sagrada com Áudio é um aplicativo que permite você navegar através de toda a sabedoria da Palavra de Deus em uma linguagem simples e claro com só uns poucos cliques.
Não basta só ser Cristão, é necessário ter um bom aplicativo da Bíblia Sagrada com Áudio em Português instalado em seu celular! 
Ver e ouvir a palavra do maior e melhor homem que veio a passar pela Terra e saber interpreta-la, levando-a além dos olhos e chegando ao coração.
Agora você a terá sempre em sua mão, passando as mais gostosas horas de sua vida lendo as palavras de amor do filho do grande pai, seja em casa, na rua ou no trabalho!
Leve com você no seu móvel a Bíblia Sagrada com Áudio. Você não precisa de conexão de internet para usá-lo, basta fazer o download e instalá-lo.
A Bíblia é composta de 66 livros e está dividida em duas partes: o Velho Testamento (39 livros) e o Novo Testamento (27 livros). Seus autores provêm de várias origens, mas todos desejavam compartilhar o plano de Deus para a redenção de Seus filhos. Esse plano centraliza-se em Jesus Cristo, o Messias, a respeito de quem tanto os autores do Velho quanto do Novo Testamento prestaram testemunho.
Novo Testamento é a porta para os livros e as cartas escritas pelos apóstolos de Jesus Cristo, pessoa de espírito bom, filho do Senhor, cuja mãe tem como nome Maria, mulher simples, alegre e doce, que teve como marido, José.
Já no Velho (Antigo) Testamento, um pouco mais longo, mas não menos belo, é a vez de ler os ricos textos sagrados, podendo ir da criação ao apocalipse sem sair de seu lar.
Qualquer usuário tem o poder de compartilhar os versículos com o amigo, a namorada de maneira gostosa sem o perigo de vírus. Mesmo quando estiver a falar ou comer, poderá ouvir os áudios, no formato MP3, com a mesma facilidade que se escuta músicas.
A Bíblia Sagrada com Áudio disponibilizada no seu dispositivo móvel permite de um modo simples e prático o acesso a palavra de Deus em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento.
¡Leve a Bíblia Sagrada com Áudio a todas partes! Os melhores conselhos para sobrellevar os problemas mais complicados da vida encontram-se em suas páginas. As escrituras são muito úteis e ajudam a muitas famílias a ser felizes.
A Bíblia é uma coletânea de escritos antigos que contém registros da comunicação de Deus com Seus filhos e instruções para eles. A palavra Bíblia tem origem grega e significa “os livros.” Embora geralmente pensemos na Bíblia Sagrada como um único livro, na verdade, trata-se de uma biblioteca divina, reunida em um único volume.
É uma ótima oportunidade para nos melhorar e encontrar essa força e espírito que somente a Bíblia sabe como nos transmitir.
Desfruta da Santa Palavra de Deus em texto e em audio, e evangeliza nas redes Interface amigable ao usuário e de rápido acesso aos livros, capítulos e versículos.
O aplicativo é fácil de usar e permite você ler as sagradas escrituras de forma rápida e cômoda,

Escuta os audios completos da Bíblia Sagrada
Escutar os conselhos da Biblia faz-nos mais sábios. Ponha-se em mãos de Deus, abrace a Biblia e segua seus conselhos.

bluejetty:00075572:ios.description:
Write. Plan. Study. Work. Create.
Noteshelf 3 brings natural handwriting, powerful AI, PDF annotation, audio recording and planning together in one beautiful app for iPad, iPhone and Mac. Free to start.
FOR STUDENTS
• Take lecture and class notes with lifelike pens, pencils and highlighters
• Annotate textbooks, worksheets, slides and PDFs
• Record audio while you write, so you never miss a word
• Use Noteshelf AI to summarize and explain what you've learned
FOR PROFESSIONALS
• Capture meeting notes and record important discussions
• Mark up contracts, reports and presentations
• Present your notes on an external display with a laser pointer
• Export and share notes as PDFs or images in one tap
FOR PLANNERS & JOURNALERS
• 200+ templates for digital planners, journals, diaries and trackers
• Plan your days, track goals and keep a personal journal
• Decorate pages with stickers, photos and custom covers
WRITE NATURALLY
• A smooth, natural handwriting experience built for Apple Pencil
• Write, type, draw and sketch on the same page
• Turn handwriting into text and search your notes in 65 languages
• Choose lined, dotted or grid paper in any color
WORK WITH PDFs & DOCUMENTS
• Import and annotate PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint files and images
• Highlight, mark up, write and draw directly on your documents
• Scan paper documents with the built-in scanner
NOTESHELF AI
• Summarize handwritten pages in seconds
• Explain difficult terms and concepts
• Translate text into other languages
• Generate notes on any topic
RECORD & REMEMBER
• Record lectures, meetings and ideas alongside your handwritten notes
STAY ORGANIZED & SECURE
• Folders, subfolders, tags, bookmarks and a table of contents
• Link notebooks together to connect ideas
• Lock notes with a password, Face ID or Touch ID
• Sync across iPad, iPhone and Mac with iCloud
• Automatic backup to Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or WebDAV
YOUR NOTES, YOUR WAY
• Custom notebook covers and a toolbar you can rearrange
• Presentation mode, dark mode and flexible page layouts
FREE TO START
Create up to 3 notebooks with core pens and paper for free. Upgrade to Noteshelf Premium for unlimited notebooks, all templates, handwriting recognition, auto-backup and 100 monthly AI credits.
Write beautifully. Work smarter. Stay organized.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00086614:ios.name: Smart Logbook
bluejetty:00086614:ios.summary: Smart Logbook makes logging your flights fast and easy. When you apply for a new rating or interview for a job, you can easily see your flying totals, over any span of time, in any type of aircraft. Track your currency and limits, and get r
bluejetty:00086614:ios.description:
Smart Logbook makes logging your flights fast and easy. When you apply for a new rating or interview for a job, you can easily see your flying totals, over any span of time, in any type of aircraft. Track your currency and limits, and get reminders to renew your medical and recurrent training. As your flying experience grows, use the interactive map to see for yourself all the places flying has taken you.
Getting started is easy. Download Smart Logbook and log 50 hours of flight time for free. Then make a one-time purchase in the app to continue adding flights. Besides getting the intuitive and powerful functionality Smart Logbook offers today, you'll also receive regular updates with new capabilities.
Smart Logbook sync keeps your logbook securely backed up, and lets you seamlessly access it from multiple devices. Sync is included in the free trial. After that, just sign up for the very affordable sync subscription. The first year is free, and you can cancel any time.
For more info about purchasing or the sync subscription, see https://thesmartlogbook.discourse.group/c/help/purchase
Features:
• Extensive customization, with defaults for general aviation and professional pilots.
• Calculate your totals, filtered by time period, aircraft type/characteristics, and more.
• Currency and limit tracking. Includes rules for FAA, EASA, and Transport Canada requirements, and allows creating custom rules.
• Electronic signature capture, compliant with FAA standards.
• Track certificates, ratings, endorsements, and medicals, and get notifications to renew items that expire.
• Interactive map of your flights, which can be viewed and shared online.
• Database of 40,000 airports, and allows adding custom airports.
• Print your logbook in Jeppesen Basic/Pro, Transport Canada, EASA, or DGCA (India) format.
• Calculate totals for the FAA Form 8710-1 / IACRA.
• Add photos of aircraft, models, crew members, certificates, and flights.
• Import flights from LogTen Pro or Excel/CSV file.
• Export flights to CSV file.
• Support for Dark Mode and Sign in with Apple.
Privacy Policy:
https://thesmartlogbook.com/privacy.html
Terms & Conditions:
https://thesmartlogbook.com/eula.html

bluejetty:00174387:ios.name: Rexton App
bluejetty:00174387:ios.summary: Disclaimer:This app is intended for download and use by individuals aged 18 years and above only. The information provided through this app is for general informational purposes and is not intended to replace professional medical advice, di
bluejetty:00174387:ios.description:
Disclaimer:This app is intended for download and use by individuals aged 18 years and above only. The information provided through this app is for general informational purposes and is not intended to replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Users should consult a qualified Healthcare Professional (HCP)for any medical questions, concerns, or assistance.
The Rexton App enables users of Rexton hearing aids, purchased 2014 or later, to adapt these safely and conveniently to their individual requirements and to adjust and control them.
In addition, the Rexton App includes various services and functions that support or automatically take over the extended use of your hearing aids.
All features and services are subject to the following factors:
- brand, type and platform of the hearing aid
- specific functions supported by the hearing aid
- services offered by the brand or distributor
- country-specific availability of services
Basic functions of the Rexton App:
With the Rexton App the hearing aid wearer can use a smartphone to remote control the paired hearing aids. The Rexton App also offers a comfortable range of functions for simple devices in the entry-level segment, e.g.
- various listening programs
- tinnitus signal
- volume control
- sound balance
Hearing aid-dependent functions of the app:
Depending on the technical equipment of the hearing aids and depending on the default functions of the provider, the Rexton App allows the following functions to be controlled, like
- directional hearing
- separate adjustment of both hearing aids
- muting the hearing aids
- volume control
- motion sensor
... as well as displaying and setting the battery charge status, warning signals, device usage and statistics for user satisfaction
Services at a glance
The availability of the listed services and features depends on the make and model of the hearing aid, distribution channel, country / region and service package.
Hearing success lessons
In addition to the initial adjustment of the hearing aid, the examination of the settings for the hearing success of the patient is significantly important. Based on a questionnaire available in the Rexton App, the hearing aid wearer can also document and continuously check the status and success of his hearing success to his audiologist.
The user guide for the app can be accessed from the app settings menu. Alternatively, you can download the user guide in electronic form from www.wsaud.com or order a printed version from the same address. The printed version will be made available to you free of charge within 7 working days.

With its fast-paced and attractive gameplay, funny eye-catching celebrations, and easy to use dynamic controls, you'll feel like a pro athlete as you dribble, pass, and shoot your way to victory. bluejetty:00166278:ios.name: BattleTabs: PvP Ship Battle
bluejetty:00166278:ios.summary:
Take the game everyone played as a kid. Give every ship a superpower. Now you're playing BattleTabs.
A fast, tense 1v1 strategy duel: build a fleet, hunt down your opponent's, and sink it before they sink yours. The board is hidden, the ab
bluejetty:00166278:ios.description:
Take the game everyone played as a kid. Give every ship a superpower. Now you're playing BattleTabs.
A fast, tense 1v1 strategy duel: build a fleet, hunt down your opponent's, and sink it before they sink yours. The board is hidden, the abilities are deadly, and one good read can win the whole match.
SO, WHAT'S IN YOUR FLEET?
You bring four ships into battle — and there are 40+ to choose from, each a completely different tool:
· The Coracle one-shots any ship — if you've already found the tile.
· The Longboat keeps firing until it finally misses.
· The Octopus tells you how far away the nearest enemy is hiding.
· The Loyal Defender takes every hit meant for the rest of your fleet.
· The Magic Mirror steals your opponent's last move and fires it back.
· The Valkyrie strikes twice — and harder every time one of your own ships goes down.
Mix, match, and find the combo that wins the way you want to win.
THE BOARD IS HIDDEN. SO IS YOUR PLAN.
Every shot is a guess you're trying to make less of a guess. Scout with sonar. Bluff your placements. Bait out their cooldowns, then punish the opening. The matches are short. The mind games aren't.
QUICK TO LEARN. BRUTAL TO MASTER.
A round takes a few minutes. Getting genuinely good takes a while. Climb the ranked ladder, where wins come from better reads — never better luck.
YOU DON'T HAVE TO BATTLE ALONE.
Join a clan and climb together. Drop into tournaments to prove you're the best in the field. Or go solo against the AI in Expedition — a PvE roguelike run where you push your fleet through encounter after encounter, upgrading as you go, with only three strikes to spare.
KEY FEATURES
· 40+ ships, each with a unique cooldown ability
· Collect ships and build your fleets — think your strategy through
· Unlock new ships and cosmetics (hats!) on the research tree
· Skill-based ranked play — pure 1v1, no pay-to-win
· Tournaments — compete for the top of the bracket
· Clans — team up, climb, and represent
· Expedition — a PvE roguelike against AI fleets
· The Settlement — a home island for your pets, and visits between friends (Battle Club)
· Two modes: Intense for fast duels, Casual to take your time
· Cross-platform — your fleet follows you everywhere
· Free to play
5M+ players have registered. Jump in on iPhone and iPad.
JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Talk tactics, report bugs, and help shape where the game goes next.
Discord: https://battletabs.com/discord
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/BattleTabs
Latest news: https://battletabs.io/news
---
Note: this game requires an internet connection (4G, 5G or Wi-Fi).
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://battletabs.com/privacy
