bluejetty:00016983:ios.name: Powerball Lottery
bluejetty:00016983:ios.summary: Get the latest Powerball results within moments of the draw taking place. This easy-to-use app shows the Powerball numbers (including Power Play and Double Play) and full prize breakdown including number of winners and prizes paid. This app
bluejetty:00016983:ios.description:
Get the latest Powerball results within moments of the draw taking place. This easy-to-use app shows the Powerball numbers (including Power Play and Double Play) and full prize breakdown including number of winners and prizes paid. This app also includes Powerball Xs & Os and 2by2 for states that play them.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00041265:ios.name: Meteor Speed Test - Ad Free
bluejetty:00041265:ios.summary:
- Testing speed for mobile and WiFi internet connections
Meteor is an ad-free internet speed test tool that can be used to check the speed of your mobile and wireless connection (on 3G, 4G LTE or 5G), as well as for WiFi speed testing. 
-
bluejetty:00041265:ios.description:
- Testing speed for mobile and WiFi internet connections
Meteor is an ad-free internet speed test tool that can be used to check the speed of your mobile and wireless connection (on 3G, 4G LTE or 5G), as well as for WiFi speed testing. 
- Test connection speed and app performance
Meteor’s unique test allows you to see how your internet connection and download speed will affect the performance of your favorite mobile apps. You can test app performance for up to six mobile apps at a time, from 27 of the most popular apps and games around the world. 
- Test connection speed and app performance
Meteor’s unique test allows you to see how your internet connection will affect the performance of your favorite mobile apps and games. You can test up to six mobile apps at a time, from 27 of the most popular ones around the world.
- Easy to use speed test
One simple test gives you easy-to-understand results for download speed, upload speed and ping time. Then, simply choose the apps you use most to see how they are impacted by your current network connection - no more trying to work out whether your network service provider is delivering the 5G connection you need.
- Historic internet speed test performance
View all your internet speed tests by location on a map and sort them by best and worst performance. See a timeline of your tests in the history tab and review the stats for each speed test to monitor how your network experience has changed over time.
- Connectivity coverage map
Always know where to find the best coverage with Meteor’s network coverage map. The map shows signal strength down to street level using signal data from local users. With network stats on local network operators, you can check coverage ahead of a trip, check the internet and signal strength in remote areas, compare your network to other providers in the area, arrange the best local SIM.
- Improving network connection
Meteor is completely free to use and contains no advertising. 
We provide an independent source of truth in mobile network experience: A data source that shows how users experience mobile network speeds, gaming, video, and voice services worldwide. To do this, we collect anonymised data on the signal strength, network, location, and other device sensors. You can stop this at any time in the settings section. We share this data with network operators globally and others in the industry to drive better connectivity for all.
Do Not Sell My Info: https://www.opensignal.com/ccpa

bluejetty:00039085:ios.description:
⋱「ままのて」アプリのおすすめポイント⋰
◆ 妊婦さん＆ママ・パパへ！毎日のメッセージ
妊娠中は、妊婦さんの身体と赤ちゃんの様子がわかるメッセージ「今日のママへ」「今日のパパへ」「今日の赤ちゃん」を毎日配信。産後の育児中には、赤ちゃんの成長やママとパパに役立つ情報を定期配信。妊娠週数・赤ちゃんの成長にあわせた情報を届けることで、妊娠中から子育て中のママとパパをしっかりとサポートします。
※育児中の情報配信は、現在は2歳の誕生日までの対応となります。
◆ 妊娠中・育児中の日記記録、体調管理、体重管理・体重記録ができます
妊娠中の気持ちや体調を日記として記録し、あとから振り返ることができます。体重管理、体重記録もでき母子手帳のようにもご利用いただけますよ。
それに加え、育児中は赤ちゃんの排泄や授乳、離乳食、睡眠等の情報まで記録することができます。
◆ パートナーと連携してママの身体の変化や赤ちゃんの成長を共有
妊娠中のママの体調、ママが記した写真や日記、赤ちゃんの育児お世話記録などをパパとシェアすることができます。ママの身体の変化や赤ちゃんの成長をパートナーと共有することでコミュニケーションを育むことができます。妊娠中は妊婦の身体の変化とお腹の赤ちゃんの成長、産後は赤ちゃんの成長を一緒に楽しんでみてはいかがでしょうか。
※「今日の体重」の記録は共有されません。
◆ 赤ちゃんのイラストとセリフ
妊娠週数と月数がひと目でわかります。妊娠モードは毎日お腹の中で少しずつ成長する赤ちゃんの様子をかわいらしいイラストで表示。育児モードは、赤ちゃんがかわいらしいセリフを毎日伝えてくれますよ。毎週変化する赤ちゃんのイラストは要チェック。約1500種類の楽しく役立つセリフから、日替わりで赤ちゃんがおしゃべりします。
◆ 医師監修！Q&Aでママとパパの悩みを解決
妊娠週数や子どもの月齢にあわせたQ&Aがいつでも見放題。助産師・小児科医が回答するQ&Aで、妊娠、出産、育児の疑問を解決します。妊婦さん＆ママ、パパの気になる悩みをQ&Aからチェックしてくださいね。
◆ 今読みたいおすすめ記事を毎日更新
妊娠週数や子どもの月齢にあったおすすめ記事を配信します。妊娠、出産、育児の情報はもちろん、ライフスタイルから美容・ファッションまで、妊婦さん＆ママ・パパの役に立つ豊富な記事をお届けします。
◆ 妊娠・出産のリアル！先輩ママの体験談
約400人の先輩妊婦さん＆ママへのアンケート結果と、豊富な体験談が読み放題。人には聞けない気になる話題は、体験談をチェック！
◆ 妊娠中・育児中を選んで、時期にあった情報が届く
妊娠中から出産後までしっかり妊婦さん＆ママ・パパをサポートします。
・妊娠ステージ
妊婦さんは「つわり」や「陣痛」など妊娠中特有の不安や悩み、妊婦健診や体調管理、お腹の赤ちゃんに関する疑問を解決していただきたく配信しています。安心の「医師監修済みQ&A」がチェックできるほか、妊娠週数にあわせたおすすめの記事を毎日配信します。現在の妊娠週数と月数、出産予定日までのカウントダウンを毎日お知らせします。
※妊娠ステージは妊娠2週〜42週までの対応となります。
・育児中ステージ
出産後は、「夜泣き」「授乳」など赤ちゃん特有の不安や悩み、子どもの成長や病気に関する疑問を解決！　安心の「医師監修済みQ&A」はもちろん、子どもの月齢にあわせたおすすめ記事を定期的に配信します。
※育児ステージは、現在は2歳の誕生日までの対応となります。
◆妊娠・育児の先の見通しがカレンダーでわかる
妊娠週数や月齢ごとのまとめや、その時期にやっておきたいことがリストになっているので、スケジュールを立てやすい！
赤ちゃんの成長過程、先の行事などがひと目でわかります。
◆妊娠や育児の基礎情報をまとめてチェック
妊娠中にはベビーカーや抱っこひもなどの出産準備物チェックリスト、名付けのガイド、マタニティヨガ、育児中には授乳ガイドや離乳食・保育園選びに役立つ情報が満載！
検索しなくてもまとまった情報が手に入ります。
ライフスタイルやファッションまで、豊富な記事がそろっています。
◆「妊娠したかも」と思ったときから、2歳の誕生日まで使える
妊娠中から出産後まで1つのアプリでママとパパをしっかりサポートします。
【妊娠中に届く情報】
妊娠初期は妊娠検査薬・つわり・妊婦健診などの情報、妊娠中期は逆子・安定期・胎動、妊娠後期〜出産の期間は陣痛・胎児の状態など、時期に合わせた情報をアプリ内で手に入れることができます。
体調管理や体重管理といったママの身体に関する疑問や、育児日記やアルバムのつくりかたなど気になることは先輩ママの情報で解決！
【育児中に届く情報】
出産後は、夜泣き・母乳など新生児の子育て特有の不安や悩み、赤ちゃんの成長や離乳食・病気に関する情報が満載です！

listings.description:
⋱「ままのて」アプリのおすすめポイント⋰
◆ 妊婦さん＆ママ・パパへ！毎日のメッセージ
妊娠中は、妊婦さんの身体と赤ちゃんの様子がわかるメッセージ「今日のママへ」「今日のパパへ」「今日の赤ちゃん」を毎日配信。産後の育児中には、赤ちゃんの成長やママとパパに役立つ情報を定期配信。妊娠週数・赤ちゃんの成長にあわせた情報を届けることで、妊娠中から子育て中のママとパパをしっかりとサポートします。
※育児中の情報配信は、現在は2歳の誕生日までの対応となります。


◆ 妊娠中・育児中の日記記録、体調管理、体重管理・体重記録ができます
妊娠中の気持ちや体調を日記として記録し、あとから振り返ることができます。体重管理、体重記録もでき母子手帳のようにもご利用いただけますよ。
それに加え、育児中は赤ちゃんの排泄や授乳、離乳食、睡眠等の情報まで記録することができます。

◆ パートナーと連携してママの身体の変化や赤ちゃんの成長を共有
妊娠中のママの体調、ママが記した写真や日記、赤ちゃんの育児お世話記録などをパパとシェアすることができます。ママの身体の変化や赤ちゃんの成長をパートナーと共有することでコミュニケーションを育むことができます。妊娠中は妊婦の身体の変化とお腹の赤ちゃんの成長、産後は赤ちゃんの成長を一緒に楽しんでみてはいかがでしょうか。
※「今日の体重」の記録は共有されません。

◆ 赤ちゃんのイラストとセリフ
妊娠週数と月数がひと目でわかります。妊娠モードは毎日お腹の中で少しずつ成長する赤ちゃんの様子をかわいらしいイラストで表示。育児モードは、赤ちゃんがかわいらしいセリフを毎日伝えてくれますよ。毎週変化する赤ちゃんのイラストは要チェック。約1500種類の楽しく役立つセリフから、日替わりで赤ちゃんがおしゃべりします。

約400人の先輩妊婦さん＆ママへのアンケート結果と、豊富な体験談が読み放題。人には聞けない気になる話題は、体験談をチェック！

bluejetty:00131338:ios.description:
Bringing desktop-grade audio editing, recording, and on-device AI together, SoundLab is a powerful sound editor that lets you edit audio, clean up speech, separate vocals, and mix up to 16 tracks.
SoundLab is more than an audio editor. It is built for the ideas, quick edits, and unexpected creative needs that come up during music and podcast production, so you can start creating anytime, anywhere on your iPhone or iPad.
We won't claim SoundLab replaces a desktop DAW. But it is a serious mobile production tool for the moment the idea arrives and you don't want to open a computer — or wait thirty seconds for a desktop DAW to launch.
Precise Multitrack Audio Editor
• Mix up to 16 tracks with gain, pan, mute, and reordering.
• Copy, cut, paste, trim, insert, replace, split, duplicate, join, move, and more—with unlimited undo/redo.
• Zoom smoothly for millisecond-level selections.
• Loop any range while you work.
• Draw non-destructive volume curves for fades and ducking.
• Record overdubs directly into your project while monitoring playback.
AI Vocal Separator & Vocal Remover
Separate vocals and instrumentals, create acapellas, or make backing tracks with the vocal remover. Karaoke Mode preserves fuller accompaniment. AI runs locally: no uploads or server queue.
AI Stem Separator
Split into four stems—vocals, drums, bass, other—or six with guitar and piano. Preview and balance parts, then export a mix or individual stems.
AI Noise Reducer & Audio Enhancer
Use AI Noise Reducer on recordings or AI Noise Suppression on selected audio. EQ, compression, de-essing, normalization, amplification, and Bass Boost provide enhancement for voice and music.
25+ Selection-Based Effects
Apply 25+ effects to any waveform range, including AI separation and noise suppression, 10-band EQ, Reverb Pro, Tape Delay, Compressor, Change Pitch/Tempo, Fade In/Out, Phaser, Reverse, Silence Remover, and more.
Master Effects
Master Effects run in real time on the mix bus. Adjust tempo, pitch, reverb, and EQ while previewing, then export alternate versions without changing tracks or clips.
Audio Recorder
• Quick Recorder: Capture ideas with your chosen input device.
• Recording Studio: Monitor your mic, set input gain, use a limiter and reverb, and record over a backing track—with or without it in the saved mix.
• Use compatible external microphones and audio interfaces recognized by iOS.
Import, Create & Organize
• Import from Files, Music Library, other apps, or Wi-Fi; extract audio from video.
• Convert text to speech and add, insert, or replace audio in your project.
• Sync audio with iCloud; archive and restore projects through iCloud, USB drives, or external storage.
• Use Video Composer to mix audio with video and create soundtrack videos.
Flexible Export
Export AAC, ALAC, MP3, FLAC, or WAV with selectable channels and sample rates, plus high-bitrate and lossless options. Add metadata and cover art in supported formats. Save to Files or iCloud, share, or export a ringtone.
SoundLab is perfect for:
• Music lovers and independent creators
• Podcast and voice-over producers
• Music students and teachers
• Especially for users who are familiar with Audacity or Audition

bluejetty:00127798:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a beautiful analog bedside clock, with alarms, weather, a sleep timer and widgets. Now rebuilt for iOS 26.
Description:
FaceClock turns your iPhone or iPad into an analog clock you'll actually want on your nightstand, your desk or your kitchen counter.
Twenty clock faces
Pick from four groups: Minimal (bars, dots, rings), Numerals (including Roman, Arabic-Indic and Chinese numbers), 24-Hour dials, and Counter-Clockwise faces that run backwards. Choose a color theme, including a dim red Night theme that won't keep you awake, and a light theme for bright rooms.
Make it yours
Set any wall color or use your own photo as the background, then drag and pinch to frame it. Add the date, the digital time in 12- or 24-hour form, and the current temperature. Drag up or down anywhere on the clock to dim the screen for night-time.
A real alarm
Built on Apple's alarm system, so it rings even when your phone is locked or on silent. Choose the time, which days it repeats and how long snooze lasts.
Sleep timer
Count down with white noise, or an alarm at the end. The timer keeps going on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
Weather on the face
Local temperature and conditions from Apple Weather, right on the dial. Visual effects behind the clock can follow your weather: sunlight, fog, rain or snow.
Hear the time
Have the clock speak the time on the hour, half hour or quarter hour, in your choice of language. Or just double-tap the clock whenever you want to know.
Widgets
Clock widgets for the Home Screen in every size, including extra large on iPad, plus a minimal clock for the Lock Screen. They follow the clock settings you chose in the app.
Also included
Now Playing controls for the Music app · battery ring with charging status · keep-screen-awake for bedside use · full iPad support in portrait and landscape · English and Japanese.

bluejetty:00070782:ios.description:
Spacious’s top-rated real estate app opens the door to all of your residential, commercial, serviced apartment, new development and overseas property needs.
Using our app’s easy to use real estate search options, you can search by price, size, map-view, proximity, landmark, neighborhood, street name, school, new developments and other points of interest.
Once you’ve found what you’ve been looking for, be it a house a home, an apartment, an office, you can chat to local agents and landlords directly using our in-app chat function.
The Spacious app helps you stay on top of your local real estate market with up-to-date listings, price movements, demographics, transport links and instant notifications about new homes in your search area and more. We’ll also bring you the latest overseas investment opportunities.
Helping home seekers make better decisions is our raison d’etre. We do this by giving transparency in a complicated environment. Our diligence and commitment to not compromise on the quality of our listings sets us apart from our competitors. Our passion to help make the real estate industry more transparent comes from our own personal experiences when looking for a new home. We knew there had to be a better way.
We believe everyone has the right to the same information, so we put the right data into the hands of those who need it the most.
The Spacious real estate app has everything you need to help you find a property to buy, sell, rent, let, lease or invest in.
Key features:
• Browse for Hong Kong’s highest quality residential, commercial, serviced apartments and new developments for sale or rent.
• Searching is easy: where you are (via GPS locator) or type in an address, landmark, building, neighborhood
• Save your favorite homes and searches to receive instant notifications when new listings hit the market or when new rentals become available. 
• Connect with a local agent who can help guide you through the buying or selling process.
Additional features:
Search by price, beds, baths, keywords and more
Search by map overlays to see census demographics, schools, transport links, parks etc.
Multilingual Support – Available in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.
With your feed-back we can make our app even better.
We're constantly looking for ways to make our app more useful, so that you can have the best property hunting experience. If you have any feedback about the app or suggestions for future versions, let us know at contact@spacious.hk
Privacy and Legal
We will collect and use your personal information to give you a personalized user experience (e.g. receive saved searches by email) and to promote the services of spacoius.hk and third parties. Our Privacy Policy further explains how we collect, use and disclose personal information and how to access, correct or complain about the handling of personal information. Access our Privacy Policy on: https://www.spacious.hk/en/privacy
Your use of our app is subject to our terms of use, available at https://www.spacious.hk/en/terms

bluejetty:00061283:ios.description:
Company Shortname Required! This app requires a company shortname, which is a unique company identifier which you can get from your company administrator. 
Tada! The new HCMtoGo mobile app is here! Before you jump in and download it be sure to take a look at the following.
*IMPORTANT MESSAGE FOR NEW HCMtoGO USERS*
BEFORE YOU LOGIN - employees and managers:
• If your administrator has not setup the new HCMtoGO app for your organization, you will NOT be able to get access. Please check with your manager or company admin to get access to the new app. 
• When logging in with HCMtoGO you will need to select the region you are using as well as the Company Shortname (The unique Identification number your company administrator needs to provide to you.)
• After you enter that information you will be prompted to enter in your Company, Username, and Password. If you get stuck on this your COMPANY ADMIN can help you out. 
• Companies need to be using approval workflows to process To Do Items. 
• Supported Timesheet Profiles are Bulk Hours and Start/End (All Days) only.
• Administrator should provide their company’s Short Name to users for login.
Now that you are ready to join HCMtoGO here are some of the awesome things you can do within the new app to enhance your human resource needs:
• Check and/or edit your timesheets for accuracy
• Submit and view time off requests
• Check vacation/sick balances
• Enroll in benefits and view existing benefits
• Check your schedule
• View pay stubs and manage direct deposits.
• Check your schedule and, if enabled, swap shifts with peers
Your employer must have the HCMtoGO software configured for mobile use. Contact your system administrator for more details. 
Key things to know as an administrator: 
• Users need to have permission to access the new app via their security profile. 
• Users need to be permissioned to have access via their UI Preferences widget within their security profile. 
• Companies need to be using approval workflows to process To Do Items. 
• Supported Timesheet Profiles are Bulk Hours and Start/End (All Days) only.
• Administrator should provide their company’s Short Name to users for login.
• Basic Authentication with SSO is not currently supported

bluejetty:00153906:ios.description:
Unleash Your Inner Artist with Glow Art Drawing - Doodle App!
Dive into a mesmerizing world of light and color! Glow Art Drawing - Doodle App is your ultimate creative playground for crafting stunning, unique artworks using vibrant, glowing strokes. Whether you want to create captivating images or dynamic video art, this app makes it easy and fun. Effortlessly doodle intricate designs or simple sketches that come alive with luminous effects, resulting in incredible digital drawing and art.
What Makes Glow Art Shine?
This application provides an intuitive platform where your imagination takes center stage. Glow effects add a touch of wonder to every line you draw. It's designed for everyone – from aspiring artists discovering their passion to experienced creators looking for a fresh medium. Create personalized glowing messages, design unique avatars, illustrate fantastical scenes, or simply unwind with relaxing digital doodling. Share your unique creations easily with friends, family, or on your favorite social media platforms, spreading the beauty of light art.
Your Art Gallery!
Never lose track of your masterpieces! The integrated "Artwork" section acts as your portfolio, automatically saving and listing all your completed projects. Watch your skills evolve as you fill your gallery with dazzling glow creations. It’s the perfect way to review your progress and revisit your favorite pieces of drawing.
Feature Highlights - Experience the Magic!
• Intuitive Glow Doodle Interface: Start creating instantly! Our easy-to-use controls let you doodle with light effortlessly, making complex effects simple to achieve.
• Dynamic Glow Stroke Engine: Experience our core technology! Draw lines that pulse, shimmer, and glow with adjustable intensity and style. It feels like pure magic!
• Rich Color Palettes: Choose from a wide spectrum of vibrant colors specifically designed to enhance the glow effect, making your art pop.
• Image & Video Artwork Creation: Don't just draw, animate! Turn your static glow doodles into simple, captivating video sequences or export high-resolution images for versatile drawing uses.
• Save & Manage Projects: Your 'Artwork' gallery keeps everything organized. Save projects in various formats, perfect for storage or further editing.
Summary & Get Started!
Glow Art Drawing - Doodle App is more than just a drawing tool; it's an experience! With its unique glow effects, user-friendly interface, image and video capabilities, and easy sharing options, it’s the perfect app to explore your creativity. Whether you're looking to relax, have fun, or create serious digital art, the power is in your hands.
Download Glow Art Drawing - Doodle App today and start creating your own luminous masterpieces. Let your imagination glow and make some drawing magic!
If you have any questions or contributions to the app, do not hesitate to contact us via email: feedback.outlaw@bralyvn.com. We value your contributions and will do our best to meet all requirements and improve product quality.
Terms of Use: https://bralyvn.com/term-and-condition.php
Privacy Policy: https://bralyvn.com/privacy-policy.php

Is lust, explicit sexual imagery, or sexual compulsivity affecting your mental health? What about your self-esteem or your relationships? Studies have found that compulsive explicit sexual imagery use can lead to depression, anxiety, stress, and worse sexual performance.
If you are struggling to quit compulsive sexual habits, Fortify is here to equip you with tools, education, lifestyle coaching, teletherapy, and a community of others who know what you’re going through, to assist you in moving forward in your fight toward lasting freedom.
It's more than just a band-aid or a filter. Through research-based principles of therapeutic lifestyle change, our mission is to help spark an uprising among people who are tired of sexually explicit imagery messing with their lives – and ready to stop and turn toward something better.
Based on your personalized assessment, Fortify provides videos and challenges to help guide your progress. Sleek tracking features, analytics, and customizable goal tracking ensure you celebrate your victories and learn from your mistakes.
And these science-based methods work! But don’t take our word for it.
Our users have had this to say:
"There is no shaming, just calm but direct encouragement and understanding..."
"The app helps you celebrate small milestones. It's important to celebrate progress, not perfection, when dealing with addiction."
"Fortify does not tell you, ‘Oh you need to try harder.’ It takes your addiction seriously, and actually gives you tools and inspiration to help you get through a rough time."
"Not only Fortify helped me with nofap and staying away from sexual compulsivity, the app has also kept me more organized with my goals! I've been studying and exercising more which has lifted my mood!"
You're not alone. Join tens of thousands from around the world using Fortify to find healing and recovery from sexual compulsivity.
Feedback? Questions? Contact us at info@joinfortify.com

bluejetty:00182481:ios.description:
Welcome to the Deco App — the perfect way to set up your mesh WiFi in minutes and control your whole network.
Our simple-to-follow guide walks you through the setup process and even gives you suggestions for whole home coverage.
Once connected, you’ll have instant access to check every connected device, manage your kids’ online activity, and control your home network effortlessly. All from the palm of your hand.
- EASY TO SET UP AND MANAGE
• Quickly set up with step-by-step instructions
• Find the best spots to place additional Deco units for maximum coverage
• Control your WiFi network without turning on your computer
• Check your connection status and network speed at a glance
• Find out who or what is connecting to your network
• Instantly block unwanted devices with a tap
- PROTECT YOUR WIFI
• Detect potential threats and receive warnings before things get serious
• Create a guest network to give friends internet access while shielding your private network
• Block unauthorized access and inappropriate content
• Run network performance tests
- FIND FAMILY TIME WITH PARENTAL CONTROLS
• Set a time restriction and pause the WiFi on kids’ devices
• Control when specific devices have WiFi access
• Make room for more family time with Schedules
- PRIORITIZE YOUR FAVORITE DEVICES
QoS lets you choose which devices always have the fastest connections. Set a schedule to assign device priority for different times of the day.
- KNOW EVERYTHING ABOUT YOUR NETWORK
Detailed reports help you understand your home WiFi and everything connected.
- CREATE YOUR SMART HOME
Connect, control, and check the status of your smart cameras, plugs, and lights – all from the Deco app. 
Features available in Deco may vary by model and software version. Stay tuned for updates as we add new features and products to the Deco family!

Term of Use: http://www.tp-link.com/en/privacy?app=deco#sec_b\

It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Heritage Valley Mobile Banking:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Heritage Valley Mobile Banking app, you must be enrolled as a Heritage Valley Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00155900:ios.description:
The Hawaiian Electric or HECO mobile application is a great way to view information on known outages for the islands of Oahu, Maui, Hawaii, Lanai, and Molokai. Get up-to-date outage information, such as areas impacted; number of customers affected; and estimated restoration time. Receive important information from Hawaiian Electric with our alert and news notification service. Be advised of outages near your current location, using the geolocation feature on your mobile device and sign up for alerts on a specific outage. You can also report an outage directly or get access to the county-specific trouble lines from the mobile application.
You can access your online account to view your electric bill, as well as stop/move your electric service if needed. Payments can be made directly from your checking account or with a credit card through Speedpay. You can also start new electrical service. 
In addition, you can access an interactive map to find any of our electric vehicle (EV) fast chargers across the islands we service. The map allows you to find a fast charger close to you and receive information about the charger type and location. Step-by-step driving instructions are also available to help you get to your EV fast charger quickly!

bluejetty:00160278:ios.description:
Learn Japanese from hiragana to JLPT N1 with structured lessons for vocabulary, kanji, grammar, listening, reading, and review — all in one app.
Coban is designed for learners who want to understand Japanese, not simply memorize it. Learn grammar and vocabulary in context, recognize patterns, and build the skills you need to understand and use Japanese naturally.
— STUDY FROM N5 TO N1
Follow a structured learning path from beginner Japanese to advanced JLPT content.
• 7,500+ vocabulary words 
• 2,100+ kanji 
• 490+ grammar points 
• 2,500+ example sentences 
• JLPT N5, N4, N3, N2, and N1 content
— LEARN WITH AUDIO
More than 12,000 audio recordings help you connect written Japanese with natural pronunciation.
Listen to vocabulary and example sentences, practice shadowing, and strengthen your listening comprehension as you study.
— REVIEW WHAT YOU LEARN
Use quizzes and SRS review to reinforce vocabulary, kanji, and grammar and focus your study on what you need to remember.
— STUDY JAPANESE OFFLINE
Coban’s learning content is stored on your device, so you can continue studying even without an internet connection.
— BUILT FOR REAL JAPANESE
Coban goes beyond JLPT test preparation. Lessons are designed to help you see how Japanese works in context so you can apply what you learn to reading, listening, conversation, and everyday communication.
Whether you are just starting Japanese or working toward JLPT N1, Coban gives you a complete Japanese study library you can keep using as your skills grow.

bluejetty:00135165:ios.description:
Welcome to the LEKFIT online studio! Your complete fitness method. Created by former professional dancer + celebrity instructor and named best in specialty fitness.
Eliminate the boredom and bring on the fun, as we take the guesswork out of your fitness routine. New workouts delivered daily, so all you have to do is press play!
LEKFIT is a strategically curated fitness method that features dynamic movement designed to work the full body. With new daily workouts, LEKFIT offers low impact, high intensity, fat burning cardio with muscle sculpting techniques created to strengthen and tone. The LEKFIT online studio brings you musically driven, results proven, fun and challenging workouts that create a complete fitness experience.
Pioneering the rebounder cardio fitness movement, the LEKFIT method brings you the most effective and beneficial cardio work with rebounder (trampoline) cardio.
Enjoy the LEKFIT method anytime + anywhere with seven new workouts, seven days a week.
Along with the daily release, you’ll gain access to the exclusive LEKFIT library with an extensive variety of content.
+ rebounder cardio
+ strength training
+ muscle sculpting & stretching
+ pre/post-natal modifications
+ community & expert support
+ travel friendly
enjoy a seven day free trial
To access all features and content you can subscribe to LEKFIT online studio on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app. Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In-app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://digital.lekfit.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://digital.lekfit.com/privacy

Run multiple stopwatches at once. Keep separate times for training, work or everyday tasks, then save and share your results.
MULTIPLE STOPWATCHES
• Run unlimited stopwatches simultaneously
• Give each stopwatch a name and color, and drag to reorder
• Choose single-stopwatch mode to stop the others when you start one
• Show or hide milliseconds for each stopwatch
LAPS + NOTES
• Record lap and split times, and add a comment to any lap
• Edit a completed lap's duration; the total time updates automatically
• Undo the last duration edit
• Compare the fastest and slowest laps in a summary above the list once you have at least two completed laps
• Delete a lap or merge its time into the current lap
FOLDERS + BULK ACTIONS
• Group stopwatches into folders for work, training or other activities
• Start, stop or reset all stopwatches in a folder

FOCUS MODE

EXPORT + BACKUP
• Export CSV files for Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets
• Share results as a PDF report or an image
• Open export directly from a stopwatch or choose several from settings
• Back up, restore and transfer selected stopwatches using a file
SIRI SHORTCUTS
• Create, start, and stop stopwatches by voice
• Build automations in the Shortcuts app
CUSTOMIZATION
• Choose preset or custom colors and a compact or regular layout
• Change the app icon and use dark mode
• Follow your system text size with Dynamic Type
IPHONE & IPAD
• Layouts adapt to the window size, with the list and selected stopwatch side by side when space allows

bluejetty:00097506:ios.name: Hidden Objects: Mystic Woods
bluejetty:00097506:ios.summary: "Enchanted Stories: Mystic Woods" – uncover ancient magic and secrets in thrilling hidden object games! Step into Rose's shoes as she embarks on an epic quest to protect the fading magic of the Mystic Woods. With axes rising and the forest
bluejetty:00097506:ios.description:
"Enchanted Stories: Mystic Woods" – uncover ancient magic and secrets in thrilling hidden object games! Step into Rose's shoes as she embarks on an epic quest to protect the fading magic of the Mystic Woods. With axes rising and the forest in peril, you must use your skills to solve magic puzzles, find hidden objects, and save the forest from destruction. Your journey will take you through search and find games and enchanting locations, where danger lurks and mysteries await. Can you solve the mystery and save the enchanted forest from the ruthless lumberjack threat?
When Rose ventures into the Mystic Woods to help her grandmother, she discovers a devastating truth: the forest’s magic is fading, and a ruthless logging pact threatens to destroy its very soul. There’s no choice for Rose other than to embrace her grandmother’s legacy and become a guardian. But who would have thought that Little Red Beauty would be accompanied on this dangerous quest by none other than a lone, brooding wolf? The fate of the forest now lies in the hands of the unlikely duo - and yours! Can you find a cure for the ancient trolls? Clean the magical river and save the sirens who call it home? Soothe the tensions with the local werewolf pack before conflict ignites? Of course, you won't have to do it alone: befriend the creatures of the forest and enlist their help! But beware... the lumberjacks are already sharpening their axes.
- Mystical Adventures Await!
Explore detailed locations as you find hidden objects in every corner of the enchanted forest. These exciting search and find games offer endless fun with challenging scenes full of cleverly concealed items. Use your sharp eye to uncover secrets vital to Rose's journey!
- Solve Magic Puzzles and Mini-Games!
Solve magic puzzles that will test your wits and unlock mystical powers. Each puzzle is a piece of the larger mystery, and only by solving these finding object games you can protect the forest from destruction!
- Shape Your Story with Your Choices!
Your decisions will affect the path of Rose, Wolfgang, and the Mystic Woods. This search and find game lets you control the outcome by making important choices that influence the fate of the forest. Can you lead characters to a happy ending? Only your keen eye for find hidden objects and magic puzzles can reveal the answer!
- Collectibles and Achievements to Unlock!
As you progress through the game, keep an eye out for hidden collectibles and special items that can help you in your journey. Every achievement you unlock will bring you closer to mastering the art of hidden object games. Challenge yourself to find hidden objects scattered throughout the forest and prove you’re worthy of the forest's magic!
Will you rise to the challenge and restore the fading magic of the Mystic Woods? The forest is waiting in the free trial of the "Enchanted Stories: Mystic Woods"!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00080701:ios.description:

**أهم الميزات الجديدة:**
كوزرات تفاعلية وذكية
اختبر نفسك بأسئلة متنوعة وتابع أخطائك بكل سهولة حتى تتقن المادة تمامًا.
تحليل دقيق لأدائك
يعرفك على المواد والمواضيع اللي تحتاج تراجعها أكثر، حتى تدرس بذكاء مو بكثرة.
نظام مؤقت مستوحى من تقنية البرومودو
نظم وقتك بالمذاكرة واستفاد من كل دقيقة بطريقة فعالة.
إشعارات قوية ومفيدة

حافظ على استمراريتك بالدراسة يوم بعد يوم وشوف تقدمك يزداد قدام عينك.

شاهد قوائم تشغيل مخصصة مرتبة حسب الكتاب والموضوع حتى ما تضيع وقتك بالبحث.
قسم الأساتذة والمدرّسين

يساعدك تخطط، تراجع، وتوصل للنتيجة اللي تحلم بيها بخطوات منظمة وسهلة.

مجاني بالكامل – سهل، منظم، ومناسب لكل طالب سادس إعدادي بالعراق.

bluejetty:00179189:ios.description:
VK Mail: email client for Yandex, Gmail, Rambler, Mail.ru , Outlook.com and other email services. Nothing superfluous, just emails.
Minimalistic design. There is nothing superfluous in the VK Mail app, such as ads. Just what you need for comfortable work with emails. 
Smart sorting. VK Mail automatically sorts newsletters, notifications from social nets, news and emails to yourself into folders. Everything is neatly organized and easy to find. 
Custom filters. Set your own filters for a clean and orderly inbox. You can set them so that emails from the selected senders are moved straight to dedicated folders or trash and are marked as read. 
The unsubscribe wizard. All your newsletters are collected on one page to make it easy to unsubscribe from the ones you don't need. Go to your account settings, select "Manage Newsletters" and unsubscribe from those newsletters which you don't read. 
Reliable protection. Powerful spam filters and email login confirmation via SMS, PIN, Touch ID or Face ID. You can choose an access protection method in the app settings and settings for personal data. 
All email accounts in one place. If you already have an account with Mail.ru, Gmail, Yahoo, Yandex or another service, connect them in the VK Mail app and switch between them in a couple of taps. To add an account, tap “”Account” and “+”. 
Quick swipe actions. You can work with emails without even opening them! Swipe the message from left to right and select an action for this gesture: delete the message, mark it as read or move to spam. 
Sending large files. You can attach an entire movie or all photos from your vacation to an email: VK Mail can send files up to 2GB without compressing them and turning them into links. 
Cool themes from VK. Themes from VK will help you express your style and give your inbox an appealing look without distracting attention from emails. And there is also a dark theme to make reading emails at night more comfortable. You can choose a design in the account settings. 
Catchy address. Come up with a terse and expressive name with the domain @vk.com, and your email will be easy to remember — both for you and your recipients. 
Download VK Mail, configure it as you like, and use it as a single email client for accounts from any services: Gmail, Yandex, Rambler, Mail.ru and many others.

bluejetty:00079624:android.description:
🌟 Enter the Mr World International Contest
Step into an inspiring global arena where confidence, talent, and determination define the path to victory. Mr World International Contest invites you to represent your country, take on dynamic challenges, and compete against skilled contenders from around the world. This experience blends creativity, strategy, and interactive mini-games into a fun and motivating journey. 🌍
🏅 Prove Your Strength, Skills & Versatility
The road to the crown is more than appearance—it’s about showing well-rounded ability. Face challenges that test cooking talent, athletic performance, decision-making, and quick reactions. Each round introduces new surprises that push you to adapt, grow, and outperform your rivals. 💪🔥
🍳 Explore Creative & Skill-Based Activities
Step into hands-on tasks that highlight your versatility. Prepare dishes, complete timed objectives, and showcase resourcefulness in themed challenges. These moments blend creativity with focused gameplay, offering a calm yet engaging rhythm. 🥗🎨

Demonstrate speed, agility, and stamina across fast-paced activities designed to test your athletic edge. Run, react, and dodge obstacles as you aim to stay ahead of your competitors. Each performance helps build your contestant’s reputation on the international stage. 🏃♂️💥
🧠 Solve Quick-Thinking Mini-Challenges
Sharpen your mind with puzzles and rapid-decision tasks that reward intuition and strategy. These short, satisfying challenges add variety and offer light brain-training moments that keep the competition exciting. 🧩⚡
🎉 Experience the Ceremony-to-Finale Journey
From the grand opening ceremony to the final awarding of the crown, every stage is packed with energy, anticipation, and interactive moments. Build momentum, win rounds, and rise through the ranks as you inch closer to becoming the next Mr World titleholder. 🏆🌟

🌍 Represent Your Nation – Step onto a global stage with pride
🎭 Compete in Diverse Rounds – Cooking, athletics, speed tests & more
🍳 Show Your Skills – Creative dishes & hands-on challenges
🏃 Athletic Tasks – Test agility, stamina & timing
🧠 Brain-Boosting Moments – Quick thinking puzzles & mini-games
🏆 Claim the Crown – Outperform rivals to become the ultimate winner
🌟 Rise Above the Competition
Download Mr World International Contest and take on an exciting blend of skill-based challenges, global competition, and uplifting progress. Whether you enjoy casual mini-games, creative tasks, or competitive simulation gameplay, this journey delivers a fun and motivating experience from start to finish. 🌍🏅✨

bluejetty:00019574:ios.description:
Download the GetYourGuide app to discover and book unforgettable travel experiences anywhere in the world
Whether you're planning a vacation or looking for last-minute things to do in any destination, we make booking tours, day trips, and activities easier than ever. Choose from culture, food, adventure, nature, and more experiences.
Maximize your trip with exclusive access to the world's top attractions and museums, find the highlights and hidden gems, and keep up with last-minute travel deals using the app — we make travel planning easy, and making memories easier.
Find over 75,000 experiences
Booking tickets for unmissable sights has never been easier — experience the Colosseum, Eiffel Tower, London Eye, TV Tower, Sagrada Familia, and more.
Discover expert-guided tours — explore unforgettable travel highlights in Paris, Dubai, London, Florence, New York City, Berlin, Vienna, New Orleans, Cancun, Tuscany, Lisbon, and more. Our app will be your city guide for destinations around the world, and our local experts help you get fully immersed.
Travel with flexibility
Reserve now, pay later — save your place for popular experiences early and make your payment at a later date.
Instant confirmation — whether you're booking tours in advance or need last-minute tickets, receive your tickets and booking confirmation instantly.
Offline tickets — Conveniently access your booking information offline. Download, store, and present your tickets on your mobile device
Book with confidence
24/7 customer service — Easily find help when you have questions. We offer customer service by email, phone, and in the app across multiple languages.
Flexible cancellation — Don’t stress if your plans change. We offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before your activity for most bookings.
With tours and activities for any interest, you can plan your trips your way. Dive into nature and explore fjords in Norway, try local cuisine across Europe, or uncover fascinating history in the United States.
Whether you're living the magic of the wizarding world on a Harry Potter experience, savoring delicious culinary delights on a food tour of Barcelona, booking top rated tours to see the Vatican, or following a city guide through Berlin, we guarantee you'll find something unforgettable to do — make the most of your travel and leisure time.
Uncover the top tourist activities in the world's bucket-list destinations:
Book museum tours and tickets in Rome, food trips through Naples, trekking in Iceland, river cruises around Prague, outdoor adventures in Bali, sightseeing in Budapest, and more.
Use the app as a travel planner or for travel guidance, then book travel experiences for the world's must-see highlights with excursions and last-minute tickets.
Tell us how we’re doing
Leave us a review if you’re enjoying your GetYourGuide app experience or head over to our help page for further assistance: www.getyourguide.com/contact

bluejetty:00179075:ios.description:
Create your own personal soundboard with audio clips from friends, family, your files, and the web.
Record a sound, import audio from your device, or use the iOS share sheet to add supported audio files directly to Sound Box. Tap any sound to play it instantly, or play multiple sounds at once for layered reactions, effects, and voice clips.
Keep your soundboard organized with folders, colorful tags, search, sorting, and drag-and-drop ordering. Customize tags with colors and images, sync your sounds with iCloud, and play favorites faster from Home Screen widgets or Shortcuts.
Features:

Your Life Path number repres
bluejetty:00145698:ios.description:
Numerology is an esoteric science of numbers and information derived from your date of birth and your name that will help you get a better understanding of yourself, your talents, virtues and your shortcomings.
Your Life Path number represents the path you'll take in this life. It is the single most important element in your numerological chart and it should be given the most attention. The Life Path number describes our life purpose – the main lesson we chose to learn during this lifetime.
Your Expression (or Destiny) number is the second most important number in your chart. It describes your natural talents, skills and potential. These are the gifts that we should use in the best possible ways while we move along our life path.
Your Soul Urge (or Heart's Desire) number describes your inner needs and urges. It’s a subtle number and its traits aren't always visible from the outside. It tells us what we should give to our soul for it to be happy and fulfilled.
The Attitude number describes our attitude, the traits we're known for. It gives us strength and drives us to overcome many life circumstances in an easier or more difficult way. If something's not right in your life, first take a look at this number and try to adjust to the potential of your attitude number.
Day of birth number, or our spiritual or talent number, helps us see what other talents, abilities, and skills we possess. This number has the greatest impact while we are in the most active period of life (25 to 55 years old).
The Maturity number refers to the period of maturity and describes what awaits us later in life.
The Personality number shows what sort of self-image you display to the world. We often consciously (sometimes unconsciously) decide how to present ourselves to the world – what to hide, and what to show. Therefore, this number doesn't describe our inner selves, but what is visible from the outside and how others perceive us.
Personal year, personal month, and personal day are described in the numerology forecast chart, also known as Numeroscope (horoscope in astrology). Numerology forecast chart, as well as astrology horoscope, will give you a forecast of events for a given year, month, and day. Although Numerology provides plenty of information, there is no possibility of predicting what kind of choices a person will make in life, nor can we conclusively determine whether his or her life will be resolved positively or negatively. Numeroscope, like horoscope, gives guidance and advice, and it's up to you whether you will follow them.
Comparative analysis of partners, or synastry, tells about the compatibility of partners. The synastry chart is based on the dates of birth. This comparative analysis doesn't have to be for an emotional partner, it can also be applied to work and friendships, as well as any other kind of relationship.
Daily affirmations, as a very powerful tool, have the purpose of making our days easier and encouraging us on the road to achieving our goals. Inspirational messages and affirmations for every day are carefully selected and in line with the personal day.
Crystals, gems or semi-precious stones have been used since the ancient times because of their beneficial energy. Numerology app contains recommendations of crystals for each life path / personal number, as well as a recommendation for a personal year. Crystals help us raise our energy and vibration, provide happiness, abundance, protection and wisdom.
The way you lead your life depends on you, while Numerology app is here to guide you to a better, happier and more fulfilling life.
Numerology app generates a Pythagorean numerology chart. This app can also be used as a numerology calculator.

bluejetty:00093070:ios.description:
Book, track and pay for your Liberty Yellow ride all within the app. Receive a notification when your driver arrives and rate your ride on the go. With 375 vehicles at your demand, we are here to provide transportation for your need in Buffalo, NY and surrounding areas.
Liberty Yellow is the leading provider of taxi ride services in Buffalo, New York USA.
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Liberty Yellow application.
Key Features of the Liberty Yellow application include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call Liberty Yellow with the push of a button
To begin using the Liberty Yellow application today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip 
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The Liberty Yellow application retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Liberty Yellow application or calling us at +1 716-877-7111. 
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the Liberty Yellow application in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00183104:ios.name: Binary.1001
bluejetty:00183104:ios.summary: Binary.1001 is a challenging logic puzzle that helps relieve stress and pass the time when you are on a bus, on an airplane, or simply have nothing to do. Continuous puzzle solving also helps increase IQ levels and helps prevent age-related
bluejetty:00183104:ios.description:
Binary.1001 is a challenging logic puzzle that helps relieve stress and pass the time when you are on a bus, on an airplane, or simply have nothing to do. Continuous puzzle solving also helps increase IQ levels and helps prevent age-related brain diseases. According to studies, people who solve puzzles from time to time are less susceptible to diseases such as senile dementia and Alzheimer's disease. In our program, we have created for you more than 6 thousand unique levels. All levels are divided into different levels of difficulty. Each difficulty level contains 1001 puzzles. If this is your first time playing this game, try the very first level of the easiest level of difficulty. If you can easily solve level 1001, go to the next level of difficulty.
Rules
In this puzzle, there are only zeros and ones, some of the cells are already filled, the rest must be filled by you. Your goal is to determine which cells are zeros and which are ones.
Each puzzle must be solved in accordance with the following rules:
* Each cell must contain zero or one.
* No more than two similar numbers below or next to each other are allowed.
* Each row and column must contain an equal number of zeros and ones.
* Each row is unique, and each column is unique.
Each puzzle has only one solution. You can always find this solution without guessing.
Good luck!

bluejetty:00023802:ios.description:
Tired of Googling every ingredient and still bloating after dinner? FODMAP Snap turns "is this safe?" into a 2-second answer — personalized to YOUR gut, not a generic list.
MOST APPS HAND YOU A FOOD LIST. THIS ONE FINDS YOUR TRIGGERS.
Other FODMAP apps are static lookups. FODMAP Snap learns from how YOU feel. Log a meal, log how your gut reacts, and the AI pinpoints which foods are actually causing your symptoms — bloating, gas, pain — so you stop guessing.
SCAN ANY MEAL, ANY WAY
- Photo: snap your plate for instant FODMAP analysis
- Voice or text: just say or type what you ate
- Barcode: scan packaged groceries in the aisle
- Quick Check: verify a food without logging it (menus, shopping)
YOUR DAILY GUT DIARY
A clean timeline of everything you eat, with a daily FODMAP exposure bar that shows your cumulative load across all 7 FODMAP groups — weighted by your personal sensitivities and portion sizes. Calendar strip to review any day.
AI THAT CONNECTS THE DOTS
Feeling off but don't know why? Log a symptom and the app traces it back across recent meals to find the likely culprit. Over time it surfaces patterns, food stacking, and timing correlations most people would never spot.
LEARNS YOUR SENSITIVITY PROFILE
Across fructose, lactose, fructans, GOS, sorbitol and mannitol, the app builds a confidence-scored profile of what YOUR body tolerates — and updates it as you track.
BUILT FOR SIBO & IBS
A dedicated SIBO mode adds fermentable-starch and IMO warnings generic trackers miss. Whether you're in elimination, reintroduction, or maintenance — it adapts.
RECIPES THAT KNOW YOUR GUT
160+ low-FODMAP recipes with "Safe for you" / "Caution" badges based on your profile. Import any recipe from a URL, photo, PDF, or type it in — get a full FODMAP breakdown instantly.
ALSO INCLUDED
- Portion guidance (serving size changes everything)
- Follow-up questions: "What can I substitute?"
- Saved foods for one-tap re-logging
- Available in 13 languages
HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan a meal — photo, voice, text, or barcode
2. Log how you feel with one tap
3. Let the AI find your personal trigger patterns
4. Eat with confidence
Other apps give you a database. FODMAP Snap gives you answers.
---
Not intended to replace medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional before making dietary changes. Questions? support@fodmapsnap.com

bluejetty:00071754:ios.description:
Meteo Calc is an app that analyzes the current weather status. 
 Analyze atmospheric conditions with temperature, humidity and air pressure, obtain data such as dew point, wet bulb temperature, air density, vapor pressure, and enthalpy.
 Combining temperature, humidity or dew point temperature to calculate comfort index or to scientifically adjust indoor temperature and humidity. 
 Use barometer value, temperature and sea level air pressure to calculate altitude.
APP is mainly divided into the following five parts:
1. Current,forecast: Obtain the local current weather in real-time, and calculate related data based on the weather
 1. Temperature, Apparent temperature
 2. Dew point, wet bulb temperature
 3. Relative humidity, absolute humidity
 4. Wind,Wind gust
 5. Sea level pressure, barometer pressure

bluejetty:00013681:ios.description:
FEATURES
On-demand Amharic Audio. Plus Geez, ASB, KJV and WEB bibles
* Lean the Geez language by using parallel text screens
* Verse by verse Cross References for all included Bible translations
* Highlight a verse(s), then touch the Cross-Ref icon to see related verses for selection
* Chapter subtitles in all Amharic and Geez Bible books, OT and NT
* Many color-coded section/topic title cross reference links to which open in a separate window
* Section titles and mini content references that open in new windows
* Selecting a verse in cross reference windows to top open whole Bible in popup content screen
* Search by: verses only, titles only, or verses plus subtitles
* View your Bookmarks in Search results, Mini-content...
* Great tool for serious Amharic, Geez Bible Study users, and beginners alike
* Select verses and Copy, Bookmark, and share to Facebook...
* Type in Geez to Search or to Add Notes (if no Geez keyboard installed)
* Track Reading History
* Chapter Notes: paste or type in Geez and/or Latin
* Share to Facebook, Twitter, Flickr, SMS, Mail...
On-demand audio requires Internet connection, it downloads a whole book at once and and then to it offline. Best to be on WIFI when downloading, some books are large. If your device does not have storage limitations, use our other Amharic Bible app with offline Audio allowing you to listen any book chapter at any time with no Internet required. When you are done listening to a book, you can delete the temporary files using the popup.
We are grateful to Bible.org and the Ethiopian Bible Society and our appreciation to geezexperience.com. The English Bible translations ASB, KJV and WEB are in the public domain, God bless those who made it possible. We are grateful for the many groups of volunteers who work tirelessly to make the quality and accuracy of the app possible - BLESS YOU!
For more info: visit WongelAdvocate.com (Living Word Gospel Ministry)

bluejetty:00128788:ios.description:
Get ready to rev your engines and experience the ultimate drag racing rush! Hit the streets of cities worldwide in your very own customizable car, and choose from a range of modes and challenges that will keep you on the edge of your seat. With our cutting-edge 360° camera, you'll feel like you're right in the driver's seat.
Try Street Drag 2 – Real Car Racing Online Today!
Multiple Drag Race Modes
The car racing simulator game offers a plethora of modes, including Race, Ladder, Tournament, Tier, and more. Each mode has its own unique challenges, and you'll have to use all your skills to emerge victorious. With so many different racing games options to choose from, you'll never get bored of this real driving simulator. There is no limit to the fun!
Fine Tune Your Car with Car Customization
Are you a mechanic at heart? Then you'll love the advanced settings in the car customization garage. From torque curve to mechanical efficiency, drivetrain type to wheel dimensions, you can fine-tune every aspect of your car to achieve the perfect ride. And if you're not an expert, don't worry - you can let our drag racing game do the rest.
Of course, it's not just about the mechanics - you'll also want to make your car look great. With a huge selection of wheels, spoilers, decals, and colors, you can customize your ride to your heart's content. And with our 360° camera, you'll be able to admire your handiwork from every angle.
Get an Edge on the Competition with Real-Time Stats
Take your drag racing skills to the next level by accessing real-time stats on your vehicle's engine power, tractive force, weight distribution upon acceleration, estimated time and speed for a quarter mile, ideal engine rpm to shift gears, and much more. Gain a competitive edge by analyzing and fine-tuning every aspect of your ride to maximize your speed and performance on the track.
MODES of Street Drag 2 – Real Car Racing Online
Drag Racer game has a wide variety of modes, with many exciting tournament and challenge formats, including:
- Race: Enter a drag race where you get to choose the mode, distance and difficulty.
- Ladder: Climb to the top of the ladder. Each stage, your opponents will be tougher to beat and you will be able to earn bigger prizes.
- Tournament: Race in a local tournament where the money you win each race goes into a pot. The winner takes all.
- Tier: Race against other drag racer cars from each Tier, customized to the max.
- Championship: Qualify for the next round of the Drag Championships and advance to the next Tier.
Take on the world in real-time multiplayer car games mode, where you can challenge your friends or face off against other players from around the globe. Unlike other racing games, this drag racer game saves your progress in the cloud, you can pick up where you left off no matter where you are.
Whether you're a die-hard car lover or a casual player, the racing simulator offers the most realistic and thrilling drag race experience out there. Download Street Drag 2 – Real Car Racing Online for free now and get ready to feel the rush!

bluejetty:00023654:ios.description:
Maximize your Hersheypark® experience with The Official Hersheypark Mobile App! Find information on rides, attractions, entertainment, food, shopping, and more for Hersheypark, ZooAmerica® North American Wildlife Park, and Hershey's Chocolate World Attraction. Plus, navigate through the Park with our customizable map and create an HPGO account to view personalized ride stats and ride photos.
Map Features
- Show and hide attractions of interest to customize your own map of Hersheypark and ZooAmerica
- Use the ‘Get Directions’ function for turn-by-turn navigation to any location*
- Create ride wait time alerts for your favorite rides
- Easily locate important services such as Ticketing Services, First Aid, Accessibility, Lost Children, Lost & Found, Barking Lot Day Kennel, and more
- Locate restrooms, ATMs, lockers, smoking gazebos, and stroller/wheelchair rentals
HPGO Features
- Create and manage your HPGO account to collect ride stats, view ride photos, and connect your Fast Track purchases
- Personalize your experience through your HPGO profile
- Create reminder alerts for your favorite shows
- Create a to-do list
Attraction Details
- Learn detailed information about all rides, shows, games, shops, services
- View current ride information including closed rides and ride wait times
- Search function to help find information about attractions
- Filter/sort results by height, distance, name, and more
- View daily entertainment and Hershey Character appearance schedules
- Find information on food and drinks, including menus, ingredients and allergens
- View hours for area attractions, including Hershey's Chocolate World Attraction, Hershey Story Museum, and more
*Continued use of GPS running in the background may decrease battery life.

Why Moto Watchdog?
Our app is more than just a tracking tool; it’s a commitment to your security and convenience. With Moto Watchdog, you’re not just tracking your vehicles or assets; you’re taking a step towards smarter, safer, and more efficient management.
Whether you’re a concerned parent, a frequent traveler, or a business manager, Moto Watchdog is tailored to meet your needs. Download now and join thousands of users who trust us for their tracking needs.

Embark on a journey of skill and strategy as you tackle challenging card layouts, aiming to stack the suits in ascending order. Whether you're a seasoned solitaire pro or a newcomer to the game, Jolly Solitaire offers an experience that is both engaging and rewarding. Exercise your mind, test your wits, and enjoy hours of endless fun with this classic card game.

Key Features:
* Classic Klondike Solitaire gameplay: Enjoy the traditional solitaire experience that has captivated players for generations.
* Fun and addictive: Delve into a world of cards and challenges that will keep you coming back for more.
* Suitable for all ages: Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned player, Jolly Solitaire offers entertainment for everyone.
* Modern design: Experience solitaire in a sleek and user-friendly interface designed to enhance your gaming experience.
* Engaging gameplay: Test your skills, strategize your moves, and conquer the deck in a quest for victory.
* Endless Challenges: New card layouts and daily challenges ensure a unique experience in every session.

Download Jolly Solitaire now and rediscover the joy of classic card gaming in the palm of your hand. Join countless players worldwide who have embraced the thrill of solitaire with Jolly Solitaire. Get ready to shuffle, stack, and win your way to success!

Thank you for choosing Jolly Solitaire - where every deal holds the promise of endless entertainment and fun-filled moments. Let the cards fall in your favor as you embark on a solitaire adventure like no other! 

Jolly Solitaire starts with a free plan, and you can easily upgrade. If you choose to purchase a subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple’s App Store account, and your account will be charged within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time. For more information, please visit our Privacy Policy(https://jollysolitaire.com/privacy-policy.html) and Terms of Use(https://jollysolitaire.com/terms-of-use.html).

Your experience is important to us. Please share your feedback at jollysolitaire@gmail.com. Help us make Jolly Solitaire even better!

bluejetty:00147136:ios.description:
Palm Cleaner: AI-Powered Phone Cleanup & Privacy
Clean your iPhone, free up storage, and protect your privacy — all with AI. Palm Cleaner quickly removes photo and video clutter, organizes contacts, and keeps your device fast and secure.
AI PHOTO CLEANER – DELETE DUPLICATES & FIND FASTER
Never sort through photos manually again. Our smart AI does the work for you:
- Instantly find and remove duplicate photos
- Automatically group similar shots and pick the best one to keep
- Bulk delete unwanted screenshots and blurry images
- New: Browse your albums by Time and Location for quick searching and management
OPTIMIZE STORAGE – COMPRESS VIDEOS, SAVE SPACE
Keep your memories without sacrificing storage:
- Compress large video files with multiple resolution options
- Choose specific videos to compress, keeping quality under your control
PRIVACY PROTECTOR – GUARD YOUR SENSITIVE INFO
Go beyond cleanup and secure your personal data:
- Scan your gallery to detect sensitive info like IDs and documents
- Hide private photos in a secure, encrypted vault
- Protect your clipboard content from being exposed
CONTACTS & CALENDAR TIDY
Keep your digital life organized:
- Merge duplicate contacts in one tap
- Remove invalid or old entries
- Clean up expired calendar events for a clearer schedule
AT-A-GLANCE WIDGETS & BATTERY CARE
Stay informed directly from your Home Screen:
- Monitor storage and memory usage with a simple glance
- Check battery health and status with helpful charging animations
YOUR PRIVACY, GUARANTEED
We believe your data should stay on your device.
- Offline Processing: All scans and AI analysis happen directly on your iPhone. No internet connection needed.
- No Data Collection: Your photos, videos, and files never leave your phone. We cannot access any of your personal information.
YOU ARE IN CONTROL
Review all items before anything is deleted. You have the final say, so you can clean with confidence.
Subscription & Pricing
The free trial version of Mobile Cleaner Master provides you with full access to all features for your convenience. You can quickly clean up your phone, organize photos, protect privacy, keep track of phone status, and enjoy a tidier mobile life. 
For more information about Mobile Cleaner Master's features, you can subscribe to gain unlimited access to all functions. The product offers various subscription plans with discounts available based on your selected plan. Subscribe to Mobile Cleaner Master today and experience even more excellent services! Join the Mobile Cleaner Master community today and make your mobile life more convenient and efficient!
By using Mobile Cleaner Master, you agree to our User Agreement and Privacy Policy.
https://fenshen.leeryou.com.cn/palm/iphone/agreement.html
https://fenshen.leeryou.com.cn/palm/cleanPolicy.html

bluejetty:00080404:ios.summary:

Twin detectives, Eleanor and Randall Jones have a new case! A girl was killed right in a movie theate
bluejetty:00080404:ios.description:
Play puzzles and brain teasers in a hide & seek adventure quest! In this one your goal is to find hidden objects needed to become a hero!
Twin detectives, Eleanor and Randall Jones have a new case! A girl was killed right in a movie theater -she lost all her blood. There were other similar cases, so the police nicknamed the criminal Dracula. Together with their colleague, the detectives assumed that the girl was murdered by her friend. But when the twins get to the bottom of what happened, the case takes an unexpected turn! Also, Randall and Eleanor have to deal with dark magic... again. So, get to the truth and save innocent people by solving puzzles and beating exciting challenges in this Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!
· FIND OUT THE TERRIBLE TRUTH ABOUT THE FATAL LOVE TRIANGLE IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play more exciting puzzles and point & click adventure detective games after you finish the main story! More collectibles are waiting for you in this unique chapter, where you can find the hidden objects and unlock all new branches of the interactive story games!
· GATHER COLLECTIBLES AND LOOK FOR MORPHING OBJECTS!
Each location has a unique collection of various collectibles to help you in your investigation! Are you ready to go on an exciting search and find adventure games and collect all the artifacts while playing puzzle quest?
· ENJOY BONUS MATERIALS THAT INCLUDE CONCEPT ART, WALLPAPERS, MUSIC, AND MORE!
Our clue game from Domini Games has tons of bonus content for you to enjoy! More interactive stories needed to be found in our seek and find games!
· PLAY AND REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE PUZZLES AND MINI-GAMES TO EARN A VARIETY OF ACHIEVEMENTS!
Replay your favorite finding games to earn as many achievements as you can to brag to your friends!
· USE A STRATEGY GUIDE THAT WILL HELP YOU REVEAL THE TRUTH!
Stuck on any level? No problem - our built-in walkthrough will always help you!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00141243:ios.description:
Do you like transport simulators as much as we do? Then play Colonize - a unique economic strategy game set in a space setting. Build and develop your own colony and its transport network on a distant planet. This is a relaxing simulator that will allow you to feel the spirit of freedom of space explorers.
Are you tired of the notorious railroad and shipbuilder simulators? Become the manager of your own space colony. This will allow you to plunge into the world of unusual space transport of a new era.
There are no timers inherent in such games, all buildings and improvements occur instantly. Real time transportation of goods without timers and other artificial restrictions.
Discover and explore all the biomes of the planet, enriching and developing a fleet of unique vehicles along the way, which will give you the best gaming experience.
Features:
- Build a global transportation network on your own planet.
- Develop various buildings of the colony.
- Lots of amazing vehicles.
- Unique setting and visual style.
- Explore the territory of a wild planet.
- Nothing appears just like that, everything is created from the resources available on the planet.
- An unforgettable soundtrack that will allow you to immerse deeper into the atmosphere of the game.
And much more. We are working hard to meet the needs of every player. Expect frequent updates with new content and unique mechanics.
All this in a meditative atmosphere in which you can relax and enjoy the game process!

bluejetty:00024954:ios.name: SimplePractice Client Portal
bluejetty:00024954:ios.summary: If you’re receiving services for behavioral health, counseling, speech pathology, occupational therapy, physical therapy, or any other wellness service by a practitioner who uses SimplePractice, this app is for you! The SimplePractice Clien
bluejetty:00024954:ios.description:
If you’re receiving services for behavioral health, counseling, speech pathology, occupational therapy, physical therapy, or any other wellness service by a practitioner who uses SimplePractice, this app is for you! The SimplePractice Client Portal iOS app empowers you to manage care for you or your loved ones from one secure place. Stay connected with your practitioner between appointments from the convenience of your phone. Your personal information is kept private, yet easily accessible for your convenience.
Simplify how you access care with features like:
• Passwordless login – Securely log into your Client Portal without the hassle of a username or password by setting up a passcode, touch ID, or Face ID for instant access. 
• Personalized notifications – Get push notifications sent right to your phone regarding any new messages, invoices, or documents that have been sent to you by your practitioner.
• Secure messaging – Message your practitioner directly from your phone knowing that all communication is secure and private.
• Upcoming appointments and requests – View all your upcoming appointments, and request a new appointment with your practitioner directly from the app. 
• Digital payments – Add new payment methods to pay your bills including HSA and FSA cards. You can even pay directly from the app. 
• Digital paperwork – Complete documents and questionnaires related to care on your own time. 
• Telehealth – Join virtual appointments with your practitioner directly from the app, so you never have to find a link buried in your inbox again. 
• Appointment directions – Get automatically transferred to your preferred mobile navigation app for easy directions to your practitioner’s office.
• Profile switching – Quickly toggle between any Client Portal you’re managing—whether you’re seeing different providers who use SimplePractice for practice management or are managing care for multiple individuals.
To access the SimplePractice Client Portal iOS app, you must be invited to use the SimplePractice Client Portal by your practitioner. When you first log into the app, the email you provided to your practitioner will be used to authenticate your Client Portal access. After you’ve signed up, turn on Face ID, Touch ID, or a four-digit passcode for hassle-free login. Please note: what you can see and do within the SimplePractice Client Portal app may vary, and is limited to the specific features your practitioner has enabled for your profile. 
Are you currently looking for therapy services? To find a behavioral health therapist that uses SimplePractice near you, visit www.meetmonarch.com.

bluejetty:00151428:ios.description:
Are you constantly on the lookout for something exciting to do during your leisure time? Do you long for an adventure that not only gets your brain firing on all cylinders but is also immersed in a sweet, charming atmosphere? Look no further! Cupcake-Sorting Match is here to be your ultimate source of entertainment!
Step into a world bursting with colors and filled with the most adorable cupcakes you've ever seen. Each cupcake in this delightful universe is like a miniature work of art, painstakingly crafted to perfection. Here, gaming transcends the ordinary and transforms into an exhilarating mental odyssey. You'll need to put your sharp observational skills to the test as you sort and match these cute treats based on a variety of elements. From the rich, indulgent taste of chocolate to the fresh, zesty flavor of strawberry, and from the dreamy softness of pink to the energetic vibrancy of orange, every sorting task is a sweet exploration of flavors and aesthetics.
The game features a vast and ever - expanding collection of levels. The difficulty is carefully calibrated to increase gradually, ensuring that whether you're a complete novice taking your first steps in the gaming world or a seasoned gaming veteran, there's always a perfect challenge waiting for you. The meticulously designed graphics are a visual treat. The details of each cupcake are so realistic that you can almost smell the freshly baked goodness and feel the smoothness of the icing. It's like stepping into a high - end patisserie where every corner is filled with delicious surprises. Paired with the lively and catchy background music, every gaming session becomes a stress - free escape. The music has a rhythm that perfectly complements the gameplay, relaxing your mind and allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the sweet world of cupcake sorting.
But the excitement doesn't stop there! Cupcake-Sorting Match comes with an exciting global leaderboard. This means you can compete head - to - head with players from all over the world. Imagine pitting your skills against the best cupcake sorters out there, striving to claim the title of the ultimate Cupcake Sorting Master. It adds a thrilling competitive edge to the game, motivating you to constantly improve your performance, break your own records, and rise to the top of the leaderboard.
Cupcake-Sorting Match is more than just a game; it's a harmonious blend of fun, challenge, and mental stimulation. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or eager to give your brain a workout in an enjoyable way, this game has got you covered. So, what are you waiting for? Dive into this sweet adventure now and embark on your very own cupcake - sorting journey!
Subscription Information
Weekly Subscription: $19.99 per week
Monthly Subscription: $39.99 per month 
Payment & Renewal
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. 
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings at any time.

Explore colorful scenes packed with surprises, humor, and easy puzzles in this hidden-object game.
From secret alien outposts to bustling human cities, each level invites you to explore a world where nothing is quite as it seems. With over 25 hand-drawn locations and hundreds of quirky objects to find, the game’s colorful art style and creative settings will keep you hooked for hours.
Explore each scene at your own pace, hunting for objects and uncovering hidden surprises. Need help? Use the built-in hints system to keep moving without losing the thrill of discovery.
