• Interactive Gameplay: Dive into richly animated scenes where every tap unveils a surprise or a fun detail.
• Lighthearted Humor: Laugh along with clever insights into how aliens might interpret Earth’s oddities.

• Accessible Design: Whether you’re a beginner or a hidden-object pro, the game’s intuitive controls and flexible difficulty settings make it easy to enjoy.
• Plenty of Extras: Beyond the main objectives, there are side quests and scattered surprises waiting to be discovered.
Over 250 unique items to find in diverse locations.
A mix of challenging puzzles and lighthearted gameplay.
25 hand-drawn locations
Perfect for all kind of players
Embark on a journey like no other, filled with laughs, surprises, and endless fun. Download Looking for Aliens now and discover why this quirky hidden-object game is out of this world!

bluejetty:00096858:ios.description:
Transform your music listening experience with AudioEQ Pro, the ultimate professional audio equalizer app for iOS. Whether you're listening to local files or streaming audio, take complete control of your sound with powerful equalization tools and stunning visualizations.
* PROFESSIONAL 10-BAND EQUALIZER
Fine-tune your audio with precision using our advanced 10-band graphic equalizer. Adjust frequencies from 60Hz to 16kHz with real-time sliders, giving you complete control over bass, mids, and treble. Perfect your sound for any genre or listening preference.
* BUILT-IN PRESETS & CUSTOM SETTINGS
Choose from professional presets including Rock, Pop, Jazz, Classical, Electronic, Hip-Hop, and more. Or create and save your own custom presets for instant access to your perfect sound. Each preset is optimized for specific music styles and listening environments.
* STUNNING AUDIO VISUALIZATION
Watch your music come to life with beautiful real-time audio visualizations. Choose from multiple visualization types including spectrum bars, waveforms, and 3D graphics. See the frequencies dance as you listen, creating an immersive visual and audio experience.
* ADVANCED VOLUME CONTROL
Take control of your audio output with professional-grade volume management. Adjust master volume, fine-tune stereo balance for left and right channels, and use volume presets for different listening scenarios. Protect your hearing with safe volume limits.
* STREAMING & LOCAL MUSIC SUPPORT
Play music from your local library or stream directly from URLs. Import audio files from your device, manage playlists, and enjoy seamless playback. Support for multiple audio formats ensures compatibility with all your favorite tracks.
* 3D SOUND POSITIONING
Experience immersive 3D sound with our virtual surround sound technology. Adjust speaker positioning, fine-tune spatial audio effects, and create a concert-like experience right in your headphones or speakers.
* POWERFUL AUDIO EFFECTS
Enhance your music with professional audio effects:
Bass Booster - Add depth and power to low frequencies
Virtualizer - Create immersive surround sound
Reverb - Add space and depth to your audio
Echo - Create atmospheric sound effects
Pitch Shifter - Adjust playback speed and pitch
* INTUITIVE INTERFACE
Designed with Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, AudioEQ Pro features a clean, modern interface that's easy to use yet powerful. Navigate between features effortlessly with our custom tab bar, and enjoy a seamless experience across iPhone and iPad.
* KEY FEATURES:
- 10-band graphic equalizer with real-time adjustment
- Professional presets for all music genres
- Custom preset creation and management
- Real-time audio visualization
- Advanced volume control with stereo balance
- 3D sound positioning and virtualizer
- Local music library and URL streaming support
- Playlist creation and management
- Multiple audio effects (Bass, Reverb, Echo, Pitch)
- Dark mode support
- Optimized for iPhone and iPad
- Low-latency audio processing
Perfect for music lovers, audiophiles, DJs, and anyone who wants to enhance their audio experience. Whether you're listening to your favorite playlist, streaming music, or fine-tuning audio for content creation, AudioEQ Pro gives you the professional tools you need.
Download AudioEQ Pro today and discover the difference professional equalization makes. Transform your music, enhance your listening experience, and take control of your audio like never before.

bluejetty:00129163:ios.summary: Learn German faster with real German reading content, an AI conversation partner, and Goethe & Telc mock tests - all built around the CEFR levels from A1 to C1. Todaii German turns everyday German content into bite-sized lessons you can fin
bluejetty:00129163:ios.description:
Learn German faster with real German reading content, an AI conversation partner, and Goethe & Telc mock tests - all built around the CEFR levels from A1 to C1. Todaii German turns everyday German content into bite-sized lessons you can finish in just 10 minutes a day. Read smarter, speak with confidence, and walk into your exam ready.
WHY Todaii German?
• Our language experts create German reading content from A1 to C1 levels, with one-tap lookup and a quiz built right into every reading lesson.
• Todaii is your companion for reading, listening, AI speaking practice, vocabulary flashcards, and full Goethe & Telc exam prep — all in one app.
Start learning German in a new way with Todaii.
======
WHAT LEVELS CAN I LEARN?
You can learn German from A1 (absolute beginner) through A2, B1, B2 up to C1 (advanced), with reading content, listening material, and exam prep matched to each CEFR level.
======
Why learning with real Deutsch content works:
► REAL GERMAN READING, NOT TEXTBOOK DRILLS
Articles curated by level — A1 through C1 — across culture, technology, business, and everyday German life. Tap any word for instant lookup with meaning, native audio, and example sentences. A short reading quiz at the end locks the new vocabulary in.
► GOETHE & TELC EXAM PREP
Full mock tests from A1 through C1, with detailed answer explanations so you understand why — not just what. Walk into the real Goethe or Telc exam knowing exactly what to expect.
► SPEAK GERMAN 1:1 WITH AN AI TUTOR
Hold real conversations in German on topics you'd actually talk about. Get instant feedback on grammar and pronunciation, suggestions for better phrasing, and a score you can track over time. It's the kind of speaking practice a textbook can't give you.
► TRAIN YOUR LISTENING WITH NATIVE AUDIO
Every article comes with high-quality native German audio. Trending podcasts and videos include full transcripts, with playback speed you can adjust to match your listening level — slow it down to catch every word, speed it up as your ear improves.
► VOCABULARY THAT STICKS
General word lists for everyday Deutsch, plus specialist vocabulary sets for nursing, hospitality, retail, and customer service. Flashcards, matching games, and sentence-building exercises move new words into long-term memory.
► INSTANT GERMAN DICTIONARY
AI-assisted lookup for words, phrases, and grammar. See real example sentences and visual cues that make new German vocabulary easier to remember and easier to use in real conversations.
======
WHO IT'S FOR
• Self-learners working toward A1, B1, or C1 fluency
• Students preparing for Goethe or Telc certification
• Anyone who wants to read, listen, and speak German — not just memorize
• Busy learners with ten minutes a day and a real goal
Start small. Stay consistent. Todaii is the German learning companion you'll come back to.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at todai.easylife@gmail.com — your input drives every update.
Privacy: https://todaiinews.com/en/policy
Terms: https://todaiinews.com/en/terms

bluejetty:00069148:ios.description:
Supported Digital Cameras as of October 2026
ZR, Z9, Z8, Z7II, Z7, Z6III, Z6II, Z6, Z5II, Z5IIC, Z5, Zf, Zfc, Z50II, Z50, Z30, D6, D850, D780, D500, D7500, D5600, D3500, D3400, COOLPIX P1100, P1000, P950, A1000, A900, A300, B700, B500, B600, W300, W150, W100, KeyMission 80
The foregoing may include models not available in some regions.
Be sure to update the camera firmware to the latest version.
Use a computer to download the latest camera firmware from the Nikon Download Center. * According to your camera's model, you can download your camera's firmware via the SnapBridge app.
http://downloadcenter.nikonimglib.com/
Principal Features
- Once the camera is paired with your smart device, new photos can be downloaded automatically.
- Adjust camera settings and take photos.
- View the pictures on and download photos from the camera.
- Use the app to pair the device with up to five cameras.
- You can send images taken with your camera to Nikon Imaging Cloud (Note 1).
- View downloaded photos or share them via e-mail or social media.
- Add photo info or text to uploaded photos.
- Download location data to the camera (Note 2) or set the camera clock to the time reported by the smart device.
- Receive notifications of firmware updates for paired cameras.
System Requirements
iOS17.7, iOS18.7, iOS26.7
iPadOS17.7, iPadOS18.7, iPadOS26.7
iPhone 7 or later, iPad 5th or later, iPad mini 5th or later
Bluetooth 4.0 or later
There is no guarantee that this app will run on all devices.
Notes
- Note 1: Upload to Nikon Imaging Cloud requires a Nikon ID.
- Note 2: The GPS function runs continuously in the background, increasing the drain on the battery. The drain on the battery can be reduced by choosing power-saving mode. This feature is not recommended for use with devices not equipped with GPS.
- If you are unable to download images or connect via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi after pairing, try one or more of the following solutions:
　- Turn the paired camera off and then on again.
　- Switch tabs in SnapBridge.
　- Exit and relaunch SnapBridge.
- Users can register for a Nikon ID using this app.
- Enable Bluetooth and Wi-Fi when using this app.
- Remote movie recording is not supported on some cameras.
- Movies can be downloaded by switching to Wi-Fi and selecting the files manually. 
- Upload/download of AVI and interlaced movies is not supported.
- 4K UHD movies transfer and playback are not supported on some devices.
- Remote photography and movie download are available only if the camera has Wi-Fi (some cameras only).
- Keep the app displayed in the foreground when downloading images from the camera via Wi-Fi. Download is not available when the app is running in the background.
- The app may not perform as expected depending on your environment and network conditions.
Using the App
For more information, use the app "Help" option.

bluejetty:00121650:ios.summary: Welcome to the best and most popular version of Mexican Train Dominoes, with over a million happy players. Our classic domino board game looks beautiful and is an utter delight to play. Learn the game’s strategy by playing a range of diffic
bluejetty:00121650:ios.description:
Welcome to the best and most popular version of Mexican Train Dominoes, with over a million happy players. Our classic domino board game looks beautiful and is an utter delight to play. Learn the game’s strategy by playing a range of difficulty levels that provide a good game for both new and experienced players. Enjoy a short game when you have a spare 5 minutes or a longer game when you have more time.
If you’re new to dominoes (or dominos) you'll find this game easy to learn with our simple-to-follow tutorial. If you’re a seasoned pro, we've made the game a joy to play with simple controls and stunning audio-visual themes. A mix of animated and simple backgrounds add to the pleasing ambiance for an even more relaxing play environment. 
The rules are easy to follow, being derived from classic block, muggins, or Chickenfoot variations. Place dominoes that connect to the last domino (sometimes known as bones) on any open 'train'. If you can't move, then you can draw another domino tile. If a player puts down a double, then the next player must cover that tile. When a player gets rid of all their bones they win the round, and all other player scores are added up. Once all the rounds are complete, the winner is the player with the lowest number of points.
Dominos Features: 
- 3 player games and 4 player game modes played against the multiplayer computer.
- Three game lengths - Blitz, Short, and Full for quick and longer games.
- Pass and Play multiplayer game. 
- 6 different backgrounds with their own family-friendly ambiance to play on.
- Plenty of space to puzzle over your hand.
- Train scrolling for superior visibility and to see potential blocks.
- Playable tutorial for game rules
- Optional Advanced opponents for a pro challenge.
- Option to change the house rules of the game.
- Simple controls - place and draw dominoes with ease! 
Download now and discover the best version of Mexican Train Dominoes that your phone or tablet can offer!

bluejetty:00098646:ios.description:
Music Tune is a smart and lightweight music player that gives you full control over how you experience music. Whether you're streaming yt music, downloading your favorite tracks, or listening offline, Music Tune is designed for smooth playback with zero distractions.
Looking for a SnapTube-style downloader or a reliable offline player? Music Tune does both — while giving you features like lock screen controls, background playback, and a sleep timer.
Why Music Tune?
• Play and manage free music from YouTube with no login
• Background playback while using other apps
• Turn off your screen and keep the music going
• Built-in offline player and download support
• Inspired by user favorites like musi, muzi, and SnapTube
• Simple and fast interface for non-stop listening
• Full control with playlists, queueing, and history
Whether you call it música, musica, or just music, Music Tune brings a global experience for true music lovers.
Subscription & Billing Policy
Music Tune offers optional subscription plans to unlock enhanced features. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your account settings. No refunds will be issued for unused portions of the subscription term.
Privacy Policy:https://info.dshome.cc/policy.html
Terms of Service:https://info.dshome.cc/terms.html

bluejetty:00187371:ios.description:
Log into your Net2 or Paxton10 system from anywhere in the world using your smartphone or tablet. Switch between multiple sites quickly and easily with simple biometric identification. All key system features can be accessed from the Paxton Connect app. Administrators can view and edit features for which they have been granted prior permission.
Paxton systems currently supported
Net2 Pro
Log into your Net2 system and access:
• User creation and administration
• Token enrolment
• Live events and filtering
• Reports (read only)
• Roll call report generation
• Online and offline muster control
• Open door
Net2 Pro v6.00 or above is required. For full system administration, the Net2 desktop software is required.
Paxton10
Log into your Paxton10 system and access:
• User creation and administration
• Live events and filtering
• Reports
• Buildings and devices (read only)
• Roll call report generation
• Online muster control
• Control device
For full system administration, a desktop computer running the Chrome web browser should be used.

bluejetty:00120173:ios.name: Happy Daycare: Toddler games
bluejetty:00120173:ios.summary: You are in charge of this daycare, a small and fully interactive world where everyone is welcomed and the only rule is to use your imagination to create amazing stories. Explore 7 different rooms, with tons of toys and thousands of differen
bluejetty:00120173:ios.description:
You are in charge of this daycare, a small and fully interactive world where everyone is welcomed and the only rule is to use your imagination to create amazing stories. Explore 7 different rooms, with tons of toys and thousands of different interactions, and play with 5 playful characters .
CREATE YOUR OWN STORIES!
Let your imagination fly exploring and playing with the daycare center, where every room is an adventure itself. Prepare delicious meals in the kitchen, create a musical band, put the children to bed, or bathe them after a hard day of play. In this daycare, you decide!
EXPLORE THE DAYCARE!
With tons of toys, different objects and thousands of possible interactions. Water the plants, mix ingredients from the fridge into the pot, or throw toys into the bathtub. You will find surprises everywhere!
DISCOVER AND PLAY FREELY!
Discover all the different rooms, full of surprises and hidden treasures. Remember, there are no rules so don't be afraid to interact with anything!
FEATURES
+ Explore and play in 7 different rooms full of activities.
+ You will be in charge of 5 charming children eager to play.
+ Lots of toys and objects, and thousands of possible interactions.
+ Without rules and goals, just fun to create your own stories.
+ Kid safe environment for children aged 2 to 8, no third party ads.
Specifically designed to be played by children from 2 years of age, but detailed enough to captivate and amuse children up to 8 years. Happy Daycare Stories will foster their imagination and creativity, and will keep them fascinated for hours for less than the price of a cup of coffee.
The free trial includes 3 rooms so you can test the endless possibilities of this game. Once you are sure, you can buy the full version through a single purchase within the application, which will unlock the 7 rooms forever.
About SUBARA
SUBARA games have been developed to be enjoyed by all members of the family, regardless of their age. We promote responsible social values and healthy habits in a safe and controlled environment without violence or advertisements from third parties.

bluejetty:00043497:ios.name: Wise - Teach Online
bluejetty:00043497:ios.summary:
With WISE, your online teaching is at your fingertips. Just open the app, create your classroom, invite your students to join and embark with your students on a journey of comprehensive online classroom experience.
CREATE MULTIPLE CLASSROO
bluejetty:00043497:ios.description:
With WISE, your online teaching is at your fingertips. Just open the app, create your classroom, invite your students to join and embark with your students on a journey of comprehensive online classroom experience.
CREATE MULTIPLE CLASSROOMS
Create separate virtual rooms for each class you teach. Create a class schedule which gets automatically shared with your students. No more meeting links and password sharing before every class.
AUTOMATED ATTENDANCE
We understand that a lot of time is wasted on taking attendance online. On WISE, you will get attendance reports after every class you take. We give the percentage of class attended by each student.
DISCUSSION BOARDS
Facilitate discussions with or among students for doubts resolution. No need to juggle across Whatsapp groups to keep a track of students’ doubts and queries. Use this to post course updates or changes.
SHARE RESOURCES
Share study material, pre-reads and curated online content. Give and grade assignments.
It is extremely simple to use and works smoothly even on low bandwidth. So get started on upgrading the learning experience of your students
Do you teach at a school? Are you a principal who wants to keep a track on teachers’ and students’ progress? Do you run a coaching institute? Are you an individual teacher? Are you hosting webinars? Do you want to start your online course but are overwhelmed with managing its operations?
WISE has solutions for all your online education problems.
As a school teacher you can create a timetable for your students without the need of having to schedule meetings and sending meeting ids/passwords every time. Increase engagement level by facilitating after class discussions, sharing material or videos and conducting regular assessments. Receive automated attendance reports after every class.
As a principal, using WISE for your school will be super efficient. Get access to all your school’s virtual classrooms and track the progress of each class. No need to wait for Whatsapp messages to receive daily reports.
Coaching institutes can use WISE to streamline their classes. Use the discussions feature to resolve doubts of students. Share your study material and youtube videos through the resources tab. And schedule regular short tests to keep the competitive spirit alive.
As an individual teacher you can use WISE to organize your classroom experience and operations. Create multiple classrooms across different batches you teach. Send personalized notes and rich online content in each batch. Significantly upgrade the learning experience of your students’ learning experience by sending/receiving regular assignments and homework.
Plan your next webinar or webinar series on WISE. With a single step registration, get all your participants at one place. Interact with them before the webinar through the discussions tab. Share key resources with them. No more worries of losing touch with the participants after the webinar. Use WISE for sending/receiving feedback and inputs in between two back to back webinars. Planning a series of leadership workshops? Use WISE.
Do you want to start online teaching? Overwhelmed with the intricacies of starting a course? Use WISE. A unified platform that helps you enrol students, start taking classes, send/receive resources. All at one place. Starting an online course was never simpler.
Follow us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/wiseapplive
Like us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/wiseapplive
Have a question or suggestion: info@wiseapp.live

bluejetty:00185355:ios.description:
Outsmart friends and rivals worldwide in Line 'Em Up® — a fast, strategic two-player board game where the first to build two rows of five chips wins.
Play your way: blitz through 60-second turns or take up to 24 hours per move.
● GAME MODES
- 60-Second Mode — Beat the clock. One minute per turn keeps the pressure on.
- 24-Hour Mode — Play at your own pace. Perfect for matches that fit around your day.
● FEATURES
- Online multiplayer — challenge friends or get matched with players worldwide
- In-game chat with your opponent
- Level up faster with challenges and claim your rewards
- Unlock a growing collection of avatars and chips
● HOW TO PLAY
Each player is dealt seven cards representing spots on the board. Play a card, place a chip, and draw a new one. Build two rows of five chips to win — but watch out:
- Blue Jacks are wild — place a chip anywhere
- Red Jacks remove an opponent's chip
- Corner spots count as free chips, giving you a head start on a row
- Completed rows lock — and locked chips can be reused in new rows
Simple to learn. Tough to master. Every match rewards sharp strategy.
● CONTACT
Questions or feature ideas? Reach us at hello@boredgames.dk — we'd love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00016223:ios.name: Concepts
bluejetty:00016223:ios.summary:
Think, plan & create – Concepts is a flexible vector-based sketchbook where you can take your ideas from concept to reality.
Concepts reimagines the ideation process – offering a safe and dynamic workspace to iterate and explore your ideas
bluejetty:00016223:ios.description:
Think, plan & create – Concepts is a flexible vector-based sketchbook where you can take your ideas from concept to reality.
Concepts reimagines the ideation process – offering a safe and dynamic workspace to iterate and explore your ideas, organize your thoughts, and experiment with designs. 
With our infinite canvas, you can:
• Sketch plans and whiteboard ideas
• Make notes, doodles, and mindmaps
• Draw storyboards, product sketches and designs
Concepts is vector-based, making every stroke editable and scalable. With our Nudge, Slice and Select tools, you can easily change any element of your sketch without redrawing it. 
Talented creators at Disney, Playstation, Philips, HP, Apple, Google, Unity and Illumination Entertainment use Concepts to develop and realize extraordinary ideas. Join us!
Concepts has:
• An infinite canvas with optional paper types and grids
• Realistic pens, pencils and brushes that flow with pressure, tilt and velocity or create your own
• A tool wheel or bar you can personalize
• HSL, RGB and COPIC color wheels
• Editable vector-based sketching – move, organize and edit the tool, color, size, scale, smoothing, opacity; transform or nudge lines to shape them 
• Unlimited layers
• Scale and measurement tools that calculate real-world dimensions
With Concepts, you can:
• Drag + drop images + PDF files 
• Create, store and share vector Object libraries 
• Export images, vector SVG + PDFs to scale for printing or efficient flow between apps (including Procreate, Sketchbook, AutoCAD and Adobe)
• Share directly to email, text, Files, cloud, photos, or your favorite social apps and present with AirPlay or a second screen
• Store your work safely in your personal iCloud Drive
FREE FEATURES
• Infinite canvas
• A selection of paper, grid types & tools to get you started
• The full COPIC color spectrum, RGB and HSL color wheels
• Five layers
• Unlimited drawings
• JPG exports
PAID FEATURES
Subscription:
• 200+ brush and Object libraries, features, and services
• Enjoy Team Sharing for smooth collaboration, including live-sharing of object libraries, color palettes & brushes, with new updates arriving all the time
• Unlocks everything across platforms
• TRY PREMIUM FREE FOR 7 DAYS
One-time-purchases:
• Buy the Essentials for life and unlock selection & editing tools, infinite layers, shape guides, custom brushes, custom grids, and exports to PNG / PSD / SVG / DXF.
• Pay for advanced features as you need them – object packs & professional brushes are sold separately
• Limited to the platform you purchase on
Terms & Conditions:
• Monthly and yearly subscription payments are charged to your iTunes account at the time of purchase.
• Your plan will renew automatically at the end of the billing period unless canceled 24 hours before the billing period ends.
• You can cancel or make changes to your subscription at any time in your iTunes Account settings.
• Unused portions of any free trial period are forfeited if you make changes to your subscription.
We’re dedicated to quality and update frequently based on your feedback. Your experience matters to us. Chat with us in-app via Ask Us Anything, email us at concepts@tophatch.com, or find us anywhere with @ConceptsApp.
COPIC is the trademark of Too Corporation. Many thanks to Lasse Pekkala and Osama Elfar for the cover art!

Introduce your children to the ultimate educational adventure with Yateland's "Dinosaur City"! This is a dynamic game that combines entertainment and education, making it the perfect choice for building games for kids. This interactive platform gives children the freedom to create and innovate with 791 versatile and colorful building blocks, allowing them to construct an exciting city full of prehistoric wonders.
"Dinosaur City" offers a wide variety of architectural styles, spread across six unique themes, each with four distinct building styles. This makes it an engaging and immersive construction game that helps children understand colors and shapes while boosting their cognitive skills.

Easily Get Started Invest
bluejetty:00050102:android.description:
Ready to embark on your investing journey?
Learn Stocks
Learn by MyWallSt teaches you how to invest in the U.S stock market (Nasdaq) with easy to understand, zero-jargon, bite-sized lessons, all original content.
Easily Get Started Investing in the Stock Market
Huge efforts have gone into the design of our app to ensure the content is laid out in an easy to follow manner, with chapters and lessons similar to any book you're used to reading. This is not your usual stock market learning app!
Investment Lessons
There are no quizzes or spreadsheets, just 40 original investment lessons created by the MyWallSt team, designed to teach you the fundamental principles of investing in the stock market. 
Each lesson can be read in under 1 minute and you are in control of when you learn. Each lesson is also in audio format so you can choose to listen or read.
Learn How to Invest
This app is designed to walk beginners step-by-step through the world of the stock market and give you the confidence to start investing your own money. You can mark each lesson as 'read' once completed so you can monitor your progress as you read.
Learn From a True Investing Expert
The investment lessons have been fully created by our co-founder and chief investing analyst, Emmet Savage. 
It captures all of the major lessons he’s accumulated through thousands of hours of practice and comes with a jargon-free promise.
Emmet has been investing in publicly-listed stocks for almost 30 years. By buying stocks and holding shares in businesses you know and many you’ve never encountered, he has increased his portfolio’s value by over 24% on average every year since 2002, meaning that investments made many years ago have grown almost 38 times in value.
Investing in stocks is his passion. Helping others to learn how to invest is his life's pursuit.
Who is MyWallSt?
The MyWallSt team is made up of lifelong investors and tech geeks out to achieve one common goal - to help people shape their personal capital and financial future by making it simple to start investing. We're passionate about creating beautiful apps that make that process simple and straightforward.

bluejetty:00014449:ios.name: Mobilní klíč eGovernmentu
bluejetty:00014449:ios.summary:
Aplikace Mobilní klíč eGovernmentu pro mobilní platformu iOS umožňuje jednoduché a rychlé přihlášení do Datových schránek i řady dalších webových aplikací veřejné správy bez nutnosti zadávat složité jméno a heslo.
Pro použití v datových sc
bluejetty:00014449:ios.description:
Aplikace Mobilní klíč eGovernmentu pro mobilní platformu iOS umožňuje jednoduché a rychlé přihlášení do Datových schránek i řady dalších webových aplikací veřejné správy bez nutnosti zadávat složité jméno a heslo.
Pro použití v datových schránkách si do mobilního telefonu nebo tabletu nainstalujte aplikaci Mobilní klíč a v Datových schránkách ji připojte ke svému uživatelskému účtu (Nastavení - Možnosti přihlášení - Přihlášení Mobilním klíčem). Pro přihlášení do Datových schránek pak stačí se přihlásit do Mobilního klíče otiskem prstu (nebo PINem, heslem či obrázkovým heslem - podle vlastní volby) a sejmout QR kód na přihlašovací stránce.
Jeden Mobilní klíč si můžete připojit k více datovým schránkám. Po přihlášení Mobilním klíčem vám pak Datové schránky nabídnou výběr ze všech dostupných uživatelských účtů.
Do Mobilního klíče mohou být také doručována upozornění na nové zprávy ve vaší datové schránce.
Pro přihlašování přes Národní bod se nabízí více možností. Poté co si aplikaci nainstalujete na mobilní telefon, můžete si buď do Národního bodu přenést svou identitu z datové schránky nebo si spárovat aplikaci Mobilní klíč se svým stávajícím účtem v Národním bodě za použití jiného elektronického prostředku pro přihlášení nebo si můžete na kontaktním místě veřejné správy (Czech POINT) založit nový účet v Národním bodě.
Mobilní klíč vyžaduje ke svému běhu iOS verze 11 či vyšší a zapnutý zámek obrazovky (nesmí být možné odemknout zařízení prostým odsunutím obrazovky, musí být nastaven odemykací obrazec, PIN nebo heslo).
Pokud má vaše zařízení Touch ID nebo Face ID a iOS alespoň 11, je možné se do Mobilního klíče přihlásit otiskem prstu (Touch ID) nebo načtením obličeje (Face ID).
Pro přihlášení do Datových schránek je potřeba, aby měl telefon či tablet přístup na internet - je jedno, zda přes mobilní data nebo pomocí Wi-Fi.
Aplikace Mobilní klíč zajišťuje pouze bezpečné přihlášení bez nutnosti zadávat přihlašovací údaje. Samotný přístup do datové schránky (čtení zpráv) probíhá i nadále ve webovém prohlížeči - aplikace nic jiného než přihlášení (a doručení notifikací) nezajišťuje.
FAQ: naleznete, zde: https://info.mojedatovaschranka.cz/info/cs/help/15.2.text.html#15_2
a zde: https://info.identitaobcana.cz/mep/
Podmínky používání Mobilního klíče eGovernmentu pro prokazování totožnosti prostřednictvím Národního bodu jsou uvedeny na následujícím odkazu: https://info.identitaobcana.cz/Download/PodminkyPouzivaniMEG.pdf. 
Aplikace používá ikony z Icons8.com

Many Christmas carols are designed as lullabies for the infant Jesus, the most famous of them being "Silent Night".
As tiny beings, babies require quite a few things the average human would need, but in smaller portions or in different wavelengths. For instance, sunlight…it's not that the sun will kill a baby, but if exposed to more than a certain amount, it could be harmful to the child. Typically a lullaby is in triple metre, or in a compound metre like 6/8. Tonally, most lullabies are simple, often merely alternating tonic and dominant harmonies: Because the intended effect is to put someone to sleep, wild chromaticism would be somewhat out of character.

Many Christmas carols are designed as lullabies for the infant Jesus, the most famous of them being "Silent Night".

As tiny beings, babies require quite a few things the average human would need, but in smaller portions or in different wavelengths. For instance, sunlight…it's not that the sun will kill a baby, but if exposed to more than a certain amount, it could be harmful to the child. • כלי לניהול תקציב
ממשק חדשני שמאפשר לך לעקוב אחרי ההוצאות וההכנסות, להבין באמת מה המצב הפיננסי שלך, להגדיר יעדים, ואפילו לחסוך קצת.
• תובנות שימושיות על הכסף שלכם
תמונה מלאה, ויזואלית וברורה עם הסברים פשוטים שיעזרו לך לנהל את הכסף שלך בצורה חכמה ובקלות.

הפרסום אינו מהווה הצעה או התחייבות להעמדת האשראי. העמדת ההלוואה היא באמצעות בנק לאומי לישראל וכפופה לשיקול דעת הבנק. אי עמידה בפירעון ההלוואה עלול לגרור חיוב בריבית פיגורים והליכי הוצאה לפועל.

Every photo comes from a fan who was there. Check your view before the sh
bluejetty:00040951:ios.description:
See your view before you buy. A View From My Seat shows real photos taken by fans from their seats at more than 6,000 stadiums, arenas and theaters around the world.
Every photo comes from a fan who was there. Check your view before the show, then share yours after, so the next fan knows exactly what to expect.
SEE YOUR VIEW
- Fan photos by venue, section, row and seat.
- Filter by event type: baseball, soccer, football, hockey, basketball, concerts, theater and more.
- Seating charts matched to the event you're viewing.
- Comments and tips from fans who sat there.
SHARE YOUR VIEW
- Take a photo or video from your seat, or pick one from your library.
- Event details fill in automatically when your photo was taken at a game, concert or show.
- Can't find your venue? Share a photo from it and add it to the app.
- Earn trophies and badges, and climb the leaderboard.
SCAN YOUR TICKET
- Scan a ticket or ticket screenshot to jump straight to the view from your section.
- Your ticket is read on your iPhone and never uploaded.
- My Seats keeps your upcoming seats on your phone, with section photos saved for offline viewing at the venue.
- Get a reminder on event day to share your view, with your venue, event, section, row and seat already filled in.
TRACK YOUR STADIUM JOURNEY
- Chasing all 30 ballparks? Chasing tracks your progress through every venue in a league and shows which ones you still need.
- Your profile shows your photos, stats and featured trophies.
PLAN YOUR NIGHT
- Upcoming events for teams, artists, tours and shows, with Add to Calendar.
- Find tickets from our ticket partners, and check the view from those seats before you buy.
- Hotels near the venue, with distance and nightly price.
- Venue pages with maps, directions, teams and event types.
- Explore by city, college, sport, artist or show.
BUILT BY FANS
A View From My Seat is free, with no subscriptions. It's built by a community of sports fans, concert-goers and theater lovers, and used by more than 50 million fans a year. The more fans share, the better it gets for everyone.

"A View From My Seat... allows fans to post photos and comments from games they attend" –ESPN
"#1 Must-Have Sports App" –Wireless Zone
Also featured in Sports Illustrated and BroadwayWorld.

bluejetty:00013924:ios.description:
Commercial Bank Mobile Banking Services 
******************************************************************** 
Commercial Bank Mobile Banking offers customers quick access to their bank accounts, loans and credit cards. Available 24/7, allows you to check balances, pay bills and transfer money between own accounts and to local banks. Provides flexibility to transfer funds internationally within 60 seconds and supports faster remittances to over 40 countries. 
AROUND THE CLOCK, AROUND THE GLOBE 
---------------------------------------------------- 
Get instant access to your accounts through your mobile phone whenever and wherever you choose. 
FULLY SECURE 
-------------------
Commercial Bank Mobile Banking uses state of the art security measures. We have added new security measures in the app’s latest version in line with Qatar Central Bank’s regulations. For our users’ convenience, we have provided an option on screen to enter a mobile number if they have trouble receiving the SMS, this can be an international number. 
The new CBsafe ID feature introduced within the Mobile App provides additional security protecting customers from fraudulent calls. 
Using the CBQ Mobile App, you will be able to identify legitimate calls from the Bank, ensure caller authenticity and reduce the chances of fraudsters gaining access to your information.

*Subscribe to e-statements 
*Enable Voice activation 
*Manage Font settings 
*Early loan settlement

* Purchase Ooredoo and Vodafone prepaid services (Hala Topups, Hala vouchers etc.)

* Perform Merchant payments using QR Codes including P2M payments. 
* Mobile Payment Request - Request payment from another CB customer 
*Make Charity payments 
* Pay Kahramaa and Qatar Cool bills 
*Setup Apple Pay and perform card tokenization for Tap n Pay 
* Setup standing orders 
* Send an e-gift – Surprise your friends and family with an e-gift on special occasions 
* Mobile cash – Send cash to any mobile number within Qatar and withdraw the funds from any CB ATM without using an ATM card. 
*mPay services – Perform P2P and P2M payments instantly 
* Dispute credit or debit transactions 
* Update your personal profile 
*Buy now pay later – Convert your credit card transactions to instalments 
* Create new PIN for your debit and credit cards 
* Activate, Block your cards temporary and permanently 
* Cash advance from credit card - transfer money from your credit card to your account 
* Share IBAN with family and friends

To open more eateries, Jenna must overcome obstacles posed by competitors. A girl with a strong heart is unbeatable.

3-D Touch - By holding down on the Lupo app icon you will be able to place an order for pickup, delivery or order your Quick Order all from your Home Screen. 
Reviews- View all menu & order reviews by previous customers.
Referrals- *Account Required* Refer-a-Friend
Future Orders - Place an Order for any upcoming date and time. 
Favorite Menu Items - Tap the Heart next to your favorite Lupo menu items and they will be added to your home screen for easy access and quick adding to cart! 
Order Progress Tracker - Get real time updates on your orders! You will know when the order is accepted, being prepared, and ready.
School Lunch - Add students, select school and lunch period, set up and manage lunch deliveries for the week. Exclusive school lunch menu!

bluejetty:00155124:ios.summary: The emergence of Lyme disease and the rapid geographical range expansion of certain tick species in Canada are important issues for public health authorities and the public in general. A citizen science project called eTick invites the publ
bluejetty:00155124:ios.description: The emergence of Lyme disease and the rapid geographical range expansion of certain tick species in Canada are important issues for public health authorities and the public in general. A citizen science project called eTick invites the public to participate in the monitoring of ticks in Canada by submitting tick photos via a mobile application or a web site (eTick.ca) for identification by trained personnel. The identification results (usually returned within 1 business day) appear in real time on a public interactive map so that visitors can visualize all entries for a specific area and/or examine individual submissions. All eTick products and services (application download, image identification, consultation of public data) are free of charge. listings.description: The emergence of Lyme disease and the rapid geographical range expansion of certain tick species in Canada are important issues for public health authorities and the public in general. A citizen science project called eTick invites the public to participate in the monitoring of ticks in Canada by submitting tick photos via a mobile application or a web site (eTick.ca) for identification by trained personnel. The identification results (usually returned within 1 business day) appear in real time on a public interactive map so that visitors can visualize all entries for a specific area and/or examine individual submissions. All eTick products and services (application download, image identification, consultation of public data) are free of charge. Ten provinces are currently participating: BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, NL, and PE, with Territories to be added soon.

bluejetty:00026462:ios.description:
PAW Patrol to the Rescue! This PAWsome app features interactive learning games for toddler girls and boys, plus real episode clips! Designed for preschool and kindergarten kids aged 2-5, it’s a brand-new way to experience the hit Nickelodeon show PAW Patrol – and the best way to get your biggest (or smallest) PAW Patrol fan smiling, laughing, and learning.
**PAW Patrol Academy is part of the Piknik bundle – one subscription, endless ways to play and learn! Get full access to the world's best apps for kids from Toca Boca, Sago Mini, and Originator with an Unlimited Plan.**
WHAT'S INSIDE PAW PATROL ACADEMY
• Fun and interactive missions with your child’s favorite PAW Patrol characters 
• Parent-approved learning games for preschoolers to help kids practice topics like ABCs, spelling, counting, numbers, shapes, and more
• Kids learn about emotions, self-care, and life skills with Heroes in Training classes
• Preschoolers can wind down with calming coloring activities or get moving to the music with dance parties
THE MOST EXCITING WAY TO EXPERIENCE PAW PATROL 
• Kids join the pups in Adventure Bay to explore their favorite TV, YouTube, YouTube Kids, Nickelodeon, Nick Jr. show
• Kids become the heroes of their own adventure stories and play with Chase, Rubble, Marshall, Zuma, Skye, Rocky, and Ryder
• With tons of engaging and kid-friendly activities, preschoolers learn new skills through play 
REAL LEARNING BENEFITS 
• Cognitive: Problem solving, task completion, and focus
• Social: Communication, conflict resolution, and community values
• Emotional: Resilience, emotional intelligence, self-expression, and confidence
• Creative: Coloring, music, and songs
• Physical: Fine motor skills, dancing, and movement
GUILT-FREE SCREEN TIME 
• Highly immersive adventures and self-guided activities provide frustration-free play for kids (and break time for parents!)
• Safe, ad-free, and easy for kids to explore independently
• No WiFi required – perfect for on-the-go playtime 
• PAW Patrol Academy meets the highest COPPA and GDPR standards
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS 
After your free trial, PAW Patrol Academy requires a monthly or annual subscription to access all activities and additional content.
• When you confirm your purchase, payment will be charged through your iTunes account.
• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Don’t want to auto-renew? Manage your account and renewal settings in your user Account Settings.
• Cancel your subscription anytime through your Account Settings, with no cancellation fees.
• Questions? Need a hand? Give us a shout at support@playpiknik.com.
Privacy Policy
Sago Mini is committed to protecting your privacy and the privacy of your children. We adhere to the strict guidelines set forth by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) & kidSAFE, which ensure the protection of your child’s information online. 
Privacy policy: https://playpiknik.link/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://playpiknik.link/terms-of-use
About Sago Mini
Sago Mini is an award-winning company devoted to play. We make apps, games and toys for preschoolers worldwide. Toys that seed imagination and grow wonder. We bring thoughtful design to life. For kids. For parents. For giggles.
Find us on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok at @sagomini.

bluejetty:00120826:ios.description:
This classic alchemy puzzle game starts off with the four basic elements - Air, Water, Earth and Fire. Mix them together and create new elements. Make Santa Claus, a crocodile, a skeleton, sushi, or an elephant! Can you create and discover all 1000 elements? This premium brain teaser provides hours of exploration, creativity and fun. Play and share your progress with your friends. Caution - this game is addictive, and could keep you busy all day! :)
FEATURES:
- Unique "Hot-Cold" indicator option that tells you when you are close
- Hint system with extended hints that display element names
- Cheats available - You can cheat and unlock elements, if you get stuck
- Stars* that mark when elements can no longer be used
- Leaderboard and sharing on social networks
- Long press to see an elements' parents 
Some tips:
Can't create any more new elements? Simply place one or more items to the top of the screen and click the "Hint" button in menu. The hint can be simple (just a number of possible elements) or extended (also see their names). The type of hint can be changed in the "Options" menu. See the in game help menu for full instructions.
Good luck Alchemist!

bluejetty:00093143:ios.description:
The WERU Community Radio App: 
The WERU Community Radio App allows you to listen to WERU, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for WERU Community Radio all at once! You can explore and listen to On Demand content whenever you want, share stories with your friends and wake up to WERU with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from WERU even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing.
• Integrated program schedules for WERU streams! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to WERU Community Radio in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access WERU's past programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• The WERU Community Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The WERU Community Radio App is brought to you by the people at WERU Community Radio and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, on whatever device you have!
Please support WERU by becoming a member today!

http://www.publicmediaapps.com

FlashBea
bluejetty:00017216:ios.description:
FlashBeats is a mobile application for creating party strobe lights by synchronizing flashlights and smartphone’s screens.
The app analyzes the rhythms of music tracks and creates an individualized strobe light show for each song.
FlashBeats can sync with an unlimited number of phones to play music and watch videos simultaneously on multiple devices.
FlashBeats produces disco lights based on your choice of music, creating a custom party by connecting the DJ lights and beats of hundreds of people together!
With the FlashBeats app, you can create light shows at home parties, as well as at music and sporting events.
FEATURES:
- Synchronized Strobe Lights is our unique technology with the ability to connect an unlimited number of phones into one network and make flashing lights that match the rhythm of the music. It transforms your phone’s flashlight into a house party stroboscope or disco ball. You can also use smartphone’s screens as a color flash strobe.
- Create your personal music playlist with your favorite songs and have fun with your friends. The more devices you connect, the louder and brighter your party will be!
- Public Parties are live video streams with editor-curated music videos. You can join EDM, Hip-Hop, Rock, Pop or tens of other public parties depending on your mood. There are also public parties with popular local music. You can invite friends to watch together or have fun with your favorite music videos.
- Volume Booster (with synchronized sound) - invite friends to your rave party or any public parties and create a speaker booster! The audio and video will be synced with all connected devices to create a sound amplifier effect (available only for YouTube).
- Chat with friends and people all over the world. Every public party has a group chat that you can join. Meet new people and have fun together!
- Tap-to-Light (paid option). Do you want to create your own personal lightshow? Just do it! You can create one without music or choose any song from the catalog as background music. And, of course, you can invite your friends to your show and have fun together. Here's an idea - why not support your favorite sports team at the stadium with an amazing strobe light chant?
- Microphone Strobe (paid option). The app can listen to the ambient music and create flashing lights based on the music rhythm. Sound like magic? Yes! This is tech magic! You can use this feature everywhere: at home, at a disco club or even at an open-air concert.
- Party Leaderboard is a worldwide championship for the biggest party of FlashBeats’ fans. How many friends can you invite to your private party? Let’s find out!
CAUTION! Blinding bright LED strobe lights may be harmful to the eyesight, and for some people, it might cause epileptic seizures!
Oh, you are still reading this? We didn’t think anyone would get this far. That means you must really like the FlashBeats app! Why not download FlashBeats and have a party today! 
BTW, we can also create incredible light shows at any music or sporting event, where we can connect everyone's smartphones for a fun and engaging experience for fans. Some of the things we can do include: launching a light wave, synchronizing light beats to the music, displaying a dance of light during a goal or at a runner's starting line, and
displaying sponsor's logos, images and even cartoons.
If you are interested in setting up a light show for your event, please contact us at: support@flashbeats.app
Enjoy your favorite music with your friends in a bright new way! Download the FlashBeats app today!

Terms of use: https://flashbeats.app/terms-of-use/
Privacy policy: https://flashbeats.app/privacy-policy/
Contact: support@flashbeats.app

bluejetty:00126311:ios.description:
Transform your smartphone into a document scanner and a mobile office. Easily scan, sign, edit, and convert documents from anywhere—whether you're at home, in the office, or on the move. Enjoy the convenience of digitizing and sharing files with just a few taps. Say goodbye to bulky scanners and embrace simplicity.
Key Features:
Fast Document Scanner
Use the document scanner to scan anything—contracts, receipts, notes, or IDs. Works as an ID scanner, receipt scanner, and even a business card scanner to keep your paperwork digital and organized.
Scan to PDF & Convert to PDF
Instantly convert or scan in high resolution. Whether it’s photos to PDF, JPG to PDF, or an image to text conversion, get professional-quality scans in seconds.
Edit Documents with Ease
Use the built-in document editor to edit documents, crop, rotate, and enhance scans before sharing. Perfect for contracts, notes, or any other paperwork.
Sign & Send with eSign
Digitally sign with the document signer and send them instantly. Use the eSign feature for contracts, agreements, or any important document.
Smart File Management
Easily organize scanned files with the built-in file manager and file organizer. Quickly access your documents, rename, categorize, and store them efficiently.
On-the-Go Sharing & Printing
Use the scan and go functionality to scan multiple pages instantly. Perfect for digitizing paperwork efficiently. Send documents via email, social media, or cloud storage. Use the fax app feature to send faxes directly from your phone. Need a hard copy? The app works as a PDF printer for iPhone, making it easy to print your files instantly.
Advanced OCR & Image to Text
Extract text from scanned documents using OCR text scanner technology. Convert image to text, edit content, and copy important details with ease.
Multiple File Formats & Conversions
Seamlessly convert scanned documents with the built-in file converter. Turn JPG to PDF, use the jpeg converter, or convert to PDF for easy sharing.
Perfect for Business & Personal Use

bluejetty:00147057:ios.description:
Welcome to myVW, a drive-changing app with connected vehicle services enabled through myVW+. The myVW app enables access to essential tools for most model year 2020 or newer VW vehicles, including service scheduling, finding a preferred Volkswagen dealer, viewing service history⁵, and other owner resources. Plus, subscribe to connected vehicle services plans to get access to additional available features (depending on vehicle model and equipment), such as:
• Remote start your engine¹
• Start and stop EV battery charging²
• Remote lock or unlock your doors³
• Remote honk and flash²
• Remotely access climate control for EVs²
• Manage EV battery settings⁶
• View last parked location⁴
• Create vehicle alerts, including speed, curfew, valet and boundary alerts²
• View fuel or EV battery status⁶
• Vehicle health reports⁷
• DriveView⁸ scores 
Use of the myVW app requires acceptance of myVW Terms of Service. Connected vehicle services enabled through myVW+ are available on most MY20 and newer vehicles and require an included or paid subscription, some of which may have their own terms and conditions. Paid subscription is required to continue services after included plan expires. Visit the shop tab in the myVW mobile app to see how much time is remaining on your subscriptions. All connected vehicle services require the myVW app and myVW account, cellular connectivity, network compatible hardware, availability of vehicle GPS signal, and acceptance of myVW and myVW+ Terms of Service. Not all services and features are available on all vehicles and some features may require the most recent software update. Services depend on connection to and continued availability of 4G LTE cellular service, which is outside of Volkswagen’s control. Services are not guaranteed or warranted in the event of 4G LTE network shutdowns, obsolescence, or other unavailability of connectivity due to existing vehicle hardware or other factors. All services are subject to change, discontinuation, or cancellation without notice. Certain connected vehicle services may require additional payment for emergency or other third-party services rendered such as towing or ambulance transport services. Message and data rates may apply for app and web features. Connected vehicle services are not available on most MY20 Passat vehicles or rental fleet vehicles. See Terms of Service, Privacy Statement, and other important information at vw.com/connected. Always pay careful attention to the road and do not drive while distracted. 
¹Requires active subscription to Remote Access plan and compatible factory-installed or dealer-installed remote start feature. See Owner’s Manual for further details and important warnings about the keyless ignition feature. Do not leave vehicle unattended with the engine running, particularly in enclosed spaces, and consult local laws for any limitations on use.
²Requires active subscription to Remote Access plan.
³Requires active subscription to Remote Access plan. See Owner’s Manual for further details and important warnings about locking and unlocking your vehicle remotely.
⁴Requires active subscription to Remote Access plan. Do not use feature to locate stolen vehicle.
⁵Service history is available as long as work was performed since January 2014 at a participating Volkswagen dealership.
⁶Requires active subscription to VW Vehicle Insights plan.
⁷Requires active subscription to VW Vehicle Insights plan. Refer to your vehicle's warning and indicator lights for the most current diagnostic information. Always consult owner's literature for maintenance guidelines and warnings. Vehicle Health Reports and Health Status may not be available on all EV models.
⁸Requires active subscription to VW Vehicle Insights plan and enrollment in DriveView. Use of your vehicle by multiple drivers may impact your driving score. Always obey all speed and traffic laws.

Welcome to Plato, where gaming meets chatting in the most epic way possible. Immerse yourself in over 50 amazing multiplayer games that don't suck and are deeply integrated with chat, so you can play and connect with friends old and new. 
Why You'll Love Plato:
● Games Galore: With 50 top-tier multiplayer games like Ocho (Crazy Eights), Pool, and Bowling, there's always something fun to play. Whether you're into strategy, sports, or classic board games, we've got you covered.
● Ad-Free Fun: Say goodbye to annoying ads and pay-to-win schemes with free games. Plato is all about pure, uninterrupted fun.
● Privacy First: We don't collect unnecessary data, so you can game and chat with peace of mind.
● Personalization Paradise: Personalize your profile, group chat themes, and game experiences to make Plato truly yours.
● Play with Friends: Play group chat games with Plato—it's a fully fledged messenger. Engage in group chats, chat rooms, and even voice chat for the ultimate social experience.
● Get Competitive: From competitive ranked games to player-run tournaments, there's always a chance to prove you're the best. Climb the leaderboards and earn bragging rights among your friends.
Games You Can't Miss:
● Classics: Checkers, Chess, Backgammon, Dice Party, Dominoes, Four in a Row
● Card Games: Baloot, Hold'em Poker, Spades, Gin Rummy, Hearts, Go Fish
● Board & Party Games: Ludo, Bingo, Dots & Boxes, Bankroll, Werewolf (Mafia)
● Sports & Action: Archery, Bounce, Basketball, Bowling, Cup Pong, Darts, Mini Golf, Table Soccer

● Plato Originals: Match Monsters, Brawlbots, Plox, Blitz League
Join millions of players around the world who have made Plato their go-to app for gaming and chatting. Download Plato today and experience the ultimate fusion of fun and friendship in online games!
Have a question? E-mail us at hello@platoapp.com, we’d love to hear from you.

Private messaging and calls across the world
Your privacy is our priority. With end-to-end encryption, you can be sure that your personal messages and calls stay between you and who you send them to. And no one, not even WhatsApp, can read or listen to them.
Simple and secure connections, right away

High quality voice and video calls

Stay connected in real time

Share daily moments through Status
Share your everyday life with those who matter. With Status you can share text, photos, video, and GIF updates that disappear after 24 hours. You're always in control of who sees your status. Just choose who you want to share it with - all your contacts or selected ones. And bring your everyday to life.

bluejetty:00177275:ios.description:
The Buc app makes it easier than ever to move around Buckhead, GA—with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. No detours, no delays.
What we’re about:
CONVENIENT.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said. Plus, all rides to or from a MARTA station are free! Head to bucride.com for more information.
How does the Buc work?
- The Buc is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. 
-Using the Buc app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. 
-Now for the clever bit: our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making public transportation easier than ever before! 
How long will I wait?
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking.
- You can also track your bus in real time using the app.
Questions? Head to bucride.com or reach out at support-buc@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

---
【为什么我要做这样一款软件？】
举铁的训练质量与重量、次数等因素密切相关，而在训练中，有一个“王者”指标——**训练容量 = 组数 × 重量 × 次数**。因此，一款方便记录自己训练质量的工具就显得非常必要。

bluejetty:00035725:ios.description:
【什么是「训记」？】
这是一款比较「硬核」的健身 App。
在训练中记录笔记，精确到每一组的重量和次数，对于健身爱好者来说非常重要。这款软件的初心是：更好地记录并分析自己的训练内容。
---
【为什么我要做这样一款软件？】
举铁的训练质量与重量、次数等因素密切相关，而在训练中，有一个“王者”指标——**训练容量 = 组数 × 重量 × 次数**。因此，一款方便记录自己训练质量的工具就显得非常必要。
在早些年，人们通常使用纸和笔来做记录。后来，微软发布了 Excel，很多人开始使用 Excel 来记录和分析数据，但它毕竟不够专门化，仍然有很多痛点。
直到今天，仍然有不少人在健身房坚持使用纸和笔，很多教练也是如此——他们通过纸笔来帮助会员记录和分析数据。纸笔最大的优点是“灵活”，但它的主要痛点在于容易丢失，且数据零散、杂乱，不便于长期积累和回顾。
Excel 在一定程度上能解决这些问题，但它毕竟只是一个通用的软件，并非专门针对健身记录。所以，我想做这样一款 App，旨在提供一个极其简单、没有任何“花哨”功能、却能自由记录个人训练数据的工具。
---
【训记和其他健身 App 有什么不同？我应该用它吗？】
其他健身 App 都是非常优秀的软件，它们提供了丰富的课程、视频和文章，也在很大程度上培养了从未想过健身的人群去尝试健身，我认为这是一件非常好的事情。
然而，其他健身 App 大多对我们这些健身狂人的自定义需求支持并不够——无论是自定义计划，还是自定义输入，都不算自由。因此，「训记」最大的特点便是——**足够自由**。
这款 App 的适用人群，我总结了几条，大家可以逐一对照，看看自己是否需要：
1. 你明白健身是怎么回事，也明白“健身”和“减肥”互不构成充分或必要条件。 
2. 你清楚健身记录的重要性，也重视对记录数据的分析。 
3. 你需要基于自己记录的数据，通过图表等自动分析和辅助功能，来指导和优化自身的训练。
---
【HealthKit】
- 在 Apple Watch 上进行训练时，每次训练的心率、消耗、训练距离会同步到 HealthKit，方便你在「健康」App 中查看。 
- 在「训记」-「我的」-「身体数据」中，开启「同步健康数据」即可同步体重数据。
【有关您的隐私和 HealthKit 数据的重要说明】
由于健康隐私非常重要，我们会在「训记」手表 App 首次使用时，询问你是否授权读取并写入心率、日常消耗及训练距离数据。只有在你同意后，「训记」才能更好地记录和分析你的训练情况。
---
【反馈方式】
- 「训记」 - 「我的」 - 「反馈中心」

bluejetty:00014555:ios.summary: Paycheck Lite computes your payroll check from a Gross payroll amount or calculates Hourly Wages, that may include overtime and double time. Paycheck Lite calculates net paycheck amount and applicable federal and state payroll taxes, such
bluejetty:00014555:ios.description:
Paycheck Lite computes your payroll check from a Gross payroll amount or calculates Hourly Wages, that may include overtime and double time. Paycheck Lite calculates net paycheck amount and applicable federal and state payroll taxes, such as federal withholding tax, social security, medicare, state withholding, state unemployment and state disability (where applicable). 
Paycheck Lite is an ideal tool for anyone looking to estimate net pay (take-home amount after taxes) in the state of employment. Use Paycheck Lite to calculate payroll check on a go and to compare net paychecks in 50 different states and US territories, especially if considering employment in a different state or a possible relocation. 
Paycheck details can be emailed to employee, employer, payroll service provider, spouse or anyone else. Use Paycheck Lite to estimate your net paycheck amount and budget your spending accordingly. 
Paycheck Lite mobile payroll app considers federal and state deduction allowances, current year to date wages paid, and federal and state filing statuses - details that affect accuracy of calculation. For professional payroll app and paycheck calculation consider upgrading to paid Payrollguru app, which allows for multiple employees payroll profiles, pre-tax and post-tax deductions, and displays a pie chart distribution of a gross paycheck. 
Paycheck Lite is available for iPhone, iPod and iPad. Thank you for using Paycheck Lite! If you enjoy using the app please review it, otherwise please send us your comments, suggestions and bug reports to support@payrollguru.mobi.

bluejetty:00165801:ios.description:
Playing Goodwill Tiles for just 10 minutes a day sharpens your mind, boosts your focus, and brings a sense of relaxation while making a difference! 
Take a break and dive into Goodwill Tiles, where you can blast colorful tiles, connect patterns, and sort the same color blocks and goods. This exciting tile-matching puzzle game combines the fun of matching games with the zen relaxation of strategic puzzles and a heartwarming mission. Challenge your brain, solve engaging puzzles, and help people in need as you match 3D tiles. With hundreds of levels, relaxing gameplay, and a unique rescue theme, this game is perfect for unwinding and having fun.
How to Play?
• Simply tap to match 3 identical tiles and clear the board.
• Be strategic! If the board fills up, you'll have to restart.
• Complete challenging levels and unlock hidden surprises while helping people and solving puzzles.
• Use helpful boosters when you need an extra hand.
Features You'll Love:
• Match 3D Tiles & Color Blocks – A fresh and fun take on classic tile-matching puzzles.
• Rescue People in Need – Every match brings hope and progress.
• Relax & Unwind – Beautiful visuals and soothing music for a stress-free experience.
• Hundreds of Levels – Unique tile sets, challenges, and fun obstacles.
• Power-Ups & Colorful Boosters – Use hints, shuffles, and more to help you win.
• Daily Rewards & Events – Keep coming back for new puzzles and surprises.
Why Play Goodwill Tiles?
If you love tile matching games, mahjong games, match 3 games, relaxing puzzles, and games with purpose, Goodwill Tiles is perfect for you! Whether you're a fan of family friendly matching puzzle games or the zen relaxation of tile matching, this game has something for everyone. It’s easy to play but challenging to become a tile match master, offering a mindful escape with meaningful gameplay.
Are you ready to match, help, and solve puzzles? Download Goodwill Tiles now and start your adventure!

bluejetty:00185264:ios.name: LEGO® Powered Up
bluejetty:00185264:ios.summary: Combine this app with the LEGO DC Super Heroes App-Controlled Batmobile (76112), the LEGO City Cargo Train (60198), or the LEGO City Passenger Train (60197) (each sold separately) to operate the motorized engines via Bluetooth controls, or
bluejetty:00185264:ios.description:
Combine this app with the LEGO DC Super Heroes App-Controlled Batmobile (76112), the LEGO City Cargo Train (60198), or the LEGO City Passenger Train (60197) (each sold separately) to operate the motorized engines via Bluetooth controls, or use your imagination and build entirely new creations using LEGO Powered Up components and bring them to life by coding them. Make your models move and respond to real-world events. 
The LEGO Powered Up app puts you in the driver’s seat of the awesome 4-wheel-drive Batmobile to speed through the streets of GOTHAM CITY™. Drive forwards, backwards, left and right… or pull 360-degree turns! You can even activate cool tricks and stunts as you become the Dark Knight and fight crime. You can customize and code your Batmobile tricks and choose your sounds and movements – pretty awesome!
The LEGO Powered Up app also controls LEGO trains to haul goods or pick up passengers around LEGO City. You can control the speed, change directions, and bring even more life to your play with various sounds such as a whistle, passenger announcement, railroad crossing bell, and more! The Bluetooth remote control app and the remote control handset included in the LEGO City train sets aren’t compatible with older infrared remote-controlled LEGO train sets.
Thanks to Powered Up components like hubs, motors, sensors, and lights you will be able to bring your customized creations to life. You can also bring your existing LEGO models to life. 
Is your device compatible? Please go to LEGO.com/devicecheck to check if your device is compatible. 
Ask your parents’ permission before going online. 
The LEGO Powered Up App Feature List
- Access control panels for DC Super Heroes App-Controlled Batmobile, LEGO City Cargo Train or LEGO City Passenger Train.
- Control speed and direction of LEGO vehicles with a variety of exciting interfaces.
- Add playful sounds and take your play to the next level.
- Use LEGO Powered Up hardware components in your customized models to bring them to life!
- Code movements and sounds for your models to create real-life behaviors.
- Simple, easy-to-understand programming language based on drag’n’drop coding.
LEGO and the LEGO logo are trademarks of the LEGO Group. ©2019 The LEGO Group

bluejetty:00074256:ios.summary:

Keep control over sensitive information stored on your iPhone even in case of theft or
bluejetty:00074256:ios.description:
NETGEAR Armor is a mobile app available to NETGEAR Armor customers, designed to provide security and privacy when on unfamiliar networks or public WiFi.
Keep control over sensitive information stored on your iPhone even in case of theft or loss. Ensure your digital assets remain private anytime, anywhere with this mobile security app for NETGEAR Armor users, powered by worldwide security provider Bitdefender.
Features at a glance:
Scam Alert
Stay ahead of scams and phishing attempts with our latest protection layer. The NETGEAR Armor SMS/MMS filter automatically sends messages from unknown senders with malicious links straight to your junk folder, keeping your messages safe.
Calendar Protection
Keep scams and phishing attempts out of your calendar. NETGEAR Armor identifies and removes harmful calendar events, protecting you from the "calendar virus."
Security Scan
Find our quickly if there are any misconfigurations that put your phone and data at risk and close those gaps to enjoy complete security. Rely on the tips and recommendations we provide to increase your level of protection because safety starts with the basics.
Web Protection
Browse safely with NETGEAR Armor's new Web Protection feature. Just turn it on, and we'll block any harmful websites trying to steal your personal information, like credit card details or your social security number, no matter which browser you use.
VPN
Secure your online privacy with ease. Connect to our VPN, and NETGEAR Armor will safeguard your internet activity. Enjoy secure, anonymous browsing, all with just a tap.
Dark Web Monitoring
Wondering if your personal info is out there? With NETGEAR Armor, you can easily check if your e-mail address, name, or phone number have surfaced on the dark web. Just validate your details, and we'll let you know if it's time to take action.
Please note:
To use this app, log in with the account you created when you activated NETGEAR Armor on your router.

Unleash the power of learning with our award-winning ABC Learning app, the ultimate educational companion for young minds! Prepare your child for a future filled with success as they embark on an extraordinary journey of alphabets, words, and language mastery.
Play offline, in the plane or on an internet free island.
Jump in a world of planets where learning letters is so much fun and really interesting, enjoy learning experience with cats, spaceships, islands and hundreds of learning activities.
Interactive Learning Adventure: 
Watch your child's face light up as they engage in a world of interactive games, captivating animations, and mind-boggling activities. Our app transforms learning into an exhilarating adventure that will keep them engaged for hours on end.
Master the ABCs with Ease: 
Say goodbye to traditional rote learning methods! Our app utilizes cutting-edge techniques to make alphabet mastery a breeze. From tracing letters with guided strokes to immersive activities that reinforce phonics and letter recognition, we've crafted a comprehensive curriculum that guarantees exceptional results.
Vocabulary Expansion at Lightning Speed: 
Witness your child's vocabulary skyrocket as they explore a vast collection of words brought to life through stunning visuals and audio pronunciations. From everyday objects to exciting concepts, they'll effortlessly absorb new letters, new words, associate them and meanings.
Personalized Learning Path: 
Every child is unique, and our app understands that. We've incorporated advanced algorithms to adapt to your child's progress and learning style, ensuring a personalized educational experience that maximizes their potential.
Learning Made Simple: 
Stay informed about your child's growth. Celebrate their achievements, identify areas for improvement, and gain valuable insights into their learning journey. You'll be amazed at how quickly they develop essential literacy skills!
A Safe and Ad-Free Zone: 
Your child's safety is our top priority. Our app provides a secure and ad-free environment, allowing them to explore and learn without any distractions or risks. You can have peace of mind knowing they're in a protected space designed exclusively for their benefit.
Ignite a love for learning and equip your child with the tools they need for a bright future. Join the millions of parents who have witnessed remarkable transformations in their children's academic prowess. Download our ABC Learning app today and unlock a world of limitless possibilities!
FEATURES:
- Learn UPPERCASE Letters from A-Z
- Learn Lowercase Letters from A-Z
- Understand the difference between Uppercase and Lowercase Letters from A-Z
- Associate Uppercase and Lowercase Letters 
- Associate the letter with an animal or object for easy learning.
- Tracing techniques
- Play in a space world full of fun.
- Amazing music and voice overs.
- Select letters.
- Add the letter where it belongs in the word.
- Learn A-Z letters by using interactive techniques.
- Learn to add numbers
- More to come.
Your lovely child is going to improve:
- Visual perception
- Concentration
- Hand-eye coordination
- Classifying and sorting
- Logical thinking
We do our best to make the world a better place, starting with educational techniques.
Thank you for supporting us and using the products we put so much love into.
We would love to hear your feedback, improvements or suggestions.
Send us love at hello@wakamakafo.com

Terms of service: https://wakamakafo.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://wakamakafo.com/privacy

bluejetty:00177459:ios.description:
Mutlu anne, ücretsiz olarak indirebileceğiniz kullanımı oldukça basit bir hamilelik ve gebelik takip uygulamasıdır. 
Bebek planlıyorum özelliği ile artık hamile kalma sürecindeki kadınların da kullanımı için uygundur.
Uygulamada yer alan zengin görsellerle bebeğinizin gelişimini günlük olarak takip edebileceğiniz Mutlu Anne, bu heyecanlı serüveninizde her zaman yanınızda olacak hamilelik rehberiniz olacaktır.
Son adet tarihinizi veya bebeğinizin tahmini doğum tarihini uygulamaya girerek hamilelik takibinizi kolayca başlatabilirsiniz.
Uygulamada Bulabileceğiniz Özellikler:
● Hem anne hem de bebek için ayrı olarak hazırlanmış günlük bilgiler
● Günlük olarak bebeğinizden gelecek eğlenceli bildirimler ve işinize yarayacak faydalı bilgilendirme mesajları
● Bebeğinizin ağzından gönderilen, sizin de cevap vererek bebeğinize kavuşmadan onunla sohbet etmenizi sağlayacak birbirinden eğlenceli mesajlar. İsterseniz bebeğinizin mesajını ve sizin cevabınızı sevdiklerinizle de paylaşabilirsiniz
● Diğer annelerle bilgi paylaşımı yapabileceğiniz, kafanıza takılan soruları sorabileceğiniz ve hatta uzman görüşü alabileceğiniz forum platformu
● Blog menüsü altında yer alan farklı kategorilerde, hamilelere özel olarak hazırlanan günlük içerikler
● Bebeğine isim seçmekte zorlanan anneler için binlerce isimden ve isimlerin anlamından oluşan bir liste içerisinden çarkı döndürerek rastgele bebeğinize isim seçebilme fırsatı
● Bebeğinizin tekme sayısını ve tekme aralıklarını ölçebileceğiniz ve kaydedebileceğiniz ücretsiz tekme sayar
● Güncel kilonuzu kaydedebileceğiniz ve kilonuzdaki değişimleri gözlemleyebileceğiniz kilo takibi bölümü
● Bebeğin ve annenin ihtiyaç duyacağı tüm malzemelerin ve doğum çantanızda olması gereken malzemelerin listesi
● Hislerinizi, anılarınızı ve bebeğinize söylemek istediğiniz tüm düşüncelerinizi yazabileceğiniz bebeğime notlar bölümü
● Sağlıklı bir hamilelik dönemi geçirmeniz için yaptırmanız gereken testlerin listesine ulaşabileceğiniz sağlık testleri bölümü
● Hamileliğiniz boyunca almanız gereken ilaçları ekleyerek isteğinize göre hatırlatıcı koyabileceğiniz ilaç takibi bölümü
Kolayca hamileliğinizi organize ederek kendinize notlar tutabileceğiniz takvim bölümü
● Bebeğinizin fotoğraflarını aylara göre düzenleyerek anılarınızı her daim yanınızda taşımanızı sağlayacak albüm bölümü
● Üstelik her ay düzenlediğimiz çekilişler ile annelerimizi mutlu etmeye devam ediyoruz
Mutlu Anne, hamilelik rehberi uygulaması ile harika bir 280 gün geçirmeniz temennisiyle!
Kullanıcı Sözleşmesi: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Welcome to Goods Mart: Sort & Match!
Love organizing? Looking for a calming, satisfying game to brighten your day?
Goods Mart is made just for you.

Match and organize cute 3D goods — from snacks and drinks to household items.
Satisfying Triple Matching
Drag and place three identical items on the same shelf to clear them and tidy up the mess.
Play Anytime, No Internet Needed

Use clever boosters and powerful power-ups to clear obstacles and breeze through tough levels.
Hundreds of Fun & Challenging Levels
Each level offers unique shelf combinations and organizing challenges to keep things fresh!
Adorable Characters with Personality

Drag and place items onto the shelf
Match 3 identical items to clear them
Sort smartly and make combos to keep your shelf organized
Complete goals to unlock shelves and decorations
Use boosters when you get stuck
Relax, match, and enjoy the satisfying cleanup!
Start your organizing journey today with Goods Mart — your cozy, calming escape into the world of matching and tidying up.
CONTACT US
Share your feedback with us to help us continue improving!
