bluejetty:00023670:ios.summary: Supershift is the world's most downloaded and highest-rated shift calendar app on iOS. It is built specifically for nurses, doctors, paramedics, police officers, firefighters, factory and manufacturing workers, retail staff, airport crew, a
bluejetty:00023670:ios.description:
Supershift is the world's most downloaded and highest-rated shift calendar app on iOS. It is built specifically for nurses, doctors, paramedics, police officers, firefighters, factory and manufacturing workers, retail staff, airport crew, and bus, train, and tram drivers.
No account required. No internet required. Open the app and start planning immediately - your schedule is yours, stored entirely on your device, and available anywhere from the ward to the cab to the factory floor.
If you are looking for an alternative to bloated shift apps that track your data or force you to log in, Supershift is the cleaner and faster.
WHY SHIFT WORKERS CHOOSE SUPERSHIFT
• Multiple shifts per day: Easily schedule early + late shifts, main + on-call, split shifts, or second jobs.
• Custom emojis & colors: Assign specific colors and icons to every shift type so you can read your month at a glance.
• Full Dark Mode: A beautiful, eye-friendly dark mode for comfortable night-shift viewing.
• No account required: Start using it in seconds. 
• Works fully offline: Your schedule is always accessible, even without a cell signal or Wi-Fi.
CALENDAR SHARING
Share your work schedule with family, partners, friends, or coworkers so everyone stays in sync. Coordinate shift swaps, check availability instantly, and cut out the endless back-and-forth texting.
SMART SHIFT ALARMS
Stop setting alarms manually every Sunday night. Assign a wake-up time to each shift type once, and Supershift automatically sets the right alarm for every early, late, or night shift based on your schedule.
COMPLEX ROTATIONS
Define your rotation pattern once and apply it up to 2 years in advance. Supershift effortlessly handles 4-on-4-off, DuPont, Pitman, Panama, Continental, 2-2-3, and any custom rotation you throw at it.
REPORTS & TRACKING
Track earnings, shift differentials, hours per shift type, overtime, and shift counts (e.g., vacation days, sick days, training days). Perfect for verifying payroll checks and simplifying tax time.
APPLE WATCH
Glance at current and upcoming shifts right from your wrist. Watch complications include countdown timers showing exactly when your shift starts and how much time is remaining.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Keep your schedule front and center with Day, 2-week, 4-week, or Agenda view widgets right on your home screen and lock screen.
CLOUD SYNC
Use optional Cloud Sync to keep your iPhone and iPad perfectly aligned, and to instantly restore your data when you get a new device.
SUPERSHIFT PRO FEATURES
• iOS Calendar Export: Push your shifts directly to Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, or Outlook.
• PDF Export: Create and share a polished PDF version of your monthly calendar complete with title, times, breaks, notes, location, and total hours worked.
• External Calendar Integration: See birthdays, appointments, and personal events from your external calendars right alongside your shifts.
Privacy Policy:
https://supershift.app/privacy.html

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Your music, your way — with Muzik Box.

bluejetty:00123266:ios.name: UBS Access – secure login
bluejetty:00123266:ios.summary: With the UBS Access App you can log in to E-Eanking and the Mobile Banking App easily and securely. The UBS Access App also allows you to confirm new payees and online purchases made using credit or prepaid card, and it informs you about se
bluejetty:00123266:ios.description:
With the UBS Access App you can log in to E-Eanking and the Mobile Banking App easily and securely. The UBS Access App also allows you to confirm new payees and online purchases made using credit or prepaid card, and it informs you about security-related events. 
1. Log in easily to Digital Banking
- E-Banking: Open the login page, scan the QR code with the Access App, enter your PIN or use biometrics and you’ll be immediately and securely logged in to E-Banking. 
- Mobile Banking: Launch the Mobile Banking App and select “Access App” as the login method. Afterwards, you can easily and securely log in using a PIN or biometrics. 
2. Approve online payments securely
- When you make online payments by credit or prepaid card, you will receive a push notification and can simply confirm the payment. 
- The highest standards in security reduce the risk of fraud. 
3. Confirm new payees 
- Unblock the Access App with a PIN or using biometrics, check payees and approve payments.
4. Receive security messages
- Receive information concerning security-related events such as changes to your security settings or contact details.
Using the UBS Access App is this secure: 
- A PIN of your choice protects the Access App – even if you lose your smartphone. 
- The Access App always checks the security of your smartphone before you log in to Digital Banking.
- The security code for the login is calculated automatically and transferred directly to UBS. Data transmission is protected by multi-level security.
- The Access App is always up-to-date and offers optimum protection.
- Set up biometrics to log in more easily and to confirm new payees.
UBS Switzerland AG and other non-US affiliated companies of UBS Group AG only make the use of the UBS Access App (“App”) available to existing clients of UBS Switzerland AG and of other non-US affiliated companies of UBS Group AG. Other persons are not permitted to use the App. The App is not intended for US persons nor persons domiciled in Australia. The provision of the App for download in the Apple App Store does not constitute a solicitation, offer or recommendation to enter into any transaction, nor is it to be understood as a solicitation or offer to establish a client relationship between the person who downloads the App and UBS Switzerland AG or other non-US affiliated companies of UBS Group AG.
Requirements:
Banking relationship at UBS Switzerland AG, UBS Europe SE (Germany, Italy) or UBS AG (Hong Kong, Singapore) with Digital Banking contract: For activation, you will need a mobile number stored in Digital Banking for security messages. Enter this mobile number in the profile of your Mobile Banking App: Tap on your name and go to "Phone". You can also do this in E-Banking via your profile: In "My contact details" click on the pencil symbol and then "Phone numbers". Please enter your phone number without the initial 0 and modify the country code if you do not have a Swiss mobile number.
Banking relationship at UBS Europe SE (UK, France, Monaco or Luxembourg): For activation, you will need a saved mobile number. Please contact your client advisor to set this up.
Banking relationship at UBS Europe SE (Jersey) with a "Digital Banking" contract: For activation, you will need an Access Card with card reader or an Access Card Display. 
The range of functions may differ depending on the country. 
We hope you will enjoy using the UBS Access App. We look forward to receiving your feedback and your rating in the Apple App Store.

bluejetty:00188035:ios.description:
The official AutoCAD app. View & edit CAD drawings anytime, anywhere!
Essential drafting and design capabilities for your everyday needs: Autodesk® AutoCAD® Web on mobile is a trusted solution that gives you access to the core AutoCAD commands that you need for light editing and generating fundamental designs, all at an attractive price.
AutoCAD Web subscription plans are available in the following options:
• Monthly for $9.99
• Yearly for $99.99 
• Included free with AutoCAD and AutoCAD LT subscriptions
Use familiar AutoCAD drafting tools on your mobile device in a simplified interface, allowing you to access, create, and update DWG™ files anytime, anywhere.
30 day trial: Enjoy a fully functional free trial of AutoCAD Web for 30 days. After the trial is completed, you can access limited read-only functionality without a paid subscription.
Current AutoCAD or AutoCAD LT desktop subscribers: Sign in with your Autodesk account to access AutoCAD Web on mobile.
Key Benefits:
• Work offline on your projects without an Internet connection and sync later
• Safeguard drawings in your Autodesk account or with your own external accounts
• Collaborate in real time with team members and reduce mistakes
• Replace blueprints at job sites with drawings on mobile
• Simplify workflows by opening DWG files directly from Autodesk Drive, Autodesk Docs, Microsoft OneDrive, Box, Dropbox, or Google Drive.
Features:
• 2D file viewing 
• Create, edit, and share 2D drawings 
• Work offline and sync your changes once back online
• Insert blocks from your DWG drawing 
• Manage layers and layer visibility 
• Drafting and geometry editing tools 
• Annotation and markup tools 
• Measure distance, angle, area, and radius 
• View and edit DWG files from your internal storage, email, or from the cloud
• View coordinates and properties
All new users have access to a free trial of AutoCAD Web for 30 days.
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your Apple ID. 
Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel a subscription during the active period. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.
*Free products and services are subject to the Autodesk Terms of Use at https://www.autodesk.com/company/terms-of-use/en/general-terms 
Learn more:
Autodesk Website: https://www.autodesk.com/products/autocad-web
Term of Use: https://www.autodesk.com/company/legal-notices-trademarks/terms-of-service-autodesk360-web-services/autodesk-autocad-mobile-terms-of-service
AutoCAD Service is not provided to children under the age of 14, and users under 14 cannot use this Service.

bluejetty:00098573:ios.description:
Idle Thief Village: Retro RPG
Steal and build in this unique retro adventure!
Welcome to Idle Thief Village: Retro RPG, where strategy, resource management, and daring thief missions combine to create an exciting retro-styled experience! Build a thriving village, gather resources, and lead your hero on thrilling dungeon heists to collect treasures, gold, and powerful equipment.
Key Features:
# Build and Manage Your Village:
Construct and upgrade essential buildings like lumber mills, blacksmiths, and farms to generate resources and expand your village. Plan wisely to optimize production and support your hero’s adventures!
# Thrilling Thief Missions:
Take control of your hero and embark on action-packed dungeon raids! Dodge traps, outsmart enemies, and collect valuable loot hidden in dark and dangerous places. Will you return with treasures or fall in battle?
# Hero Progression and Skill Tree:
Level up your hero, earn skill points, and customize your abilities in a detailed skill tree. Unlock powerful skills to survive tougher enemies and make each heist more rewarding.
# Collect Equipment and Treasures:
Find legendary weapons, armor, and treasures as you explore dungeons. Equip your hero to become stronger, faster, and more resilient on your missions.
# Idle Gameplay with Active Adventure:
Enjoy a perfect mix of idle village-building and engaging action gameplay. Resources keep flowing while you’re away, so you can focus on strategic upgrades and exciting missions when you return.
# Retro Pixel Art Style:
Delight in charming pixel art graphics and nostalgic visuals that bring your village and dungeon adventures to life. A perfect mix of classic and modern gameplay!
Why You’ll Love Idle Thief Village: Retro RPG:
Combine strategy, action, and resource management in one game.
Explore dark dungeons filled with enemies, treasures, and secrets.
Upgrade your hero with skills and legendary gear to dominate thief missions.
Relax with idle resource generation while planning your next heist.
Are you ready to become the ultimate thief and build a legendary village?
Download Idle Thief Village: Retro RPG now and begin your adventure!

bluejetty:00152466:ios.summary: Discover your personal style and bring your digital closet to life with Setly: the ultimate outfit maker and style discovery app. Take style quizzes, swipe through trending pieces, build outfits, and connect with a global community of fashi
bluejetty:00152466:ios.description:
Discover your personal style and bring your digital closet to life with Setly: the ultimate outfit maker and style discovery app. Take style quizzes, swipe through trending pieces, build outfits, and connect with a global community of fashion lovers.
How it works:
    •    Outfit Maker – Mix and match products to create looks for yourself or for your friends.
    •    Upload Your Own Items – Add anything you love directly into your closet by uploading a photo or screenshot.
    •    Style Quizzes – Pick your favorite products and get matched with aesthetics that reflect your taste.
    •    Swipe to Save – Swipe right on pieces you love and they land in your closet instantly. Swipe left to pass.
    •    Style Your Friends – Create looks for other people using the items in their closets, and they can style you right back.
    •    Share to the Feed – Post your outfits to the community feed, browse looks from stylists around the world, and never run out of inspiration.
    •    Outfit Challenges – Enter themed styling challenges and create the best look for the moment. The community votes on the winners.
    •    Weekly Tournaments – Compete in multi-day tournaments to win prizes and climb the leaderboard.
    •    Points & Leaderboard – Earn points for creating, competing, and participating.
    •    Community – Follow your favorite stylists, chat, and share finds with people who love fashion as much as you do.
Whether you're planning real outfits, experimenting with new aesthetics, or just here to play, Setly is your creative space to explore and share your style.
Your closet is waiting. Download Setly and start styling.

The Discover Personality App helps you on your emotional health journey by first identifying how your emotional health is affected by your personality. The Discover Personality App identifies the personality traits that are hindering your emotional health. Once your personality traits are identified you can use the Enhance Personality App to develop those personality traits.
The Discover Personality App will first identify the qualities that are causing your emotional health issues. Secondly, using interesting personality quizzes, you will be shown how your personality is affecting your emotional health. You will then be asked questions regarding your personality traits to determine the strength of the personality trait that needs to be enhanced. Examples of personality traits include sensitivity, perfectionism, obsessiveness and nervousness. You can think of these traits as the summation of your behaviors.
The Discover Personality App is based on neuroscience to provide you with an accurate assessment of the personality traits affecting your emotional well-being. Going through the Discover Personality App will be the start of a rewarding journey for you.

Who Benefits from CodenQuest?
Aspiring Coders: Break away from dull tutorials and embrace gamified lessons in JavaScript, Python, and more—perfect for interview prep and building solid fundamentals.
Professional Developers: Keep your skills fresh in languages like PHP, Rust, and Go with quick, on-the-go coding challenges that fit your schedule.
Advanced Programmers: Push boundaries with complex problems, analyze performance metrics, and compete in top-tier leagues for an extra edge in your coding career.
Job Seekers: Prepare for technical interviews using challenges modeled after real-world coding tests. Gain the confidence and proficiency to stand out in any recruitment process.
Why CodenQuest?
CodenQuest redefines learning to code by merging education with fun. Practice core programming concepts, enhance your programming logic, and master new technologies. Our daily tasks and algorithm puzzles immerse you in software development fundamentals, whether you’re focused on web development, data science, or software engineering. With guided tutorials, you’ll build confidence in coding syntax, efficiency, and problem-solving techniques.
Download CodenQuest and unlock your potential. Our interactive approach, detailed analytics, and gamified progression transform coding practice into an exciting quest. Strengthen your command of Python, JavaScript, Java, and other popular languages, then apply these skills in real-world projects or technical interviews. Gain a competitive edge, join our vibrant community of coders, and climb the ranks of the coding leagues to showcase your expertise.
Embark on your coding adventure today and experience how CodenQuest can revolutionize your learning routine. With each lesson, challenge, and league match, you’ll move closer to achieving your coding ambitions. Take the leap and discover a future of limitless possibilities—one line of code at a time.

bluejetty:00160367:ios.name: Learn to Read: CVC Words
bluejetty:00160367:ios.summary:
Want to give your child a head start with their reading skills — without boring repetition of word pronunciations? Looking for an engaging way to introduce your child to the world of putting letters together to spell words? 
Dinosaur ABC 2
bluejetty:00160367:ios.description:
Want to give your child a head start with their reading skills — without boring repetition of word pronunciations? Looking for an engaging way to introduce your child to the world of putting letters together to spell words? 
Dinosaur ABC 2 integrates fun games into step-by-step phonics lessons to help children have fun learning word sounds and mastering CVC word spelling skills with ease!
Step-By-Step Phonics Learning Method
CVC words are consonant-vowel-consonant words, such as cat, pig, and bug. We present word spelling to children in an orderly, fun, and visual way. The interactive games make learning words both fun and easy, which will help children to start reading.
Fun Spelling Games — Learn Through Play
From combining letters to making and spelling words, we've designed fun and entertaining games for each step-by-step spelling skill. Kids will experience combining letter bricks, magic word machines, disappearing mystery pictures, and more. With Dinosaur ABC 2, children can have fun playing games and easily master phonics at the same time!
15 Fun Stories to Stimulate Reading Interest
Studying and practical application of what you learn should be creative, not boring! And when children are introduced to learning in a fun way, this will help them in school. For this reason, we designed interesting short stories for each word family. Through the combination of learned words and stories, children can deepen their understanding and memory of the CVC words. This sense of achievement helps to stimulate their interest in reading.
Generous Rewards to Build Your Own Amusement Park
Each time they complete a level, children will receive star rewards to build their own amusement park, complete with roller coasters, carousels, Ferris wheels, and more. These instant rewards increase motivation and make your child’s learning journey full of fun!
Features
• Step-by-step phonics learning method, easy to master phonics
• Creative spelling games, learn through play
• 15 fun stories to stimulate reading interest
• Learn 45 CVC words help introduce spelling skills
• Use stars to build amusement park with roller coaster, pirate ship, carousel, circus, & more
• Works offline without internet connection
• No third-party advertisements
About Yateland
Yateland crafts apps with educational value, inspiring preschoolers across the globe to learn through play! With each app we make, we are guided by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Learn more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland is committed to protecting users' privacy. If you would like to know more about how we deal with these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.
Terms of Use: https://yateland.com/terms

bluejetty:00186376:ios.description:
The New Innovations mobile app is designed for graduate medical education (GME) Residents and Fellows, and undergraduate medical education (UME) students in today’s clinical learning environment. GME users can utilize Work Hours, Procedure Privileges, Procedure Logging, Evaluations and a QR code scanner for conference attendance tracking. UME users can also access Evaluations and the QR code scanner with more yet to come. Free from the constraint of returning to a desk or workstation, trainees can now engage with the key features of the New Innovations suite anywhere!
Please Note: Most features of New Innovations are accessible and compatible with current mobile web browsers. 
The app delivers a secure, persistent log-in that requires users to sign in once, and then only again after 30 days of inactivity. All users must have a valid New Innovations log-in. 
GME
Work Hours
Approve hours logged manually or previously scheduled
Add or edit hours of current day or previous 13 days
View scheduled hours up to two days in the future
Select “did not work” as an option if missed scheduled hours
Include date, time and location
See violation details that are not in compliance with ACGME rules
Procedure Privileges
Monitor progress towards procedure targets within your home department
View privileges achieved / completed for other departments
Check procedures listed alphabetically
Verify level of supervision required to conduct a procedure
Procedure Logger
Select appropriate procedure at the correct location
Provide information required by the program
Submit to observer for approval
Review list of logged procedures and see confirmation status
Evaluations
Available for residents, fellows and faculty
Complete and request on-demand evaluations
Direct Observation Assessments
Conduct on-the-spot assessments based on published EPAs. 
Avoid supervisor log-in and receive a summary or send a request to supervisors to complete.
QR Code Scanner
Access within the app
Use to scan QR codes for conference attendance tracking
UME
Evaluations
Available for students and faculty
Complete and request on-demand evaluations

bluejetty:00186629:ios.name: Puzzle Games for Pre-k Kids
bluejetty:00186629:ios.summary: Turn screen time into gentle early learning with a calm educational app designed for toddlers, babies, and preschool kids. This collection brings together puzzle games, animal games, drawing activities, coloring games, abc, numbers, shapes,
bluejetty:00186629:ios.description:
Turn screen time into gentle early learning with a calm educational app designed for toddlers, babies, and preschool kids. This collection brings together puzzle games, animal games, drawing activities, coloring games, abc, numbers, shapes, memory, and simple logic in one safe place for young children.
Each game is made to feel easy, friendly, and comfortable. Kids can tap, match, draw, color, explore animals, solve puzzles, and build early problem-solving skills at their own pace. The focus is learning through play, without timers, pressure, or complicated instructions.
What’s inside
Learning games for kids: simple activities that introduce abc, numbers, shapes, colors, memory, and logic through calm play and repetition.
Puzzle games: gentle puzzles and matching activities that help children practise attention, memory, visual thinking, and early problem-solving.
Animal games: friendly animal activities where kids can recognize animals, match pictures, and explore playful scenes through simple interaction.
Drawing for kids: creative drawing activities that encourage imagination, fine motor skills, and relaxed visual learning.
Coloring games: easy coloring and color recognition activities that help kids explore colors step by step.
Learning by age
Games for toddlers: calm toddler games created for everyday learning at home or on the go.
Games for toddlers 2–4 years old: simple activities with big buttons, clear visuals, matching, shapes, and early logic.
Baby games: gentle play with simple actions, friendly feedback, and easy activities suitable for younger children.
Preschool games: early learning activities that help children build confidence before preschool routines.
Skills and early education
Learning path: activities progress gently from simple tapping to more focused learning games.
Memory and logic: repeated play helps kids practise memory, attention, sorting, matching, and early thinking skills.
ABC and numbers: alphabet, abc, numbers, and first learning concepts are introduced through playful activities.
Shapes and colors: visual puzzles, coloring, and matching games help children recognize shapes, colors, and simple patterns.
Designed for families
Simple layout: clean screens, large buttons, and easy navigation make the app comfortable for toddlers and young kids.
Creative play: drawing, coloring, puzzles, animals, and learning activities give children different ways to explore.
Flexible learning time: short games work well for quick sessions, while longer play supports deeper learning and confidence.
This educational app combines toddler games, baby games, learning games, puzzle games, animal games, coloring games, drawing activities, and preschool learning in one friendly place. It is suitable for kids, babies, toddlers, and young children, while keeping early education calm, simple, and playful.

apple-itunes:1422582034.name: Easy QR Code Reader - Scanner
apple-itunes:1422582034.description:
A simple QR code reader that scans the moment you point your camera. QR codes and barcodes are read just by aiming, and every scan is saved to your history automatically.
Open the app and point your camera — no shutter button, no mode switching. Scanned URLs and email addresses open with a single tap.
■ Ideal for
- Reading QR codes on posters, flyers, and in stores
- Looking up products by their barcode (EAN/UPC)
- Scanning ISBN barcodes on books
- Reading a QR code inside a screenshot someone sent you
- Scanning campaign and event entry QR codes
■ Main features
- Automatic scanning — just point
The reader starts as soon as the app opens. No button to press.
- Read multiple codes at once
Detect several QR codes and barcodes on the screen in a single sweep. No more re-aiming at each code one by one.
- Scan from photos and screenshots
Can't point your camera at it? Pick a photo or screenshot from your album and the QR code inside is read right away.
- Zoom in for confident reads
Bring distant posters or tiny label codes right up close with a single tap. Small print and far-away codes both stay within reach.
- Show & save the code you scanned
Re-display any scanned code inside the app. Pick a color and module shape (square / dot / rounded), then save it to your photo library or share it through the system share sheet.
- Flashlight for dark places
Turn on the light and scan cleanly, even in low light.
- Automatic history
Every scan is saved locally on your device. Search or star to keep favorites organized.
- Built-in browser
Scanned URLs open right inside the app — or in your external browser if you prefer.
■ Supported code types
- 2D codes: QR Code, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec
- 1D barcodes: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93
From product barcodes to book ISBNs, one app covers the codes you meet every day.
■ Privacy
Your scan history is stored only on your device. No account or sign-in required. The camera permission is used solely for reading codes.
■ FAQ
Q. Is the app free?
A. Yes — every feature is free to use (the app shows ads).
Q. Can I use it as a barcode reader?
A. Yes. Besides QR codes, it reads EAN/UPC product barcodes and more.
Q. Does scanning work offline?
A. Scanning itself works offline. An internet connection is only needed to open scanned URLs.
Q. Can I delete my scan history?
A. Yes — delete entries one by one, or all at once.

apple-itunes:6798420121.name: Yonora: Private Messenger
apple-itunes:6798420121.description:
Yonora is a simple messenger for the people who matter to you. Messages, voice notes, photos, video, and free voice and video calls — all in one app.
PRIVATE WHEN YOU WANT IT
Open any one-to-one chat, tap the lock, and Private mode turns on. From that moment your messages are end-to-end encrypted on your own devices, so only the two of you can read them. Nobody else can — not even us.
SPEAK YOUR OWN LANGUAGE
Write in the language you think in. Yonora translates messages into the language the other person reads, across a hundred languages. Send a voice note and it can be turned into text, or into another language, so family in different countries can finally talk without stopping to type in English.
FREE VOICE AND VIDEO CALLS
Clear one-to-one calls and group calls for the whole family or the whole team. Put a call on hold and switch to another one. Calls use your internet connection.
EVERYTHING YOU EXPECT FROM A MESSENGER
- Groups, with disappearing messages when you want them

Block anyone, in one tap — they cannot message you, call you, or see when you are online. Report a message or an account and a real person reviews it. You can delete your account, and everything in it, from inside the app at any time.
WORKS WHERE YOU DO
Yonora also runs in your browser, so the same conversations follow you from your phone to your computer.
